tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/saṃ pu ṭa nā ma ma hā tant+ra/bod skad du/ /yang dag par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal
༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/saṃ pu ṭa nā ma ma hā tant+ra/bod skad du/ /yang dag par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /rgya gar skad du/ saṃ pu ṭa nā ma ma hā tant+ra/ bod skad du/ /yang dag par sbyor ba zhes bya ba'i rgyud chen po/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa'i dus gcig na/ bcom ldan de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang gsung dang thugs kyi snying po rdo rje btsun mo'i bha ga rnams la bzhugs so/ /de nas yang bcom ldan kyis rnal 'byor gyi dbang phyug bye ba phrag brgyad cu'i nang nas rdo rje snying po la gzigs te 'dzum pa mdzad do/ /'dzum pa mdzad ma thag tu de'i tshe rdo rje snying po stan las langs te/ bla gos phrag pa gcig tu byas nas pus mos g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ thal mo sbyar ba byas nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /ye shes kyi dbang po rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi'i gsang ba yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i mtshan nyid mnyan par 'tshal lo/ /e ma'o rdo rje snying po legs so legs so/ /snying rje chen po legs so legs so/ /byang chub sems dpa' chen po yon tan gyi phung po legs so legs so/ /gang zhig rgyud thams cad du gsang ba de thams cad 'dod pas zhus shig de nas rdo rje snying po la sogs pa'i byang chub sems dpa' chen po de rnams rab tu 'dzum zhing mig phye bas phyag 'tshal te/ rang gi the tshom yang dang yang du zhus pa/ rgyud ni thams cad ci zhes brjod/ /gling gzhi yang ni ji ltar lags/ /'di la gsang ba ci zhes gsungs/ /ji ltar yang dag sbyor byung ming / /de la mtshan nyid ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rgyud dang thams cad de ni rgyud thams cad do/ /rgyud thams cad kyi sgras ni 'dus pa la sogs pa'o/ /de rnams kyi gling gzhi ni byung bar nges pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /khyab 'jug dang / dbang phyug chen po dang / tshangs pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i phyir gsang ba'o/

/yang dag par sbyor ba ni thabs dang shes rab kyi bdag nyid can no/ /de las byung ba ni yang dag par sbyor ba'i ting nge 'dzin ces bya ba'i don to/ /'byung ba ni skye ba ste/ /de ltar gnas pa dang g.yo ba'i dngos po'i rang bzhin gyi bdag nyid can du gyur pa'o/ /mtshan nyid ces bya ba ni 'dis mtshon par byed pa'o/ /yang na rgyud thams cad kyi gling gzhi yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba zhes bya ba'i sgras ni rdo rje sems dpar gsungs so/ /gsang ba zhes bya ba 'dis ni man ngag can gyi sngags btu ba dang / dkyil 'khor gyi lha la sogs pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid rgyud/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /dang po stong nyid bsams pas ni/ /lus can rnams kyi dri ma bkru/ /gzugs kyi khams ni stong pa yi/ /sgra la de nyid kyis ni bya/ /dri yi khams ni stong pa yi/ /ro la de nyid kyis ni bya/ /reg bya'i khams ni stong pa yi/ /yid la de nyid kyis ni bya/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ mig gi rang bzhin stong pa yi/ /nang du rnam shes ji ltar lags/ /rna ba'i rang bzhin stong pa yi/ /nang du rnam shes ji ltar lags/ /sna yi rang bzhin stong pa yi/ /nang du rnam shes ji ltar lags/ /lce yi rang bzhin stong pa yi/ /nang du rnam shes ji ltar lags/ /lus kyi rang bzhin stong pa yi/ /nang du rnam shes ji ltar lags/ /yid kyi rang bzhin stong pa yi/ /dbus su rnam shes ji ltar lags/ /de phyi gzugs med lta ba med/ /sgra med thos pa po yang med/ /dri med snom pa po yang med/ /ro med myong ba po yang med/ /reg med reg po yang med/ /sems med sems las byung ba'ang med/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnyis med gnyis ni rnam spangs pa'i/ /de nyid lam ni ji bzhin nyon/ /rtog ge med cing rnam shes med/ /de bzhin rtog ge pas mi rtogs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/

/nam mkha' lta bur mnyam pa nyid/ /nyan thos rnams kyis mi shes te/ /mi shes pa yi mun pas bsgribs/ /bag chags sad pa'i ye shes gang / /rang rgyal rnams kyi sprul pa 'o/ /gsang ba sangs rgyas spyod yul nyid/ /de rnams kun gyis mi shes so/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'jigs pa las/ /rgal bar 'gro ba'i sems kyis ni/ /lus kyi dbus su bskor ba yi/ /rgal ba mtshon par gsungs pa ste/ /rnam shes ye shes sems kyis ni/ /mtshan nyid mtshan gzhi mtshon par byed/ /ye shes kyis ni shes bya blta/ /shes bya rnams kyis 'gro ba brtag /'gro ba brtag pa'i sems kyis ni/ /ji ltar rang 'dod la sogs 'gro/ /'gro bar sngon gyi skye ba ni/ /stong phrag du ma dag tu 'gro/ /yo gis sngar gsungs mtshan nyid kyi/ /mtshan nyid nyid stong par bsams nas ni/ /lus kyi stong pa'i zhing sogs la/ /blo dang ldan pas sa bon gdab/ /rtsa yi mdzes spyi las byung ba/ /de ni rdul bral rab tu grags/ /dag pa'i shel gyi 'od dang mnyam/ /byang chub sems ni 'od gsal ba/ /ye shes lnga yi dngos de nyid/ /yungs kar gyi ni sbom phra tsam/ /de yi nang du gnas pa'i lha/ /mi gsal gsal ba'i rang bzhin can/ /ma mo phyed pa mchog tu phra/ /thig le'i gzugs kyi yid kyi dngos/ /snying gi dbus su rtag gnas shing / /'od zer ldan zhing gzi brjid che/ /bcu gnyis mtha' dang dgu yi mthar/ /rkang mthil mgo bo med par ni/ /thag pa gcig ni rnam phyung nas/ /lte ba'i dbus su rnam par gnas/ /cha ni lnga pa tsam nyid ni/ /klu dbang dbyings su rgyas pa la/ /de yi cha yang phye nas ni/ /rdo rje'i dbus su rnam phyung ste/ /skye gnas dbus su sa bon gnas/ /chos dbyings khu bar byas nas ni/ /sgo ni dgu po thams cad du/ /de ni rim pas 'pho bar 'gyur/ /de bzhin me ni tshangs pa'i dngos/ /sa yi sa bon gnyis kyis ni/ /mig la de nyid sbyar bar bya/ /rlung gi stong sogs sa bon gyi/

/sems kyis sna dang rna ba sogs/ /bdud rtsi chu yi sa bon lce/ /dbang por gtso bo dbang phyug nyid/ /mgrin par gti mug sa bon te/ /lag par nyon mongs de bzhin no/ /g.yo ba snying gi gnas rnams su/ /phyugs bdag lte ba'i rtsa bar ni/ /yan lag brgyad kyi sa bon gyis/ /yan lag brgyad kyi cho gas 'dzin/ /brtan sogs g.yo bar bcas pa yi/ /'gro kun khyab par byed pas khyab/ /tshangs sogs lha dang lha min rnams/ /de yi gdan du gyur pa yin/ /gang la gtso bo spyod gyur pa'i/ /khyim ni bha ga zhes su gsungs/ /ji srid lus la rnam gnas pa/ /de yi las dang las min 'gyur/ /dge dang mi dge gang cung zad/ /byas pa'i las ni thams cad byed/ /rnal 'byor mnyam pa nyid du gsungs/ /rab tu sbyor ba sgom pa yin/ /gang tshe las kyi lus bcom pa/ /de ltar lha ru 'gyur ba yin/ /gang gis brtan dang g.yo khyab pa/ /des ni de tshe rang gis nus/ /nam mkha' lta bur mnyam nyid ni/ /de yi kha dog shes par bya/ /mya ngan 'das gnas dpa' bo ni/ /gos pa med cing dri ma spangs/ /ma dang sring mo nyid dang yang / /bu mo de bzhin mnyen mo dang / /bram ze mo dang rgyal rigs dang / /rje'u mo de bzhin dmangs mo dang / /gar ma tshos ma g.yung mo dang / /de bzhin du ni gdol pa mo/ /thabs dang shes rab cho ga yis/ /de nyid rig pas mchod par bya/ /ji ltar bye bar mi 'gyur bar/ /rab tu 'bad pas bsten par bya/ /ma gsang sbrul dang chom rkun sogs/ /sa la spyod pas sdug bsngal byed/ /rigs kyi dbye bas phyi nas ni/ /phyag rgya rnam pa lngar ni gsungs/ /bram ze skye gnyis rigs skyes ma/ /de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gsungs/ /rgyal rigs ma ni rgyal po'i rus/ /rma bya zla sogs rigs las skyes/ /rdo rje bdud rtsi zhes byar grags/ /rje'u mo bal glang skyong ba ste/ /las kyi rigs las skyes par gsungs/ /dmangs mo yang ni bran mo ste/

/rnam par snang mdzad chen por gsungs/ /gar ma padma'i rigs nyid de/ /tshos ma de bzhin las kyi rigs/ /g.yung mo rdo rje'i rigs su bshad/ /rin chen gdol pa mor shes bya/ /phyag rgya lngar ni rnam par nges/ /'di rnams de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs/ /mdor bsdus pas ni brjod par bya/ /dpal ldan de bzhin nyid gshegs shing / /de bzhin slar yang gshegs pa nyid/ /'dis ni shes rab rigs pas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs par mngon par brjod/ /rigs ni rnam pa lnga ru gsungs/ /rigs ni brgya dang mtha' yas dang / /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /phyi nas rnam pa gsum du 'gyur/ /rigs dang 'byung ba lnga rnams dang / /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /rdo rje rin chen pad nor bu/ /'dzin pa'i rim pa'i rigs rnams so/ /sgom pa po med bsgom bya med/ /sngags med lha yang yod ma yin/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /sngags dang lhar ni yang dag gnas/ /rnam snang mi bskyod don yod dang / /rin chen dpag med sems dpa' 'o/ /tshangs pa khyab 'jug zhi ba dang / /thams cad sangs rgyas de nyid brjod/ /tshangs pa sgrib bral sangs rgyas nyid/ /'jug phyir khyab 'jug brjod par bya/ /zhi ba rtag tu dge ba ste/ /thams cad kun gyi bdag nyid gnas/ /dam pa'i bde bas de nyid de/ /dga' ba rtogs phyir rnam sangs rgyas/ /gang phyir lus las byung ba'i phyir/ /lha zhes mngon par brjod par bya/ /'di la bha ga mnga' ba'i phyir/ /bcom ldan 'das zhes brjod par bya/ /bha ga rnam pa drug tu brjod/ /dbang phyug la sogs yon tan kun/ /yang na nyon mongs la sogs pa/ /'joms pa'i phyir na bcom ldan 'das/ /gang phyir skye 'gro bskyed pa'i phyir/ /shes rab ma zhes brjod par bya/ /gang phyir skal ba ston pa'i phyir/ /shes rab de nyid sring mo nyid/ /shes rab tshos mar brjod pa ni/ /sems can thams cad 'tshed pa'i phyir/ /btso blag ma zhes de bzhin brjod/

/yon tan 'jo bar gsungs pa'i phyir/ /shes rab bu mor brjod par bya/ /snying rje chen pos g.yo ba'i phyir/ /shes rab gar mar brjod par bya/ /gang phyir bcom ldan mi reg pa/ /de phyir g.yung mor brjod par bya/ /ā li kā li rab smras pa/ /brjod pa bzlas par yang dag bshad/ /rkang pa'i rjes ni dkyil 'khor yin/ /nyed phyir dkyil 'khor brjod par bya/ /lag pa sgyur ba phyag rgya yin/ /sor mo nyed pa'ang de bzhin no/ /gang phyir rnam sems bsam gtan ni/ /gang sems de ni bsam gtan no/ /pha las bde ba gang thob pa/ /de yi bde ba rang gis bza'/ /bde ba gang gis 'ching ba 'dir/ /de yi bde ba bsam gtan brjod/ /brjod par bya ba dang rjod par byed pa'i byang chub kyi sems bskyed pa la sogs pa'i bsgom pa'i de kho na'i rab tu byed pa ste dang po'o// //de nas byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun brjod par bya'o/ /nang gi lus dang / phyi'i lus dang / phyi nang gnyis ka'i lus la lus kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas pa'i phyir yang dag par rab tu shes te/ ma rig pa la sogs pas yid gnyis su gyur pa'i 'dul ba'i 'jig rten la dran pa dang ldan pa'o/ /nang gi tshor ba dang / phyi'i tshor ba dang / phyi nang gnyis ka'i tshor ba la tshor ba'i rjes su lta zhing gnas pa'i phyir yang dag par rab tu shes te/ ma rig pa la sogs pas yid gnyis su gyur pa'i 'dul ba'i 'jig rten la dran pa dang ldan pa'o/ /nang gi chos rnams dang / phyi'i chos rnams dang / phyi'i nang gnyis ka'i chos rnams la chos kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas pa'i phyir yang dag par rab tu shes te/ ma rig pa la sogs pas yid gnyis su gyur pa'i 'dul ba'i 'jig rten la dran pa dang ldan pa'o/ /nang gi sems dang / phyi'i sems dang / phyi nang gnyis ka'i sems la sems kyi rjes su lta zhing gnas pa'i phyir yang dag par rab tu shes te/ ma rig pa la sogs pas yid gnyis su gyur pa'i 'dul ba'i 'jig rten la dran pa dang ldan pa'o/

/'di rnams ni dran pa nyer bar gzhag pa bzhi'o/ /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyed do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'jog go /smon yang dag par 'debs so/ /sdig pa mi dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams spang ba'i phyir 'dun pa skyed do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'jog go /smon lam yang dag par 'debs so/ /dge ba'i chos ma skyes pa rnams bskyed pa'i phyir 'dun pa skyed do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'jog go /smon lam yang dag par 'debs so/ de ltar dge ba'i chos skyes pa rnams gnas par bya ba'i phyir thabs tshad med pa bsgoms pas yongs su gang ba'i phyir yongs su gang bar gyur pas bsgom pa dam pa 'phel bar bya ba'i phyir 'dun pa skyed do/ /'bad do/ /brtson 'grus rtsom mo/ /sems rab tu 'jog go /smon lam yang dag par 'debs so/ /'di rnams ni yang dag par spos ba bzhi'o/ /'dun pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom par bya ste/ bye brag phyed pas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / rnam par byang bar gyur pas bdag gi 'dun pa nub par 'gyur zhing shin tu rab tu 'jog pa ma yin pa'o/ /brtson 'grus kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom par bya ste/ bye brag phyed pas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / rnam par byang bar gyur pas bdag gi brtson 'grus nub par 'gyur zhing shin tu rab tu 'jog pa ma yin pa'o/ /dpyod pa'i ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom par bya ste/ bye brag phyed pas nges par 'byung ba dang /

'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / /rnam par byang bar gyur pas bdag gi dpyod pa nub par 'gyur zhing shin tu rab tu 'jog pa ma yin pa'o/ /sems kyi ting nge 'dzin spong ba'i 'du byed dang ldan pa'i rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bsgom par bya ste/ bye brag phyed pas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / rnam par byang bas bdag gi sems nub par 'gyur zhing shin tu rab tu 'jog pa ma yin pa'o/ /'di rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi ste/ 'dod pa spyod pa dang bcas pa'o/ /'jig rten pa'i yang dag pa'i lta ba la dad par byed de/ rang gi las kyi rnam par smin pa la so sor yid ches par gyur pa gang zhig de ltar las byed par 'gyur ba dge ba'am sdig pa de dang de'i las kyi rnam par smin pa so sor nyams su myong bar 'gyur ba'i phyir de ni 'tsho ba'i rgyur yang sdig pa'i las mngon par 'du mi byed pa'o/ /'di ni dad pa'i dbang por gsungs so/ /gang zhig chos rnams la dad pa'i dbang pos dad par byed pa'i chos rnams la brtson 'grus kyi dbang pos shes par byed do/ /'di ni brtson 'grus kyi dbang por gsungs so/ /gang zhig chos rnams la brtson 'grus kyi dbang pos shes pa de'i chos rnams ni dran pa'i dbang pos rab tu 'jog par mi byed pa'o/ /'di ni dran pa'i dbang por gsungs so/ /gang zhig chos rnams la dran pa'i dbang pos rab tu 'jig par mi byed pa de'i chos rnams ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang pos rtse gcig tu byed pa'o/ /'di ni ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang por gsungs so/ /gang zhig chos rnams la ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang pos rtse gcig tu byed pa de'i chos rnams ni shes rab kyi dbang pos so sor rig pa ste/ de ni chos de dang de rnams la so sor rtog pa skye bar 'gyur ro/

/'di ni shes rab kyi dbang por gsungs so/ /dbang po lnga po 'di rnams 'phel ba ni stobs lnga ru 'gyur te/ dad pa'i stobs dang / brtson 'grus kyi stobs dang / dran pa'i stobs dang / ting nge 'dzin gyi stobs dang / shes rab kyi stobs te/ 'di rnams ni stobs lnga'o/ de la byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gang zhe na/ 'di ltar ste/ dran pa yang dag pa byang chub kyi yan lag dang / chos rab tu rnam par 'byed pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / brtson 'grus yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / dga' ba yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / shin tu sbyangs pa yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag dang / ting nge 'dzin yang dag byang chub kyi yag lag dang / btang snyoms yang dag byang chub kyi yan lag ste/ bye brag phyed pas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'dod chags dang bral bas nges par 'byung ba dang / 'gog pas nges par 'byung ba dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa dang bral ba'i kun nas rnam par byang bar gyur pa dang / chos rab tu 'byed pa ni byang chub kyi yan lag bdun la sogs pa bsgom pa'o/ /de la 'phags pa'i yan lag brgyad pa gang zhe na/ yang dag pa'i lta ba ni gang zhig 'jig rten las 'das pa ste/ bdag tu lta bas kun nas bslang pa ma yin pa dang / sems cad med pa dang / 'tsho ba med pa dang / gso ba med pa dang / skyes bu med pa dang / gang zag med pa dang / shed las skyes med pa dang / shed bu med pa dang / byed pa po med pa dang / tshor ba po med pa'i lta bas kun nas bslang ba chad pa ma yin pa dang / rtag par lta pas kun nas bslang ba ma yin pa dang / srid pa dang bral ba'i lta bas kun nas bslang ba dang / rigs su lung bstan pa'i lta bas kun nas bslang ba dang / ji srid 'khor ba ma yin zhing mya ngan las 'das pa'i yang ma yin pa'i lta bas kun nas bslang ba ste/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i lta bar gsungs so/ gang zhig yang dag pa'i rtog pa ni 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /

gti mug dang / nyon mongs pas kun nas bslang ba'i rtog pa de ni yang dag pa'i rtog par mi 'gyur ro/ /yang dag pa'i rtog pa gang zhig tshul khrims dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / shes rab dang / rnam par grol ba dang / rnam par grol ba'i ye shes mthong ba'i phung pos kun nas slong ba de'i yang dag pa'i rtog pa de ni yang dag pa'i rtog par 'gyur te/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i rtog par gsungs so/ gang zhig tshig gis bdag la gdung bar mi bya zhing gzhan la gdung bar mi bya ba dang / bdag la nyon mongs par mi bya zhing gzhan dag la nyon mongs par mi bya ba dang / bdag la mi dpya zhing gzhan dag la yang dpya bar mi bya ba ste/ de mnyam par gzhag pa dang ldan pas tshig dang ldan par 'gyur zhing / gang gi tshig gis yang dag pa'i 'phags par 'jug par 'gyur ba 'di ni yang dag pa'i ngag ces gsungs so/ /gang zhig las nag po dang nag po'i rnam par smin pa de'i las mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang / gang zhig las dkar ba dang / dkar po'i rnam par smin pa de'i las mngon par 'du byed pa dang / gang zhig las dkar po dang / nag po'i rnam par smin pa de'i las mngon par 'du mi byed pa dang / gang zhig las dkar po dang / nag po dang / dkar po'i rnam par smin pa dang / nag po zad pa'i bsam pas gnas pa de'i las mngon par 'du byed de/ dam pa'i las lta bur 'gyur ba ni yang dag pa'i las kyi mtha' ste/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i las kyi mthar gsungs so/ /gang gi tshe 'phags pa lta bur dul ba dang / yon tan yang dag pa'i chas zhum zhing dul ba dang / kha gsag med pa dang / mang du smra ba ma yin pa dang / gtam la mi dga' ba dang / rang gi spyod pa'i tshul khrims dang / 'jig rten pha rol gyi dbang phyug dang ldan pa dang / bdag gi rnyed pa kha na ma tho ba med pas bdag chog par 'dzin pa dang / 'phags pa'i bka'i gnang bas 'tsho ba ste/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i 'tsho bar gsungs so/ /rtsol ba ni gang zhig brdzun dang /

'phags pas ma gnang ba dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug dang / nyon mongs pa rjes su bsten par mi 'dod pa ni rtsol ba ste/ rtsol ba gang zhig yang dag pa'i 'phags pa'i lam gyi bden par 'jug cing mya ngan las 'das par 'gro ba dang / so so'i gnas su skyed par byed pa de ni rtsol bar yang dag par rjes su 'brang ba ste/ 'di ni yang dag pa'i rtsol bar gsungs so/ gang la nye bar gnas pa de ni rab tu mi g.yo ba dang / lus drang pos kyog po ma yin pa dang / 'khor ba'i skyon sna tshogs la sogs pa dbang du byed pa ston cing / mya ngan las 'das pa'i gnas 'dod pa'i dran pa ni mi brjed pa ste/ 'di ni 'phags pa'i yang dag pa'i lam la sbyor ba'o/ /'di ni yang dag pa'i dran par gsungs so/ /yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin ni ting nge 'dzin gang la gnas nas sems can thams cad rnam par thar bar bya ba'i phyir yang dag par gnas te/ mya ngan las 'das pa mnan pa'o/ /'dis ni yang dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin zhes gsungs so/ /de nyid yang dag bshad pa ni/ /dga' ba la sogs sa rnams te/ /dbang po la sogs rang bzhin gyi/ /byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi gnas/ /phung po la sogs khyad par gyi/ /sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ni gnas/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni mchog tu 'bab/ /byang sems sum cu rtsa gnyis kyis/ /gang tshe 'dir ni gang gyur pa/ /dpang po phung po 'byung ba yi/ /sangs rgyas de yi de ma thag /rang lus nyid la sangs rgyas nyid/ /gzhan ni gang du'ang mi gnas so/ /lus las gzhan du sangs rgyas nyid/ /mi shes pa yis bsgribs par brjod/ /ye shes chen po rang lus gnas/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /dngos po kun la khyab pa po/ /lus gnas lus la ma skyes pa'o/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ lus la rtsa du lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ 'khor lo bzhi yi rab dbye bas/ /brgya phrag gcig dang nyi shu lhag

/byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /rtsa rnams sum cu rtsa gnyis mchog /gsungs pa/ 'di ltar ste/ mi phyed ma zhes brjod pa dang / phra gzugs ma dang / rtse ba ma dang / g.yon pa ma dang / thung ngu ma dang / rus sbal skyes ma dang / sgom pa ma dang / dbang ma dang / skyon pa dang / 'jug ma dang / ma mo dang / mtshan mo dang / bsil sbyin ma dang / tsha ba ma dang / brkyang ma dang / ro ma dang / kun 'dar ma dang / 'bab ma dang / rangs ma dang / mdog ma dang / gzugs can ma dang / spyi ma dang / rgyu sbyin ma dang / sbyor bral ma dang / sdug gu ma dang / grub ma dang / 'tshed ma dang / de bzhin du yid bzang ma dang / sum skor ma dang / 'dod ma dang / khyim ma dang / gtum mo dang / bdud 'bral ma'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rtsa 'di dag ji lta bu lags/ srid gsum yongs su gyur pa ste/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa thams cad yongs su spangs pa'o/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i mthar thug pa la sogs pa'i rnam par 'grel ba byang chub kyi sems 'jug pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /gsang ba'i ye shes bla med pa/ /snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsol ba btab par mkhyen nas/ rgyud thams cad kyi snying po ye shes mar me rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ rgyud thams cad kyi gsang ba 'di bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /sangs rgyas kun dngos sems dpa' ni/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba'i mchog /'di ni bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /brtan pa rtag pa mchog tu yang /

/yid srub so sor skyes pa nyid/ /rtag tu rang bzhin mnan dka' ba/ /sna tshogs las kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /sna tshogs cho ga 'dod pa yi/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje 'dzin sogs rnams/ /sems can rnams ni 'dul bar brjod/ /sangs rgyas kun sogs brtan dang g.yo/ /thams cad dngos po srid pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba sdom/ /'dis ni sgyu ma'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /thams cad las ni sna tshogs mchog /sangs rgyas sogs pas 'dul ba'i phyir/ /dngos grub sems can kun don mchog /rang gi ngo bos yongs bsgyur bas/ /bun med sgyu ma thams cad 'grub/ /sna tshogs sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes kla klo'i skad/ /ḍai bai hā ya sar 'gro bar/ /skad dbyings 'di ni rnam par brtag /nam mkha' kun tu spyod 'grub pas/ /mkha' 'gro ma zhes rab tu grags/ /kun nas sna tshogs phyag rgya ste/ /kun las sna tshogs sdom pa 'o/ /rdo rje rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /padma de bzhin padma 'dzin/ /nor bu nor bu 'dzin pa nyid/ /'di rnams kyi ni rigs rnams yin/ /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad zil gyis gnon pa rdul dang bral ba'i gnas zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te/ byang chub kyi sems 'di bka' stsal pa/ stong min stong pa min pa'ang min/ /dbu mar dmigs pa mi 'gyur te/ /shes rab pha rol phyin sbyor ba/ /thabs ni snying rje'i bdag nyid de/ /de nas mdzes pa'i snying rje thabs/ /shes rab pha rol phyin gsal ba/ /rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams la/ /dngos po med cing sgom pa'ang med/ /rnam rtog med pas rtag mos pas/ /brtag pa kun gyis brtag par bya/ /rnam rtog med pa'i chos rnams la/ /sems can don ni yongs su brtag /de bzhin gshegs pa kun bdag chos/ /chos can med cing chos nyid med/ /sgra brnyan lta bur mnyam pa nyid/ /de nas 'di ni chos ngag 'byung /

/de nas theg pa chen po las byung ba'i bsgom pas yon tan rgyas pa rnams kyis dus gsum gyi de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bstod pa'i rgyal po 'dis yang dag par bstod pa/ rnal 'byor gyi bdag po sems can grol bar mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /sems can bdag nyid skyes pa gcig par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i gti mug gcod par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal lo/ /de kho na nyid thams cad kyi ye shes gcig tu ston par mdzad pa la bstod cing phyag 'tshal te/ bdag rtag tu phyag 'tshal lo/ /yang mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /chos rnams thams cad gcig pa'i sku'i/ /snying po bcom ldan bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ /dbang po gang dang gang lam nyid/ /de dang de yi rang bzhin 'gyur/ /mnyam par ma bzhag rnal 'byor gyis/ /rtag par shin tu mnyam gzhag nyid/ /gang phyir thams cad bdag nyid kyi/ /rnam shes phung por gnas pa ni/ /skyes bu tha mal sems rmongs pa/ /la las so sor rtogs mi nus/ /sems dang sems byung sems kyi dngos/ /ye shes shes bya rang bzhin can/ /'bras bu rnams la byed pa nyid/ /chos dang chos can sgom pa nyid/ /gang phyir chos ni du mas ni/ /chu bo'i rgyun ni rgya mtsho ltar/ /thar pa nyid ni gcig pu yin/ /mang po dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar nang du rnam gnas pa/ /bla ma'i zhal las rnyed par 'gyur/ /de kho na nyid mdor bstan pa ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //de nas rgyud rnams thams cad du/ /gtan la phab pa rab bshad bya/ /sems can kun la mnyam pa'i phyir/ /gru gsum rgya che'i gzugs can nyid/ /tshangs sogs lha dang lha min bcas/ /de rnams kyi ni gnas su 'gyur/ /de nyid shes rab pha rol phyin/ /kun rdzob rnam pa'i gzugs can ma/ /de nyid yul las rnam par 'das/ /srog chags kun gyi snying la gnas/

/de phyir de rgyas ci zhig bya/ /mdor bsdus pas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bskal pa bye ba grangs med pas/ /ji ltar sangs rgyas gang thob pa/ /gang gis dam pa'i bde bas khyod/ /skye ba 'dir ni thob par 'gyur/ /yang na rdo rje 'dzin pa nyid/ /yang na 'khor los bsgyur ba 'am/ 'dis ni dngos grub chen po brgyad/ /gzhan yang yid la 'dod pa yang / /gti mug chags dang nga rgyal dang / /phrag dog dang ni nyon mongs lngas/ /sems can so sor bcings pa gang / /rang gi yan lag nyid kyis 'joms/ /'dis ni 'gro drug sems can bcings/ /'khor bar 'khor zhing skye ba nyid/ /nyon mongs pas ni rmongs gyur pas/ /sdig pa du ma byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir 'di bcom cang mkhyen nyid/ /sangs rgyas kyis sprul rigs pas ni/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung ba yi/ /sbyor bral sdug bsngal mthong nas ni/ /thabs dang shes rab sprul pa'i rgyus/ /nyon mongs rnams ni yid ches 'gyur/ /mtshon pa 'di ni 'bras bur gyur/ /khams gsum du ni dri med snang / /gang dang gang gis gnas gyur pa/ /de ni de yi ngo bo can/ /bud shing bsregs pa'i rigs pas ni/ /dgyes pa'i rgyal ba gar mkhan mchog /phung po khams dang skye mched rnams/ /'di nyid rnam dag mtshon pa 'di/ /ji ltar dgra bo nus pa la/ /dgra bo nus pas de bsnun pa/ /gti mug dag pas gti mug ste/ /zhe sdang dag pas zhe sdang nyid/ /'dod chags dag pas 'dod chags te/ /nga rgyal rnam dag nga rgyal che/ /phrag dog dag pas phrag dog nyid/ /thams cad rnam dag rdor 'dzin mgon/ /de yi ngo bo rnam dag pa/ /nyon mongs lnga ni mnyam par 'gyur/ /de ltar rigs ni lnga rnams dang / /ye shes lnga dang sangs rgyas lnga/ /'di las rdo rje snying po dang / /khro bo khams gsum sems can skye/ /nang gi dbye ba 'di nyid ni/ /bla ma'i zhal las rnyed par 'gyur/ /bla ma dman pa'i sems can rnams/ /sngags dang phyag rgya rnyed mi 'gyur/

/gang zhig shin tu gsal bas ni/ /'dzam gling de 'dir sangs rgyas bsngags/ /gru gsum dag pa e yi dbyibs/ /dbus su dgyes pa'i e waṃ yin/ /gru gsum dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar/ /rdo rje ra li rnam par byung / /btsun mo'i bha ga zhes kyang bya/ /chos kyi 'byung gnas zhes byar bshad/ /de yi nang song padma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa snying por bcas/ /de la ā li kā li 'dres/ /sde tshan brgyad ni rnam par gnas/ /sngags kyi gzugs kyis lus can gyi/ /las kyi tshogs ni byed par 'gyur/ /yi ge rnams ni lnga bcu nyid/ /rig byed rnams la nye bar gnas/ /sngags rnams nyid dang rgyud rnams dang / /phyi rol tshul gyi bstan bcos kyi/ /rdo rje snying po'i rang bzhin 'di/ /gzhan du 'di la cung zad med/ /a ka tsa ṭa ta pa ya sha/ /sde tshan dga' ba lnga bcu yang / /mnyam pa dag tu sprul pa rnams/ /rdo rje ra li padmar son/ /'dab ma brgyad po phyogs rnams dang / /mtshams rnams su ni 'di rnams rigs/ /de rnams dbus su ze 'bru la/ /dam pa'i dbang phyug ma yod do/ /sde tshan brgyad po rnams kyis ni/ /yi ge dam pa yongs su bskor/ /a ni yig 'bru kun gyi mchog /don chen sde tshan gtso bo ni/ /lus can rnams kyi sngags kun ni/ /'di nyid las ni yang dag byung / /gang zhig ral gri mig sman dang / /rkang byug ril bu rkang 'og dang / /gnod sbyin mo yi yan lag ma/ /'jig rten gsum gyi khongs su rgyu/ /dngul chu'i 'gro bas rjes su 'brang / /gang zhig thams cad mthu che ba/ /rang gi khyim du lnga bcu 'dod pa dang ldan par 'grub bo/ /de ni sde tshan brgyad nang son/ /dbyangs mchog sde tshan bdag nyid 'byin/ /skye bo rnams kyi tshig rgyas pa/ /gang zhig cung zad rtogs bya ba/ /de kun sngags kyi gzugs kyis ni/ /de phyir rab tu skye bar 'gyur/ /lus can rnams ni thams cad kyi/ /sgra ni sngags zhes brjod par bya/

/sna tshogs mdud pa'i gnas chen las/ /chos kyi ra li rnam par 'byung / /dngos grub rdzu 'phrul rnam gnas pa'i/ /sngags dang nges pa gang yang med/ /rang bzhin gyis ni ma skyes pa'i/ /sngags kyi yig 'bru dbang phyug mchog /yang dag sbyor byung mtshan nyid ni/ /de nas mchog tu rab bshad bya/ /e ni sa ru shes par bya/ /las kyi phyag rgya spyan ma nyid/ /snying rje chen mo thabs chen mo/ /rang bzhin sna tshogs spyod yul ma/ /lte bar sna tshogs 'dam skyes la/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lor rnam par gnas/ /waṃ ni chu ru shes par bya/ /chos kyi phyag rgya mā ma kī/ /byams pa dang ni smon lam tshul/ /lha mo rdo rje'i rigs gtso ma/ /snying gar chu skyes 'dab brgyad la/ /chos kyi 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /ma ni me ru brjod pa ste/ /phyag rgya chen mo gos dkar mo/ /dga' dang stobs kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /lha mo padma'i rigs byung ma/ /lkog ma chu skyes 'dab brgyad gnyis/ /longs spyod 'khor lor yang dag gnas/ /ya ni rlung gi rang bzhin te/ /nyon mongs thams cad rab 'joms byed/ /dam tshig phyag rgya chen mor nges/ /lha mo las kyi rigs gtso ma/ /btang snyoms ye shes rnal 'byor gyis/ /sgrol ma 'khor ba sgrol ba mo/ /'dam skyes 'dab ma sum cu gnyis/ /bde chen 'khor lo chen por gnas/ /e ni shes rab brjod par bya/ /waṃ ni thabs dang ldan pa nyid/ /waṃ gyis rnam par brgyan pa nyid/ /e ni nges par mdzes par 'gyur/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin gyis/ /steng dang 'og tu snyoms par 'jug /e nyid dang ni waṃ nyid dag /gnyis gnyis su ni brjod pa nyid/ /'di skad ces bya ba'i tshig gi phrad ni de skad ces gsungs nas zhes bya ba'i mthar thug pa'i rgyud kyi tshogs la bsnyegs so zhes brjod do/ /bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba ni de skad du 'dod chags chen po 'di la rtag tu gnas pa'o/ /shru zhes bya ba ni 'dzag par gsungs so/

/ta zhes bya ba ni gang yang bde ba chen po'i mgon po'o/ /bdag gis thos pa zhes bya ba ni bdag nyid kyi thos pa'i phyir rna ba'i ye shes kyis thos pa yin gyi/ rtogs pa ni ma yin no/ /bcom ldan 'das mi rtogs pa'i skyon gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ sdud par byed pa dang 'chad pa po dag dbyer med par 'gyur ro/ /yang na rtogs pa nyid ni gdul bya'i skye bo'i dbang du byas nas 'chad pa po nyid sdud par byed pa yin te/ 'chad pa po nga chos kyang nga / /rang gi tshogs ldan nyan pa nga / /de dag ji ltar 'tshal bar bgyi/ /gang du bde ba chen po'i mgon po gar mdzad pa'i tshe/ gcig nyid gcig dang du ma'i ro zhes bya ba'i tshig gis rol par mdzad pa'o/ /rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das kyis gang cung zad gsungs pa de bdag gis gcig na zhes bya ba ni dus gcig nyid la'o/ /gcig na zhes bya ba ni skad cig nyid la'o/ /thos pa zhes bya ba ni lhag par son pa ste/ 'dis bsam gyis mi khyab pa la lhag par mos pa'i ting nge 'dzin rnyed do zhes bya bar bsnyegs so/ /dus zhes bya ba ni dus tshod ces gsungs so/ /dus ni rnam pa gsum du brjod/ /bde ba'i dus dang sdug bsngal dus/ /bsam gyis mi khyab dus nyid do/ /'o ma'i rgyun ltar sna bug tu/ /'ong ba bde ba'i dus su gsungs/ /me yi gzugs kyis 'gro ba nyid/ /sdug bsngal dus dang de gcig grags/ /gcig ni lhan gcig med pa yin/ /dus ni bsam gyis mi khyab 'gyur/ /'dod chags med cing chags bral med/ /dbu mar dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /de la 'dod chags nus mtshan nyid/ /'dod chags bral ba 'gog par gsungs/ /'di bral dbu mar mi rtog pas/ /'di gsum dmigs par mi 'gyur ro/ /'dod chags nyid dang chags bral nyid/ /'dres par gyur pa rnyog pa med/ /de bzhin 'dod chags chags bral las/ /ro mnyam gcig pu'i skad cig ma/ /dngos po kun gyi ro mnyam pa/

/bsgom pa'i dus ni gcig tu gsungs/ /'di ltar ste/ dbang phyug dang / gzugs dang / grags pa dang / dpal dang / ye shes dang / brtson 'grus phun sum tshogs pa ste/ bha ga drug ces gsungs so/ /de 'di la mnga' ba'i phyir bcom ldan 'das so/ yang na gang zhig mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyi chos de rnams bcom pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs rnams dang / de rnams nyid kyi snying po dang / de nyid kyi rdo rje dang / de nyid kyi btsun mo dang / de'i bha ga de la bzhugs so/ /kye bcom ldan 'das bzhugs so zhes bya bas ci gsungs pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ro gcig pa thabs sna tshogs kyis 'dul ba'i skye bo'i yid 'phrog pa dang ldan pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi snying po rdo rje'i rang bzhin gang gi chos kyi 'byung gnas la/ gang gi tshe bcom ldan 'das bzhugs pa de'i tshe bdag gis thos pa'o/ /'di ltar ste/ shes rab gang gis nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa 'joms pa de'i phyir shes rab bha gar gsungs te/ bha ga der de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang btsun mo lhan cig tu bzhugs so/ /e ma sangs rgyas thams cad kyi/ /kun mkhyen ye shes bla na med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i bde don gang / /btsun mo nye bar mdzad pa 'o/ /rigs kyi bu 'di skad bdag gi thos pa zhes bya ba'i yig 'bru ni/ chos kyi thog mar rtag tu yang dag par gnas pa ste/ dag pa dang yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dngos grub skyed par byed pa'o/ /lag na rdo rjes ma bshad pa de ngas khyod la bshad do/ /tshig 'bru 'di rnams kyis sems can rnams 'khor ba las pha rol tu shin tu ring bar 'gro ba mngon du mtshon par mdzad pa dang / mngon du ma mdzad pa de nub pa'i sems kyis skye ba 'dir sangs rgyas nyid dam/

rdo rje sems dpa' 'thob par 'gyur te/ gang dag bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas ma thob pa de ni bde bar gshegs pa ste sangs rgyas yin no/ /mtshan gzhi mtshon par byed pa ni sems dpar yang dag bar gsungs te/ sdang bas bstan pa tsam gyis mnar med par rab tu ltung bar 'gyur bas na/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa can gyi sems kyi ro spang bar bya'o/ /kun nas nyon mongs pa can gyis srid pa'i 'jigs pa las 'das pa'i sgrub pa po dpal ldan dang ldan pas dag pa'i sems sgom par byed de/ thabs dang shes rab kyi sbyor ba 'dis ji ltar yang dag par thob pa dag pa'i yang dag par rig pa'i bdag nyid can gyi mtshan gzhi thabs dang shes rab kyi nus pas nam mkha' dang mnyam zhing gnas gsum du snang ba ste/ de'i mtshan gzhi ni mtshon par dka' ba dang / /thams cad du son zhing rgyu dang rkyen spangs bas yid bzhin gyi nor bu lta bur 'jig rten gyi rang dang gzhan gyi don byed de dngos grub thams cad kyi mchog go /rgyud thams cad kyi gling gzhi gsang ba dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po ste dang po rdzogs so// //de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /sgrub pa po la phan don du/ /gang gis slob ma dbang bskur ba'i/ /cho ga yang ni bshad par bya/ /dang por lha yi bdag nyid kyi/ /rnal 'byor pas ni nor 'dzin sbyang / /'bad pas hūm̐ las rdo rje can/ /byas te phyi nas dkyil 'khor bri/ /tshal dang skye bo med gnas dang / /byang chub sems dpa'i khyim dang yang / /khang stong dag ni khyim nang du/ /dkyil 'khor dam pa bzhengs par bya/ /rdul tshon dam pa nyid dang ni/ /yang na 'bring po nyid kyis te/ /rin chen lnga yi bdag nyid phyes/ /yang na 'bras la sogs pas bri/ /dkyil 'khor khru gsum bya ba dang / /mthe bong gsum ni lhag par bya/ /der ni rigs lnga las byung ba'i/ /rig ma bzang po gzhug par bya/ /sngags kyi lam gyi rjes btsal bas/

/gang tshe mkhas pas dbang bskur ba/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi mngon sum du/ /dkyil 'khor bde bar gshegs gnas su/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas bdag /blo dang ldan pas de bzhin blang / /rang byin brlab pa'i gnas thob pas/ /dam tshig nyams pas 'jigs pa yis/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi don dam las/ /sngags kyi lam ni de bzhin gsungs/ /rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs lha'i/ /dam tshig rim pa shin tu ring / /de phyir don kun la 'bad pas/ /dbang don rgyal ba'i bdag nyid skyes/ /rdo rje slob dpon yon tan mtsho/ /ji bzhin sbyor bas gsol ba gdab/ /yang na ma dang sring bu mo/ /bu sring mo yi bu mo nyid/ /'di nang gang de ji lta bar/ /rnyed nas bsgrub pa nyid du gyis/ /yang na mngon du 'di med na/ /kun mkhyen gyis bsngags rigs ma ni/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis khyab mdzad pa/ /de ni de phyir gzung bar bya/ /skye ba gnyis kyi bu mo dang / /yang na btso blag ma dang / yang na gdol pa mo dang / g.yung mo dang / rigs las skyes ma dang / yang na rgyal mo dang / gar mkhan gyi bu mo dang / bzo mo dang / yang na ri dwags kyi mig ma dang / rked pa phra ba dang / ro smad rgyas pa dang / nu ma mtho ba dang / bha ga bzang ba dang / dam tshig gi spyod pa la shin tu dam pa dang / de kho na la gnas pa dang / sngags dang rgyud shes pa ste/ sgrub pa po'idabang po la gnas gsum du che ba'i bu mo 'di dag bshad do/ /rigs kyi rim pa nyid kyis 'di rnams kyis thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /ma rnyed ji ltar gang rnyed de/ /de bzhin bcu drug lon pa nyid/ /dang po'i lang tsho phun sum tshogs/ /mig mdzes phyag rgya rnyed nas ni/ /rig ma de nyid blangs nas ni/ /skyabs su 'gro ba'i rim pas ni/ /sbyangs nas de nyid gsang ba dang / /sngags dang rgyud kyi rim kun bsgrags/ /sgra 'am 'og gi lam du lces/ /de nyid de bzhin steng du gzhug /kun gyi cha rigs sna tshogs byed/

/rim pa nyid kyis rna cha dang / /ska rags che dang se mo do/ /lag gdub dang ni rkang gdub ldan/ /de ltar dngos grub dam pa ster/ /gang zhig sbyangs pa'i rig ma kun/ /nye bar 'tshe ba med gnas su/ /rig pa 'dzin pa 'khor mang po/ /de nas tsan dan gos phreng sogs/ /rnam par brgyan nas dbul bar bya/ /dri dang phreng sogs rim gro yi/ /'o ma'i mchog sogs rgyas pas ni/ /phyag rgya thabs cig sgrub pa pos/ /gus par 'bad pas yang dag mchod/ /slob mas pus mo'i lha nga ni/ /sa la dad pas btsugs nas ni/ /thal mo sbyar nas bstod pa 'dis/ /ston pa la ni zhu ba bya/ /stong pa'i snying po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rtog pa thams cad yang dag spangs/ /thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes tshogs/ /ye shes sku la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /'gro ba'i mi shes gcod pa can/ /dag pa'i de nyid don ston mdzad/ /bdag med chos las byung ba yi/ /rdo rje sems dpa' phyag 'tshal bstod/ /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems/ /pha rol phyin pa'i yon tan rnams/ /mgon po las ni rtag tu byung / /byang chub sems la phyag 'tshal bstod/ /dkon mchog gsum dang theg chen dang / /de bzhin bstan dang 'gro ba dang / /khams gsum po ni 'di dag kun/ /'gro ba'i dpa' bo phyag 'tshal bstod/ /yid bzhin nor bu ltar gyur pa'i/ /'gro ba'i 'dod pa'i don grub phyir/ /dpal ldan bde gshegs bka' bzhin mdzad/ /sangs rgyas sras po phyag 'tshal bstod/ /de nyid bla med bdag 'tshal bas/ /yon tan mtsho khyod bka' drin las/ /kun mkhyen rdo rje dbang gis ni/ /da lta nyid du bka' drin skyobs/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang ba ni/ /ji ltar dpal thugs rdo rje yis/ /rdo rje chos can la gsungs ltar/ /de bzhin mgon pos bdag la skyobs/ /bcom ldan zhabs pad spangs nas ni/ /gzhan du bdag la 'gro ma mchis/ /'khor ba'i 'gro las nges rgyal bar/ /de phyir mgon pos thugs rje mdzod/

/de nas rdo rje slob dpon dpal/ /rjes su brtse bcas phan sems kyis/ /slob la snying rje bskyed nas ni/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dgug pa dang / /'dod yon lnga yis gang ba dang / /bla re bres pas nye bar 'bar/ /rnal 'byor ma dang sbyor ldan zhing / /dril bu sil sil sgra dang ni/ /me tog bdug 'khyil nyams dga' ba/ /lha yi dri phreng bde ba'i mchog /dpal ldan rdo rje sems sogs lha'i/ /dkyil 'khor mchog tu ngo mtshar bar/ /slob dpon skal ba bzang po mchog /de nas phyag rgya sbyor byas nas/ /rgyal ba'i bdag skyes byang chub sems/ /padma'i snod du gzhug par bya/ /rnga yab g.yob cing gdugs dang ni/ /bkra shis tshigs bcad glu rnams kyis/ /phyag rgya ldan pas slob ma de/ /'gro ba'i gtso bos dbang bskur bya/ /slob dpon mchog gi dbang phyug gis/ /dbang ni rin chen mchog byin nas/ /bzang po'i rang bzhin legs sbyangs pa'i/ /dam tshig yid 'ong nges par sbyin/ /khrag chen dang ni ga bur bcas/ /tsan dan dmar po sbyar ba dang / /rigs kyi bdag po'i chu ldan zhing / /lnga pa sems las yang dag byung / /'di rnams dam tshig yang dag par/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyis nye bar gsungs/ /bzang po rtag tu bskyang bar gyis/ /sdom pa yang ni da ltar nyon/ /srog chags gsad par mi bya zhing / /bud med rin chen yongs mi spang / /des na slob dpon spang mi bya/ /sdom pa shin tu 'da' bar dka'/ /gang du gsungs pa'i rig ma 'am/ /yang na bdag gi rnal 'byor ma/ /dag cing sprul pa'i rig ma ni/ /sihla ga bur bsgos pa ni/ /ji srid khu ba ldan gyur pa/ /de srid phyag rgya bsten par bya/ /phyag rgya'i gdong yang bcing ba dang / /thabs kyi gdong yang de bzhin te/ /bstan pas yang dag gang byung ba/ /slob ma'i kha ru ltung bar bya/ /ro mnyam slob ma'i spyod yul nyid/ /de nyid la ni bya bar bshad/ /rang rig ye shes nyid du 'gyur/ /rang gzhan yang dag rig pa spangs/

/mkha' mnyam rdul bral stong pa nyid/ /dngos dang dngos min bdag nyid mchog /thabs dang shes rab rnam par 'dres/ /'dod chags 'dod chags bral bas 'dres/ /de nyid srog chags rnams kyi srog /de nyid yi ge dam pa nyid/ /de nyid 'di ni kun khyab byed/ /de nyid sangs rgyas ye shes can/ /he ru ka dpal zhes byar brjod/ /gzhan rnams gang rnams de rnams dang / /dngos dang dngos med de las byung / /dga' ba dang po dpa' bo ste/ /mchog tu dga' ba rnal 'byor ma/ /shin tu bde dga' thams cad nges/ /de bde thabs las thams cad rig /dang po dga' ba tsam nyid de/ /mchog tu dga' ba gnyis pas grangs/ /gsum pa dga' bral dga' bar bshad/ /bzhi pa lhan cig skyes par brjod/ /de yang dbang ni rnam pa bzhi/ /dang po la ni bum pa'i dbang / /gnyis pa la ni gsang ba'i dbang / /gsum pa shes rab ye shes te/ /bzhi pa de yang de bzhin no/ /byang chub sems kyi dbang gis ni/ /slob ma sdig pa bral ba yin/ /sangs rgyas grong khyer mchog sngon du/ /de ni de la gnang ba sbyin/ /byang chub snying po'i bar du ni/ /phyogs kun tu ni 'khor lo ni/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bla na med/ /kun tu mchog tu rab tu bskor/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin bdag /yid bzhin nor bu ltar mthong nas/ /sbyor med bral zhing ma zhum pas/ /sems can don ni da ltar gyis/ /dbang dang bka' gnang thob nas ni/ /bya ba byas pas rab 'dzum zhing / /'gro ba dga' bar byed pa yi/ /shin tu snyan pa'i tshig 'di brjod/ /deng bdag skye ba 'bras bu bcas/ /bdag gi 'tsho ba 'bras bur bcas/ /de ring sangs rgyas rigs su skye/ /da ni sangs rgyas rigs su 'gyur/ /bskal pa rgya mtshor 'jigs chen por/ /mnar med skye ba yang dag 'khrugs/ /nyon mongs 'dam ni brgal dka' las/ /bdag ni mgon po khyed kyis bsgral/ /khyod kyi zhabs kyi bka' drin las/ /theg pa rdzogs pa lta bur bdag /bag chags thams cad bral bas na/

/bdag la byang chub 'tshal ma mchis/ /rangs shing mig ni phye ba yis/ /zhabs la 'jus nas gus par bya/ /gang dang gang zhig sdug pa'i rdzas/ /re ba med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /de dang de nyid dbul bar bya/ /bla ma'ang snying rje ldan pas ni/ /slob ma bsdu ba'i bsam pa'i phyir/ /de la phan pa'i bsam pas bzung / /de nas phyag 'tshal mchod nas ni/ /bla ma la ni yon rnams dbul/ /gser ni stong phrag brgya dang ni/ /rin chen rnam pa sna tshogs dang / /gos ni zung 'gyur brgya nyid dang / /glang po rta dang yul 'khor nyid/ /rna cha dang ni rkang gdub dang / /nor bu dang ni sor gdub sogs/ /gser las byas pa'i mchod phyir thogs/ /rang gi chung ma bu mo dang / /bran pho bran mo sring mo nyid/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni dbul bar bya/ /bdag gi dngos po thams cad kyis/ /blo dang ldan pas bla mar dbul/ /de ring tshun chad bdag bran du/ /khyod la bdag ni dbul lags zhes/ /de ltar zhu ba byas gyur pas/ /mngon par 'dod pa'i gnas thob nas/ /da ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /bdag la bka' drin legs par skyobs/ /ji ltar bla med byang chub de/ /byin gyis brlabs kyis bdag gis bsgrubs/ /bla na med pa'i byang chub gnas/ /kun mchog mchod pa bskyed par bgyi/ /sems can gnas gsum 'khor ba rnams/ /de nyid la ni gzhag par bgyi/ /dbang chog 'dis sbyin par bya zhing slob ma'i lhag par mos pa dang / zab pa dang rgya ba'i rig pas lhag par mos pa'i yid kyis shes par byas nas tshig nyid kyis dbang rin po che sbyin par bya'o/ /gang thob dbang rab mchog ni rigs kyi bdag por gzung ba rnyed par dka' zhing mtshungs pa med par gdams/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i zhing gi dpal dag blang bar byas pas byang chub sems dpa' chen po'i dbang bskur ba/ /bka' yi gnang ba rnyed nas 'jig rten gsum gyi dgra bo las rgyal rtsom pa'i go bgos pa yi blos/ /byang chub dag la dgod pa'i sangs rgyas 'dir ni de nyid rnal 'byor pas ni dri ma med par spyod/

/byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang gnyis pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //de nas thabs dang shes rab don/ /bsgom ba yang dag rab bshad bya/ /pha rol don brtson brtson 'grus kyi/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i 'jigs pa las/ /bsgral dka' gang zhig rnam bsgoms pas/ /rnal 'byor pas ni rang don du/ /mya ngan 'das par gnas mi 'gyur/ /gang gi khyad 'phags mthar thug par/ /sangs rgyas dri med ngo mtshar rmad/ /'grib dang 'phel las rnam par grol/ /byang chub bla med thob par 'gyur/ /phung po lnga sogs chos rnams dang / /theg gsum shing tu spang mi bya/ /chos dbyings shin tu mnyam pa nyid/ /chu shing lta bur yongs su gzung / /stong pa bsgom par mi bya ste/ /stong min bsgom pa mi bya 'o/ /stong pa mi spang rnal 'byor pas/ /stong min yongs su mi spang ngo / /stong dang stong min gzung ba las/ /rtog pa nyung min skye bar 'gyur/ /yongs su spangs na kun rtog ste/ /de phyir de gnyis yongs su spang / /gnyis kyis gzung ba yongs spangs pa/ /rnam grol gnas dang bral ba ste/ /nga zhes bya ba'i kun rtog 'di/ /de phyir de ni yang dag spang / /rnam pa med cing dogs pa med/ /'dod pa med cing sdig pa bral/ /thog ma tha ma'i rtog las grol/ /nam mkha' lta bur mkhas pas bsgom/ /snying rje ldan pas sems can la/ /rgyab kyis phyogs par mi bya zhing / /sems can yod dang yod min zhes/ /de ltar yongs su brtag mi bya/ /spros pa med pa'i rang bzhin nyid/ /shes rab ces ni rab tu grags/ /yid bzhin nor ltar ma lus pa'i/ /thams cad don byed snying rje nyid/ /dmigs med gnas su shes rab dang / /dmigs med snying rje chen po nyid/ /blo dang lhan cig gcig gyur pa/ /nam mkhar nam mkha' ji ltar ba'o/ /gang la sgom pa po yang med/ /gang yang rnam par sgom pa'ang med/ /bsgom bya nyid kyang yod min pa/ /de yi de nyid sgom par brjod/

/gang yang bya ba yod min 'dir/ /bza' bya nyid kyang yod ma yin/ /byed po bza' las rnam par grol/ /don dam rnam par bsgoms pas na/ /'di la sgrub po gang yang med/ /gang yang stong par byed pa med/ /dor ba cung zad med par brjod/ /blang ba'ang cung zad yod ma yin/ /dri za'i grong khyer lta bu dang / /sgyu ma smig rgyu 'dra ba dang / /'phrog pa zla ba'i grong khyer mtshungs/ /rmi lam rtse ba lta bur blta/ /sgyu ma ji bzhin thams cad du/ /blta ba nyid dang reg par bya/ /'gro ba thams cad gnas pa ni/ gang yang rnyed par mi 'gyur te/ /sbyor ba 'dus pas bsam mi khyab/ /rmi lam sad pa lta bu ni/ /ji ltar gzhon nu'i gzugs kyis ni/ /dbang po gnyis ni 'dus pa yis/ /bha gar liṅga bzhag nas ni/ /sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom/ /ye shes ci zhig skye zhe na/ /thog ma dbus mtha'i dri ma med/ /rang gis rig pa'i ye shes de/ /gzhan du smra bar mi nus so/ /gzugs rnams thams cad lta ba dang / /sgra rnams nyid kyang nyan pa dang / /smra ba dang ni dgod pa dang / /sna tshogs ro ni za ba dang / /las rnams thams cad byed pa ni/ /gzhan du sems ni mi 'gro bas/ /de nyid rig pa'i rnal 'byor pa'i/ /rnal 'byor rtag tu skye bar 'gyur/ /'di ni gnyis su med par brjod/ /'di ni byang chub sems mchog nyid/ /rdo rje rdo rje sems dpa' dpal/ /rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas byang chub nyid/ /'di ni shes rab pha rol phyin/ /pha rol phyin pa kun gyis dngos/ /mnyam nyid bsam bya nyid du gsungs/ /sangs rgyas kun mchog bsgom bya nyid/ /'gro ba brtan dang g.yo ba'i bdag /byang chub sems dpa' mtha' yas dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas dang nyan thos sogs/ /de nyid las ni thams cad skyes/ /dngos dang dngos med sbyor bral ba/ /rnal 'byor pas ni de nyid bsgom/ /dngos dang dngos med rnal grol ba/ /bsgoms na myur du 'grub par 'gyur/ /ma lus skyon la sdang ba dang /

/kun nas nyon mongs rgyab phyogs des/ /dpal ldan bde gshegs yon tan rnams/ /mtha' yas de las skye bar 'gyur/ /kun rtog mang po'i mun pas khyab gyur pa'i/ /rab tu 'joms pas smyo zhing blo 'gyu ba/ /chags sogs dgag dka'i dri mas gos gyur pa'i/ /sems ni rdo rje can gyis 'khor bar gsungs/ /rang bzhin 'od gsal rtog las rnam par grol/ /'dod chags las sogs dri mas gos bral ba'i/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin med sems dpa' mchog /de nyid mya ngan 'das pa mchog tu gsungs/ /sdug bsngal phung po du ma'i mtshan gyur pa/ /'di las gzhan du cung zad yod ma yin/ /bde ba mtha' yas 'byung ba'i rgyur 'gyur pa/ /de las gzhan du grol ba'ang yod ma yin/ /sdug bsngal ma lus zad par 'dod pa dang / /rdzogs sangs rgyas kyi bde mchog thob 'dod pas/ /sems ni brtan par byas nas 'bad pas dpyad/ /de yi rang bzhin dngos po med par byed/ /ji srid rtog pa'i mun pa'i yol stug po/ /skye dgu'i yid bsgribs sdug bsngal mtha' yas la/ /ji srid de nas de ni bral yin te/ /de srid bde ba rgya chen tha dad min/ /mnyam pa nyid kyi mthar thug 'phags dgyes pa'i/ /de yi zad phyir rang gi bya ba yang / /rgyas pa de yi yan lag 'gro ba blta/ /de ltar de kho na nyid kyi rnal 'byor pas rnal 'byor gyi nges pa byas nas bka'i gnang ba dang / rang gi dam tshig la gnas pas sgom par byed na lag pa'i phyag rgya dang / sngags dang sku gzugs kyi nga rgyal bsgom pa dang / dam tshig gi thun mong gi dngos grub sgrub par byed pa yin no zhes pas ci zhig bya/ sangs rgyas nyid kyis byin gyis brlabs pa'i mtshon pa mngon du rang gi lha'i rnal 'byor yin te/ bskyed pa dang / de mtshon pa na gnas gsum po nam mkha' lta bur 'gyur ro/ /gzhung thams cad spang nas thob pa'i gnas kyi bsam gtan gyi rnal 'byor de la brtson pas rang rig pa tsam la spro bas nyin dang mtshan du goms par bya'o/

/ri'i rtse mo dang / zhi ba'i gnas dang / padma'i tshal dang / rgyal po'i tshal dang / dben pa dang / thams cad mkhyen pa'i gnas dang / rang gi khyim mam/ sems la mngon par 'dod pa thams cad mkhyen pas sngags pa 'di'i nang du gang dang gang gi gnas der gnas shing sngags shes pa spro ba dang ldan pa des sgom par byed de/ thabs dang shes rab ma rtogs par sangs rgyas nyid mngon du thob par mi 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir shes rab ma dngos su yang dag rdzogs pa'i byang chub sbyin par byed pa bzang mo spang bar mi bya ste/ phyag rgya re re dang ldan pa 'di ma gtogs par dngos grub ster bar mi 'gyur ro/ /de phyir ye shes skyed pa yi/ /phyag rgya bzhi ni sbyar bar bya/ /gti mug dam tshig phyag rgya ste/ /zhe sdang phyag rgya chen por brjod/ /phrag dog las kyi phyag rgya ste/ /'dod chags chos kyi phyag rgya bdag /yo gas phyag rgya sna tshogs 'di/ /bskyed nas rig ma bza' bar bya/ /de la gnyis ka yang lha'i gzugs su mngon du bsams nas gti mug las zhi ba dang / khro ba las ma rung pa dang / 'dod chags las chags pas las rnams byed do/ /de'i don du rab tu byed pa lnga po 'di rnams kyis rgyal ba rnams yin no/ /snga dro dang / nyi ma'i mtha' dang / nyi ma phyed dang / nam phyed kyi dus su yang phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bya'o/ /mnyam par sbyor ba las gzhan du ni 'grub par mi 'gyur ro/ /bstan pa la smod pa'i 'jigs pa dang / /skye bo gdug pa'i nang du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor pas rang gi sems 'ba' zhig de bsams pas sems la lhag par mos pa mngon du bya'o/ /gang zhig yang rnal 'byor pa brtson 'grus kyi 'bad pas rnal 'byor 'di bsgrub par bya'o/ /shes rab mngon du ma rnyed na byolasong dag la'ang rtag tu goms par bya'o/ /de ltar gang zhig rnal 'byor pas gal te padma 'dzin pa la mngon du nyi ma re re'am/ zla ba so so'am/ lo la reg par mi byed na dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ro/

/dam tshig nyams pas rnal 'byor pa bag med pa skye bar 'gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa'i dam tshig blang bar byas na yang mi byed par sdom pa gzung bar bya ste/ de'i phyir kun gyis sdom pa dang ldan zhing de kho na la gnas pas phyag rgya'i rnal 'byor bya'o/ /gsang ba'i nye ba'i rdzas dang sngags dang rgyud kyis 'di skad yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas yang dag par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor gyis rtag tu nye bar 'dug ste/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i gnas su gnas gsum po rtse gcig pa'i tshul gyis bsgom par bya'o/ /thabs dang shes rab kyi don bsgom pa zhes bya ba gnyis pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas 'khor lo thams cad kyi/ /rnam par 'phrul pa yang dag bshad/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems sogs lha'i/ /thams cad las ni sna tshogs byed/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid 'di la bsgrub/ /rnam par bral dang gnas su yang / /rang gi tshal sogs rnams su yang / /kun las sna tshogs phyag rgya ste/ /kun las sna tshogs sdom pas ni/ /kun las sna tshogs bya ba rnams/ /ji ltar bde bar bsgrub par bya/ /bde gshegs kun gyi dkyil 'khor ni/ /stong pa nyid kyi ye shes nyid/ /khro bo'i sgrub thabs thams cad dang / /zhi ba rnams kyi lha rnams la/ /ci zhig nga yis bshad par bya/ /bsam gyis mi khyab sangs rgyas gar/ /bsgom pa lha yi rnal 'byor dang / /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i chog rim dang / /bris sku 'am ni sku gzugs kyang / /sems kyis thams cad sprul pa ste/ /sems can rnams la phan 'dod phyir/ /nga yis rgyud du bsgrags pa yin/ /stong nyid gcig las rdo rje can/ /rigs ni rnam pa lnga ru gsungs/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol pa/ /bskyed pa'i yig 'bru gzugs dag ni/ /phyag rgya dbyibs kyi chog rim dang / /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i cho ga yang / /gang gis sgrub pos 'grub 'gyur ba/ /gtso bo shin tu dga' chen pos/

/bka' drin gyis ni bskyab tu gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang por byams pa bsgom par bya/ /gnyis par snying rje rnam par bsgom/ /gsum par dga' ba bsgom pa dang / /kun gyi tha mar btang snyoms so/ /yang ni stong pa'i byang chub sems/ /gnyis pa la ni sa bon bsdu/ /gsum pa la ni gzugs brnyan rdzogs/ /bzhi pa la ni yig 'bru dgod/ /re phas nyi ma sngon du rnam bsgoms nas/ /nyi der hūm̐ byung sna tshogs rdo rje ste/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis ni rwa ba dang / /gur yang cho ga bzhin du bsgom par bya/ /dang por ro ni bsgom par bya/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi bdag nyid brjod/ /de steng rnal 'byor pa gnas nas/ /he ru ka nyid rnam par bsgoms/ /rang gi snying gar re pha bsgom/ /de las byung ba'i nyi dkyil 'khor/ /der ni hūm̐ gi dbyibs nyid ni/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid can/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs chen po/ /hūm̐ las byung ba'i rdo rje nyid/ /rdo rje lte ba'i dbus gnas par/ /yang ni hūm̐ gi de nyid bsgom/ /de nyid yongs su gyur bltas nas/ /zhe sdang bdag nyid rnam par bsgom/ /rdo rje skye ba dpa' bo che/ /'dam skyes sngon po 'dra ba 'am/ /yang na sngo dang nyi ma ltar/ /dad pas nges par bsgom par bya/ /nam mkhar rje btsun bltas nas ni/ /rdo rje skye ba snying rje che/ /rgyan rnams thams cad 'dzin pa yi/ /lha mo brgyad kyis mchod par bya/ /dkar mo ri dwags mtshan pa 'dzin/ /chom rkun bdud las rgyal ba'i snod/ /ro langs ma ni chu lag ma/ /ghasma rī ni sman 'dzin cing / /pukka sī ni rdo rje lag /de bzhin ri khrod ma ro 'dzin/ /gdol ba mo ni cang te'u rdung / /g.yung mo sku la 'khyud pa ste/ /mchod pa'i cho ga rgyas pa yis/ /'di rnams kyis ni gtso bo mchod/ /de nas gnas las rnam grol ba'i/ /chos rnams kun gyi bdag nyid 'gyur/ /ā li zla ba kā li nyi/ /sa bon nang du son rig pa/

/de nyid sems dpa' zhes byar brjod/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rang bzhin can/ /nam mkha'i dkyil 'khor khyab pa yi/ /rang gi lus mtshungs rnam par spro/ /bsdus nas snying gar dgug pa na/ /yo gi zhe sdang bdag nyid 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi nang son par/ /de nas nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam/ /hūm̐ skyes sngo dang nyi ma ltar/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /phyag gnyis pa la zhal gcig pa/ /spyan gsum skra ni gyen du ser/ /sdang mig brgyad gnyis lo yi dbyibs/ /'jigs byed mnan cing g.yon pa na/ /rdo rje kha ṭwāṃ ga nyid dang / /thod pa yang ni g.yon pa na/ /g.yas na rdo rje nag po nyid/ /hūm̐ ni 'don par byed pa'i bdag /lha mo brgyad kyis bskor nas ni/ /dur khrod du ni mgon po rol/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pas ni bsgom/ /rnal 'byor bdud rtsi sdom pa kun/ /de nyid bcom ldan rnal 'byor te/ /rdo rje sems dpa' de bzhin gshegs/ /khro bo'i gzugs ni 'dzin gyur pa/ /phyag bzhi yis ni rnam par brgyan/ /bdud bzhi rnam par dag pa ni/ /dga' ba bzhi yi rang bzhin no/ /sngar gsungs dkyil 'khor 'khor lor gnas/ /hūm̐ gi sa bon las byung ba'i/ /g.yon na thod pa lha dang ni/ /lha min khrag gis bkang ba dang / /g.yas na rdo rje me lta bus/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /gzhan pa yi ni phyag dag gis/ /lus la yang dag 'khyud pa nyid/ /shes rab rdo rje phag mo ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyi gzugs brnyan bsgom/ /dang por stong pa bsgom bya zhing / /gnyis pa la ni cha bral nyid/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /hūm̐ ni der ni bsgom par bya/ /de bzhin zhal gsum phyag drug par/ /lha yi gzugs su bsgom par bya/ /dang po'i zhal ni dkar min zhing / /g.yas pa dkar zhing zhi ba nyid/ /g.yon pa dmar po lta bu ste/ /spyan gsum bzang po'i gzugs can nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun gyi yang dag gang / /thod pa'i gdan la yang dag gnas/

/bshang gci khu ba khrag rnams kyi/ /thod pa phyag gis bzung ba dang / /gzhu dang mda' ni 'dzin pa nyid/ /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /dang po rdo rje 'bar ba nyid/ /gsum par de bzhin rtse gsum pa/ /dpal ldan shes rab 'khyud pa dang / /ral pa'i cod pan brgyan pa ste/ /sprin gyi 'od 'bar du ma ni/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig spro bar bya/ /bha ga'i dbus su sgrub pa pos/ /der ni bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /lha mo lhan cig ldan par ni/ /de nas phyag rgya bsgom par bya/ /thod pa'i stan la gnas par ni/ /'dab mar lha mo bri bar bya/ /sna tshogs gzugs ma yid 'ong ma/ /zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /dang por rig ma bri bar bya/ /gzhu dang mda' ni 'dzin ma mdzes/ /thod pa khu bas gang ba dang / /lcags kyu lag pas 'dzin pa mo'o/ /gnyis pa rtse gsum lag pa dang / /khrag gis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /rdo rje de bzhin zhags pa nyid/ /gsum pa lag par ral gri dang / /thod pa chu yis gang ba dang / /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /bzhi ba kha ṭwāṃ ga lag ma/ /g.yon pa'i lag pas thod pa nyid/ /mu suṇḍī dang ba dan gsum/ /lnga pa zhags pa'i lag pa dang / /thod pa lag pas bzung ba dang / /de bzhin utpal cang te'u nyid/ /drug pa'i lag pas padma dang / /thod pa tshil gyis gang ba dang / /de bzhin me long dgra satwa nyid/ /bdun pa 'phang mdung lag pa dang / /dung dang 'khor lo'i mtshon cha 'dzin/ /thod pa khrag gis gang ba ni/ /khru gang tsam du yang dag bri/ /brgyad pa bum pa'i lag pa dang / /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /thod pa skyes pa'i pags pa yis/ /bkab pa rdzas kyis gang ba ni/ /ze 'brur bde ba chen po dang / /'dab mar lha mo bri bar bya/ /rol mo rnam pa sna tshogs rnams/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /rdo rje zhags pa lcags sgrog dang / /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /sgo yi skyong ba yang dag bri/

/bha ga'i dbus su bsgom bya zhing / /phyis ni bzlas pa yang dag brtsams/ /hūm̐ ni rdo rje sems dpa' yi/ /oṃ ni dbyangs kyi dbye ba nyid/ /ā ni ngag dang yang dag ldan/ /shel ni dag pa lta bu nyid/ /hrīḥni de la yang dag sbyar/ /de bzhin du yang swā hā nyid/ /sngags kyi bzlas par yang dag gsungs/ /bsam gtan yi ge gcig po nyid/ /lha mo rnams kyi hrīḥnyid ni/ /'dab ma rnams la de nas dgod/ /mchod pa bzhi yi rang bzhin gyis/ /sa bon bzhi dag yang dag ldan/ /sgo yi skyong ba thams cad du/ /dang po dbyangs yig la sogs ldan/ /bha ga nyid du sgrub pa pos/ /de nas rdo rje gzhug par bya/ /hrī ཿyi rnam pa nyid dang yang / /de la hūm̐ ni brjod par bya/ /zla mtshan dus su khrag bcas pa'i/ /khu ba kha yis bza' bar bya/ /bdag nyid dang ni bha ga la/ /me tog dri yis mchod par bya/ /gal te sgrub po grub 'dod na/ /de nyid la ni bzlas par bya/ /rdo rje drag mo de bzhin gcig /de bzhin rdo rje gzugs brnyan gnyis/ /gsum pa rdo rje 'dod chags ma/ /bzhi pa rdo rje zhi ba ma/ /lnga pa rdo rje gnod sbyin ma/ /drug pa rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /bdun pa sgra yi rdo rje ma/ /de bzhin brgyad pa rdo rje sa/ /gnyis pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //'khor lo sgrub pa'i khyad par gyi/ /rim pa ji bzhin rdo rje nyon/ /zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang ni/ /srung dang de bzhin mngon spyod nyid/ /re'u mig dgu sogs 'khor lo yi/ /phyi rol mu khyud nyid du bya/ /'khor lo las kyi kha dog sogs/ /mkhas pas rnam par bsgom par bya/ /oṃ tā re tuttā re tu re swā hā/ /'di yis sa bon thams cad kyis/ /phyag 'tshal sreg blugs tha ma ni/ /dbus su ming ni sbyar bar bya/ /srung ba'i tshig kyang rnam par bya/ /mnyam nyid ye shes stong pas ni/ /bdag nyid kyi ni gzugs su bya/ /mnyam nyid kun rigs gnas su ni/

/srung ba'i 'khor lo sbyar bya ba/ /srung ba ye shes can gyis bsgom/ /'jigs pa thams cad ring du byed/ /sems can dngos po med na ni/ /rnal 'byor dngos po bsgom par bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /padma'i gdan ni bsam par bya/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster mar/ /bdag gi lus ni bsgom par bya/ /oṃ tā re swā hā/ mgo bo la'o/ /oṃ tu re swā hā/ mig dag pa'o/ /oṃ tā re swā hā/ /sna dag la pa'o/ /oṃ tu swā hā/ rna ba dag pa'o/ /oṃ re swā hā/ lce la'o/ oṃ tā ri ni swā hā/ snying gar ro/ /yan lag drug ni rnam par gzung / /'phags ma sgrol ma bsam par bya/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /kun la skyabs sbyin lag pa dang / /g.yon pa utpal lta bu mchog /sngags kyi rgyal pos bskul ba yis/ /lha rnams thams cad bsgrub par bya/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru lle hrīḥswā hā/ las thams cad pa'i sngags so/ /dgra dang rgyal por bcings pa dang / /'gro ba'i shin tu 'jigs pa'i dug /yan lag rims ni sna tshogs dang / /dug sogs dus min 'chi ba yi/ /'jigs pa'i gnas ni gang gang la/ /de dang de la rab sbyar bya/ /shes rab chub pa blo ldan par/ /srung ba bris nas gzung bar bya/ /srung ba bzang po 'di nyid ni/ /'jigs pa thams cad du ni spangs/ /srung ba 'di ni thams cad las/ /rnal 'byor de nyid gong na med/ /'bar ba'i 'od zer lta bu yi/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams nas ni/ /de yi dbus su hrīḥnyid ni/ /kha dog dmar po lta bu'i 'od/ /de nas bdag nyid bsgom par bya/ /zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /mda' dang gzhu yi lag pa ma/ /utpal la dang lcags kyu 'dzin/ /'di ni bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /'jig rten gsum po dbang du byed/ /'bum phrag gcig gis rgyal po rnams/ /khri yis 'jig rten phal pa nyid/ /bye bas phyugs dang gnon sbyin sogs/

/'bum phrag bdun gyis lha ma yin/ /'bum phrag gnyis kyis lha rnams nyid/ /brgya phrag gcig gis sngags pa nyid/ /'khor lo 'dab ma brgyad pa 'di/ /kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /mnyam nyid gzugs su bsams nas ni/ /khams gsum gyi ni rang bzhin gyis/ /sngar gsungs mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ /gong du gsungs pas bsgrub par bya/ /shes rab 'bar ba'i las rnams ni/ /'di yi 'khor lo bsgom par bya/ /oṃ pradzñe ma hā pradzñe hūm̐ swā hā/ /dngos po ngo bos bsgom par bya/ /'od zer 'bar ba du ma yi/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /shes rab bdag nyid rnam par sprul/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /kha dog dkar po 'od gsal ma/ /shes rab bdag nyid gzung bar bya/ /'di yi sa bon bzlas nas ni/ /shes rab 'dab ma lta bur 'phel/ /gu ba'am blo ni dman pa yi/ /shes rab 'phel ba'i rnal 'byor ro/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /yi ge de la dgod par bya/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus gnas par/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /zhi ba'i 'khor lo dril bu 'dzin/ /thod pa dang ni zhags pa nyid/ /de bzhin 'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs par/ /kun tu rnam par spro bar bya/ /'dir ni rnal 'byor rim pas ni/ /rin chen 'byung gnas bsgom par bya/ /btso ma gser gyi mdog lta bu/ /sku mdog ser po gzi brjid che/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus bzhugs pa/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /dpa' bo rin chen lcags kyu 'dzin/ /thod pa de bzhin zhags pa nyid/ /'dir ni rnal 'byor rim pas ni/ /padma rdo rje 'chang ba bsgom/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /padma rā ga lta bu'i 'od/ /dpa' bo mda' dang gzhu 'dzin cing / /thod pa'i gdan la yang dag bzhugs/ /padma zhags pa 'dzin pa nyid/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /'dis ni rim pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /don yod phyag na ral gri 'dzin/

/thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus bzhugs par/ /zhal gcig pa la phyag bzhi pa/ /thod pa rdo rje dril bu dang / /lcags kyu dag ni g.yas pas 'phyar/ /baiḍūrya ltar ljang gu ste/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus son pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /de yi nang son sa bon ni/ /brum̐ las spyan gyi dbyibs su ni/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus gnas par/ /phyag ni brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /'khor lo'i lag pa mda' dang gzhu/ /de bzhin rdo rje dril bu nyid/ /zhags pa ral gri thod pa nyid/ /spyan gsum pa la zhal gcig ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yang dag gang / /do shal dang ni rkang gdub brgyan/ /kha dog dkar mo shin tu mdzes/ /de bzhin thod pa'i dbu rgyan nyid/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus son pa/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yongs gang ba/ /de yi nang son bsam par bya/ /hūm̐ las mā ma kī yi dbyibs/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus gnas par/ /kha dog sngon mo 'bar chen mo/ /spyad gsum ma la zhal gcig ma/ /thod pa'i phreng bas rnam par brgyan/ /mda' dang gzhu ni 'dzin pa nyid/ /lcags kyu dang ni ral gri nyid/ /zhags pa rdo rje de bzhin du/ /dril bu dang ni thod pa 'o/ /'khor lo rin chen padma dang / /kha ṭwāṃ ga dang bcu gnyis ni/ /gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor bri bar bya/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /bha ga'i dbus su yongs gang ba'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /der ni hrīḥni bsam bya zhing / /gos dkar zhes bya rnam par bsgom/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus gnas par/ /kha dog dmar mo 'bar chen mo/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis yongs gang ba/ /phyag brgyad kyis ni rnam par brgyan/ /gzhu dang mda' ni 'dzin pa dang / /padma'i lag par ral gri dang / /thod pa rdo rje dril bu dang / /zhags pa de bzhin rin chen nyid/ /do shal dang ni rkang gdub sgra/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/

/rnal 'byor pas ni 'di bsgoms na/ /myur du sangs rgyas thob par 'gyur/ /nam mkha'i dbus su yongs gang ba'i/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya/ /de yi nang song tām̐ nyid ni/ /sgrol ma'i dbyibs su bsam par bya/ /thod pa'i gdan gyi dbus gnas par/ /phyag ni brgyad kyis rnam par brgyan/ /ral gri phyag na chags bcas ma/ /atpal de bzhin lcags kyu dang / /thod pa khrag gis gang ba dang / /zhags pa de bzhin 'khor lo dang / /gzhu dang mda' ni 'dzin pa nyid/ /zhal gcig ma ni yang dag bri/ /kha dog ljang gu spyan gsum ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /de ltar rnal 'byor pas bsgom pas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' mnyam par 'gyur/ /rgyud thams cad kyi gling gzhi'i gsang ba dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba las brtag pa'i rgyal po gnyis pa'o// //he ru ka dang bdag med ma'i/ /skyed pa'i sgrub dang de nyid nyon/ /gang gis gdug pa drag po yis/ /sems can 'dul bar 'gyur ba yi/ /mkha' 'gro mkha' 'gro mas mdzad pa'i/ /de dag thams cad khyod la bshad/ /rdo rje sems dpar gyur nas kyang / /rdo rje can nyid rdo rjer dbab/ /'bar ba'i phreng 'khrugs drag po ni/ /kun tu rnam par spro bar bya/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sa bon phreng ba de nas dgod/ /de nas rdo rje chags chen las/ /rig mar bcas pa khu bar gyur/ /sna tshogs glu yi mchod pa las/ /de nas rig mas bskul bar bya/ /rje btsun snyeng rje'i yid bzhengs shig /pukka sī ni bdag la skyobs/ /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /bdag la bde chen sbyor bzhedamadzod/ /khyod med na ni bdag 'gum pas/ /kye yi rdo rje khyod bzhengs shig /stong pa'i rang bzhin nyid spongs la/ /ri khrod ma 'bras grub par mdzod/ /dga' gtso 'jig rten mgron gnyer ba/ /stong pa nyid la bzhugs sam ci/ /khyod med phyogs ni mi 'tshal bas/ /gdol pa mo bdag zhu ba bgyid/

/bdag gis khyod kyi thugs 'tshal gyis/ /mig 'phrul mnga' ba khyod bzhengs shig /g.yung mo bdag yid dran nyams pas/ /snyeng rje rgyun chad ma mdzad cig /aṃ dang hāṃ las rdo rje che/ /khu ba'i gzugs las bzhengs nas ni/ /zhabs rnams sa la rdegs pa dang / /lha dang lha min sdigs par mdzad/ /gam̐ tsam̐ ba ྂgham̐ pam̐ sham̐ lam̐ ḍam̐/ /'di yis sa bon dbyung bar bya/ /bdag po dga' ma'i sa bon la/ /oṃ hūm̐ sngon po 'bar gtsigs pas/ /ma mo'i 'khor lo grong nyams dgar/ /gtso bo 'di ltar bsgom par bya/ /zhal brgyad pa la zhabs bzhi pa/ /phyag ni bcu drug dag gis brgyan/ /bdud bzhi mnyam par mnan pa nyid/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs pa po/ /sgeg cing dpa' bo mi sdug pa/ /rgod cing drag shul 'jigs su rung / /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba yi/ /gar dgu'i ro dang ldan pa nyid/ /mgo yi phreng bas do shal mdzad/ /nyi mar bzhugs shing rol mor bcas/ /kha dog nag po 'jigs pa po/ /sna tshogs rdo rje spyi bor 'dzin/ /nyid kyi zhal nas hūm̐ spro zhing / /thal bas sku la byugs pa nyid/ /bdag med lhan cig mnyam sbyor zhing / /dga' ba gnyis gnyis snyoms 'jug pas/ /dba' rlabs med pa'i rang bzhin can/ /rtsa ba'i zhal ni bzhad cing nag /g.yas pa'i zhal ni kun da mtshungs/ /g.yon pa dmar zhing cher 'jigs pa/ /steng ma'i zhal ni rnam par gtsigs/ /spyan ni nyi shu rtsa bzhi che/ /lhag ma'i zhal ni bung ba mtshungs/ /rdo rje ral gri 'dzin pa dang / /mda' dang de bzhin 'khor lo nyid/ /de bzhin gshor dang dbyug pa dang / /rtse gsum pa dang lcags kyu nyid/ /g.yon par dril bu padmar bcas/ /gzhu dang kha ṭwāṃ ga 'phyar zhing / /thod pa dang ni rin chen nyid/ /sdigs mdzub zhags pa de bzhin no/ /sangs rgyas sprin gyi 'od zer ldan/ /kun tu rnam par spro bar bya/ /de ltar cho ga sna tshogs kyis/ /dkar mo la sogs de nas dgod/ /dkar mo kha dog dkar mo ste/ /gzhu dang mda' ni 'gengs pa mchog

/thod pa khrag gis bkang ba dang / /de bzhin rdo rje gri gug nyid/ /chom rkun ma ni kha dog dmar/ /'khor lo lcags kyu 'dzin mar brjod/ /thod pa dang ni cang te'u nyid/ /gsal ba'i gzugs can dgod par bya/ /rmongs byed ma ni sku mdog nag /de bzhin thod pa dang ni gshor/ /sa la zlog pa nyid dang ni/ /g.yas pa rtse gsum 'phyar ba 'o/ /ro langs ma ni dkar ser mtshungs/ /phyag dag na ni chang dang chu/ /ral gri dang ni thod pa nyid/ /mdzes ma'i gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /pukka sī ni kha dog ser/ /dpag bsam shing gi lcug ma dang / /sha yis gang ba'i thod pa dang / /rin chen dang ni mchog sbyin nyid/ /gdol pa mo ni sngo mdog mtshungs/ /de bzhin rlung gi gos 'dzin ma/ /gzhan pa dag gis thod pa dang / /de bzhin padma dkar po nyid/ /g.yung mo sngo dang dkar ba'i mdog /rdo rje dang ni lcags kyu 'dzin/ /g.yon pas thod pa 'dzin pa ste/ /gzhan pas rlung gi gos 'dzin ma/ /ghasma rī ni ljang ser mtshungs/ /rdo rje me thab dgra sta'i lag /thod pa tshil bus yongs gang ba/ /g.yas pa mi 'jigs sbyin byed ma/ /ri khrod ma ni dkar mdog mtshungs/ /kha ṭwāṃ ga dang thod pa'i lag /rdo rje de bzhin zhags pa nyid/ /sna tshogs gzugs can bsgom par bya/ /ro hi ta dang phag nyid dang / /rus sbal de bzhin lto 'phye nyid/ /seng ge de bzhin stag nyid dang / /wa dang dge slong nyid rnams ni/ /de ltar dkar mo la sogs pa'i/ /thod pa brgyad du cho ga bzhin/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sgeg pa la sogs ro dang ldan/ /rta yi gzugs dang phag gi gdong / khyi gdong de bzhin seng ge ma/ /zhal bzhi ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /gling bu dang ni pi wang dang / /mu kunda dang rdza rnga ste/ /phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnams par brgyan/ /nag mo dkar ser lta bu dang / /de bzhin steng du rta gdong ljang /

/ser mo nag mo dkar mtshungs dang / /de bzhin steng du phag gdong dmar/ /dmar zhing nag dang dkar mtshungs shing / /de bzhin steng du khyi gdong ser/ /ljang dang nag dang dkar ba'i gdong / /steng du 'bar pa'i seng ge gdong / /thams cad skra ni steng du 'bar/ /g.yon brkyang ba yis ro mnan cing / /spyan gsum khro zhing sgeg pa dang / /rgod pa'i bzhin ni bsgom par bya/ /he ru ka bskyed pa gsum pa las rab tu byed pa dang pa'o// //ye shes mkha' 'gro'i sgrub thabs ni/ /rdo rje gtso bo rgyal po nyon/ /gnyis med ye shes chos ldan pa'i/ /gnyis kyi dngos po spangs pa yis/ /rnal 'byor kun sogs dang por ni/ /dag pa gsum ni gdon par bya/ /swa bhā wa shu dhāḥsarba dharmā swa bhā wa shud dho3haṃ/ badzra shudadhāḥsarba dharmā badzra shud dho3haṃ/ yo ga shud dhāḥsarba dharmā yo ga shud dhāo3haṃ/ de ltar byas nas rnal 'byor pas/ /yang ni bsam gtan de nyid bya/ /yid kyis rjes mthun gnas rnams su/ /de nas bsam gtan brtsam par bya/ /bla re yang ni bre ba nyid/ /sna tshogs gos ni 'phyang ba dang / /'phan dang rgyal mtshan bsgreng ba dang / /phyogs bcu'i gnas ni thams cad du/ /dri zhim me tog sna tshogs dang / /de bzhin dri yi dkyil 'khor du/ /skad cig gcig pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag gi lus ni bsam par bya/ /blo gros ldan pas sngar mchod nas/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro ma ni gzung / /de ltar cho ga sna tshogs ni/ /nges par bsgom pa nyid du bya/ /ye shes rgya mtsho ri bo'i mgor/ /phyogs sogs kha dog bzhi ni bsam/ /de bzhin gser gyi rgyan byung dang / /rin chen bdun gyis rnam par spras/ /g.yer ka 'bar ba'i phreng ba ni/ /'dod pas kun tu rgyas par ni/ /gnas ni lnga ru seng ge yi/ /gdan ni bsgom pa nyid du bya/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsams nas ni/ /gdugs ni dkar pos rnam par spras/ /bdag gis dbugs kyis phyung nas ni/

/dbus su ye shes mkha' 'gro ma/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug nyid/ /sems dpa'i skyil mo krung gis gnas/ /ma bcings skra yis mdzes pa dang / /sangs rgyas lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /kha dog sngon mo 'jigs chen mo/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /rgod dang khro ba sgeg pa dang / /spyan gsum gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ /sgra cher rgod dang gtsigs pa mo/ /gos ni dmar pos shin tu mdzes/ /steng du kha ṭwāṃ ga nyid dang / /gnyis pa la ni dgra sta nyid/ /gsum pa la ni rdo rje nyid/ /g.yon na de bzhin dril bu'i sgra/ /gnyis pa la ni lhung bzed nyid/ /gsum par de bzhin ral gri 'dzin/ /'od zer 'bar ba du ma dang / /dbus su mkhas pas bsgom par bya/ /ye shes mkha' 'gro'i mdun du ni/ /bdag gis dbugs kyis phyung nas ni/ /kha dog dkar mo shin tu mdzes/ /ma bcings pa yi skra yis brgyan/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /sgeg pa'i ro dang ldan pa dang / /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /phyag gnyis kyis ni rnam par spras/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭwāṃ ga /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma bsgom bya/ /ye shes byang gi cha la ni/ /bdag gis dbugs las phyung nas ni/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /btso ma gser gyi mdog lta bu/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭwāṃ ga /ma bcings skra yis rnam par brgyan/ /yan lag sbrul gyis brgyan dang ni/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /'jigs pa'i mkha' 'gro zhes bya bsgom/ /ye shes nub kyi cha la ni/ /yang ni ro langs ma phyung nas/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /kha dog sngon mo shin tu mdzes/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭwāṃ ga /ma bcings pa yi skra yis brgyan/ /lus la sbrul gyis brgyan pa dang / /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /ye shes lho yi cha la ni/ /gdol pa mo ni dmar mo ltar/ /rnal 'byor lhung bzed kha ṭwāṃ ga

/ma bcings pa yi skra yis brgyan/ /phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma/ /sna tshogs rgyan gyis rnam par brgyan/ /yongs gang gzugs dang gzi brjid ldan/ /'di ni rnal 'byor pa yis bsgom/ /dbang ldan lha mo seng ge ma/ /gdong ni seng ger bsam par bya/ /dkar dang ser ba lta bur ni/ /klu dbang stan la g.yas brkyang gnas/ /rdo rje lcags kyu sdigs mdzub zhags/ /shun tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /'od zer 'bar ba du mas ni/ /lus ni 'bar bar bsgom par bya/ /mer ni stag mo zhes bya ba/ /rin chen bdun po mchog gi gdan/ /phyag gnyis sngo dang dkar ba mtshungs/ /gos dang rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /'bar ba'i rdo rje lcags kyu dang / /de bzhin sdigs mdzub zhags pa nyid/ /'od zer 'bar ba du mas ni/ /lus ni 'bar bar bsgom par bya/ /bden bral lha mo wa gdong ma/ /sgra cher rgod dang 'jigs pa mo/ /ma he'i gdan dang yang dag ldan/ /dmar zhing nag pa'i kha dog ma/ /lus la shin tu mdzes gos dang / /phyag gnyis kyis ni rnam par spras/ /lcags kyu zhags pa sdigs mdzub ma/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa 'o/ /rlung du lha mo 'ug pa ma/ /ser dang dmar ba'i kha dog ma/ /klu yi gdan la gnas pa dang / /de nyid rgyan ni rab tu brtag /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil krung gnas/ /lcags kyu zhags pa sdigs mdzub ma/ /'od zer 'bar ba du ma yis/ /thams cad kyi ni thams cad 'bar/ /mkha' 'gro ma brgyad dbus su ste/ /phyi rol du ni bzhi po rnams/ /de ltar dgod pa'i rim bltas nas/ /phyi nas gnas ni rab tu brtag /shar du mkha' 'gro rgyal dbang mo/ /phyag gnyis dang mdog dkar mo/ /yi dwags gdan la gnas pa dang / /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /skra ni grol zhing drag mo dang / /me ni 'bar ba'i 'od lta bu/ /khar ni lag pa bcug nas ni/ /sgra chen rgod dang de bzhin 'bar/ /byang du mar me rgyal mo dbang / /kha dog gser mdog drag shul ma/

/'jigs pa'i gzugs can gtsigs pa can/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /rab tu song ba'i stan la gnas/ /'bar ba'i me ni lta bu'i 'od/ /thal mo gnyis kyi lag pa ni/ /mgo bo'i steng du mar me bzhin/ /nub tu lha mo 'jib byed ma/ /kha dog dmar mo 'jigs pa mo/ /rab tu song ba'i stan la gnas/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /khrag gi srad bu lag pa yi/ /snyim par khrag ni 'thung bar byed/ /me ni 'bar ba'i 'od drag mo/ /lha mo gtso mo 'jib byed ma/ /lho ru g.yo ldan ma zhes pa/ /kha dog nag po'i 'od lta bu/ /rab tu song ba'i stan la gnas/ /ma bcings pa yi skra yis brgyan/ /gos ni dmar po shin tu mdzes/ /sbrul gyi rgyan gyis brgyan pa dang / /sdigs mdzub dang ni gtun shing lag /thams cad sems ni rmongs par byed/ /'bar ba'i me yi 'od drag mo/ /thams cad rig pas thams cad bsgom/ /'di rnams gzugs sogs mdun du ni/ /dam tshig de bzhin bstan par bya/ /rlung dang me yis bdun pa'i don/ /rdo rje'i sa bon gyis ni bskul/ /theg le sgras ni mnan pas ni/ /rgyun gyi char ni zhes byar gsungs/ /gsum pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas bdag med sgrub pa ni/ /ci gsungs mdo ru bsdus nas bshad/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi dbus son par/ /nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor bsam par bya/ /'khor lo sngon du ci rigs par/ /lha rnams ji ltar 'byung ba nyid/ /'khor lo sa dang chu ni sngon/ /go rim bzhin du byin za dang / /lha rnams kyi ni rlung chen dang / /ji ltar sgom pa po 'byung ba'i/ /chos 'byung las skyes 'khor lo ni/ /'phar ma gnyis dag skyon med pa/ /ze 'bru las ni gcig yin te/ /rdo rje can gyi sku gsum mchog /bco lnga'i gdan dang ldan pa yis/ /ro ni nges par bsam par bya/ /de yi steng du zla ba yin/ /zla ba'i steng du sa bon nyid/ /phyi nas bdud las rgyal bas mnan/

/gnyis 'dus pa las bde chen po/ /ā li zla ba'i gzugs kyis gnas/ /kā li'i gzugs kyis snang byed do/ /zla ba nyi ma gnyis 'dus pas/ /dkar mo la sogs rab tu grags/ /zla ba me long ye shes ldan/ /de bzhin mnyam nyid ye shes nyid/ /rang lha'i sa bon phyag mtshan ni/ /so sor rtog par brjod par bya/ /thams cad gcig gyur nan tan nyid/ /gzugs brnyan rdzogs par dag pa 'o/ /mkhas pas cho ga gsungs pa ni/ /rnam pa lnga po bsgom par bya/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyor ba/ /rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyi gdan/ /yi ge las byung gong bu la/ /hūm̐ phaṭ rnam pa 'dod mi bya/ /sems pa'i gzugs brnyan las byung ba/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po bsgom par bya/ /phyag mtshan zhal sogs gong ma bzhin/ /zla ba chu shel nor bu'i 'od/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las/ /de ltar thams cad rdzogs pa nyid/ /ā li shes rab kā li thabs/ /zla ba nyi ma'i rab dbye ba/ /gang phyir dkar mo la sogs pa/ /kha dog dbye ba so so yin/ /de phyir kun tu rab 'bar pas/ /dkyil 'khor pa yang rab tu brtag /rnal 'byor ma lnga 'di dag ni/ /nang gi 'phar ma yang dag gnas/ /phung po lnga yi rang bzhin gyis/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu bsgom/ /dbang por rdo rje gshin rjer dkar/ /chu bdag chu yi rnal 'byor ma/ /lus ngan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /dbus su bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /phyi rol 'phar mar dkar mo dang / /chom rkun de bzhin ro langs ma/ /ghasma rī dang pukka sī/ /ri khrod ma dang gdol pa mo/ /brgyad pa g.yung mos gang ba 'o/ /'og ldan ma dang steng ldan nyid/ /mkha' spyod sa spyod ma zhes brjod/ /srid dang zhi ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /ngos su gyur ma yang dag gnas/ /lha mo thams cad sna tshogs mdog /drag chen phyag rgya lnga yis brgyan/ /zhal gcig ma la phyag bzhi ma/ /spyan gsum gsal ba'i gzugs can ma/ /'khor lo rna cha mgul rgyan dang / /lag par gdu bu ska rags nyid/

/sangs rgyas lnga ni rnam dag pas/ /'di lnga phyag rgya dag par gsungs/ /ji ltar bdag med rnal 'byor ma/ /de ltar thams cad rnam par bshad/ /g.yon pas rnal 'byor lhung bzed dang / /de bzhin steng du kha ṭwāṃ ga /g.yas na rdo rje sngon po dang / /de bzhin du yang gri gug nyid/ /ro la zhon zhing gzi brjid 'bar/ /spyan dmar de bzhin steng skyes ser/ /kha dog sngon mo ches gsal ma/ /stag gi pags pas rnam dkris shing / /'jigs pa'i me ni lta bur ni/ /gsal ba'i gzugs can ma de gnas/ /g.yas na dkar dang sngo ba ste/ /g.yon na margad sngo dang mtshungs/ /phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /lag pa gcig ni thod pas brel/ /g.yas na gri gug 'dzin pa ma/ /rgod dang khro dang sgeg pa dang / /de ni mchog pa'i gzugs gnas pas/ /sangs rgyas sprin dang mnyam pa yi/ /'od zer sna tshogs kun tu spro/ /de nyid gsum gyi rang bzhin bdag /mkhas pas dbus su bsgom par bya/ /gsum pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //de nas dkyil 'khor chen po mchog /yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /rdo rje dbyings dang mnyam pa'i dbyibs/ /rdo rje dbyings zhes bya bar gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor gnas ni sbyangs nas ni/ /phyag rgya chen por yongs su gzung / /thams cad rnam par bltas nas ni/ /sngags pas 'di ni bsgrub par bya/ /gsar pa legs par bkal ba dang / /shin tu tshad ma mdzes pas ni/ /srad bus thig gdab shes rab can/ /ji ltar nus par dkyil 'khor nyid/ /gru bzhi pa la sgo bzhi pa/ /rta babs rnams kyis shin tu mdzes/ /thig bzhi dang ni yang dag ldan/ /gos dang me tog phreng bas brgyan/ /mtshams kyi cha rnams thams cad dang / /sgo yi khyud kyi grwa rnams su/ /rdo rje rin chen rnams kyis spras/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor thig gdab bya/ /de yi 'khor lo so so'i skabs/ /nang du yang ni zhugs nas ni/ /rdo rje thig ni yongs bcug cing /
