/ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes/ /rdo rje ka ba'i rtser gnas pa/ /dkyil 'khor lnga yis rnam par brgyan/ /de nas dkyil 'khor nang du ni/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan rnam par dgod/ /gsungs pa'i dkyil 'khor cho ga yang / /sgrub pa'ang khyod la bshad par bya/ /de la dang por lha nyid kyi/ /khyim du sngags pa zhugs nas ni/ /a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/ /bsams nas de steng rdo rje ni/ /dkar po rtse mo lnga pa nyid/ /cho gas bsam par byas nas ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pa kun sogs la/ /mchod nas phyag 'tshal 'di skad gsol/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' kun/ /bdag la dgongs pa mdzad du gsol/ /bdag ni che ge mo zhes bgyi/ /dus 'di nas ni bzung nas ni/ /ji srid byang chub snying po'i bar/ /ji ltar dus gsum mgon po rnams/ /byang chub tu ni nges mdzad pa'i/ /byang chub sems ni bla na mchog /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/ /dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang / /sems can don byed tshul khrims dang / /tshul khrims bslab pa rnam pa gsum/ /so sor bdag gis brtan par gzung / /sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te/ /bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum/ /sangs rgyas rnal 'byor las skyes pa'i/ /sdom pa deng nas brtan por gzung / /rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la/ /rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang / /de nyid las ni so sor gzung / /slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi/ /rin chen rigs kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /dam tshig yid du 'ong pa la/ /nyi ma re re drug byas nas/ /sbyin pa rnam bzhi rab tu sbyin/ /byang chub chen po las byung ba/ /padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la/ /phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum/ /dam pa'i chos kyang so sor gzung / /las kyi rigs mchog chen po la/ /sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni/ /thams cad so sor gzung bar bya/ /mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi/ /byang chub sems ni bla med po/ /dam pa bdag gis bskyed par bgyi/

/sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sdom ma lus gzung bar bgyi/ /ma bsgral ba dag bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba dag sgrol bar bgyi/ /dbugs ma phyin pa dbugs dbyung zhing / /sems can mya ngan 'das la gzhag /de nas bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin pa thams cad kyi rtse mo las byung ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs te tshig 'di dag bka' stsal pa/ de nas bsam gtan gnas 'dug nas/ /chos rnams thams cad bdag med par/ /yang dag rjes su blta bar bya/ /phyi dang nang gi bdag nyid can/ /'di dag thams cad sems kyis brtags/ /sems las ma gtogs pa nyid ni/ /gzhan du yod pa ma yin no/ /chos kun rang bzhin 'od gsal ba/ /chos kun dang por ma skyes phyir/ /yid kyis a nutpanna brjod/ /de nas rang sems de nyid 'dis/ /rang bzhin gyis ni 'od gsal ba/ /'dod pa'i sngags kyis bzlas pas ni/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor rnam par blta/ /oṃ tsitta pra ti be dham̐ ka ro mi/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor che dag pa/ /nam mkha' lta bu dri ma med/ /yid gnyis kun las rnam par grol/ /mchog tu rnam par rtog pa 'joms/ /nyon mongs dri ma thams cad dag /dang po zla ba ltar bltas nas/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan 'dir/ /a sogs gzugs kyis 'jug par 'gyur/ /a ā i ī u ū ṛ ṝ l̥̄ l̥̄ e ai au am̐ aḥ bcom ldan zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi/ /yon tan khyad par ji ltar lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gru gsum rgya chen rang bzhin can/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi yon tan gnas/ /'di ni a sogs gzugs kyis ni/ /sangs rgyas yon tan 'jug par 'gyur/ /shel dang zla ba lta bur ni/ /de yi steng tu 'jug par 'gyur/ /sems ni rang bzhin 'od gsal bas/ /de nyid dga' ba byed pa'i rgyu/ /sngags pas 'di yi sngags kyis ni/ /byang chub sems ni skyed par byed/ /oṃ bodhi tsitta utpā da yā mi/ /byas pa'i rjes su rim 'byung ba/

/sems can rjes su 'dzin pa po/ /dge ba'i chos kyi yang dag gang / /nyon mongs thams cad nges par gnon/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /byang chub zla ba gnyis pa can/ /'dir yang skar ma'i rnam pas ni/ /sangs rgyas yon tan ka sogs kyi/ /gzugs kyis gzugs brnyan lta bu yi/ /rnal 'byor gyis ni 'jug par 'gyur/ /ka kha ga gha nga / tsa tsha dza dzha nya/ ṭa ṭha ḍa ḍha ṇa/ ta tha da dha na/ pa pha ba bha ma/ ya ra la wa/ sha ṣa sa ha kṣaḥ 'di yi dkyil 'khor cho ga kun/ /rgyud ni gzhan du ma gsungs so/ /de la dbus su rtse lnga pa/ /'od zer dkar po bcas pa nyid/ /kun tu bzang po'i sems bskyed pas/ /brtan par byed pa'i rgyu yi phyir/ /bdag nyid rdo rje'i gzugs brnyan du/ /'di yi sngags kyis bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ti ṣṭha badzra/ byang chub spyod pa bla na med/ /de yi sa ni rtogs pa 'di/ /ye shes dag pa zag pa med/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus su ni/ /rdo rje nges par brtag par bya/ /nam mkha'i khams ni thams cad kyi/ /tshad du yang dag gang ba yi/ /rdo rje'i lus kyi bdag nyid du/ /sngags pas bsgom par bya ba 'o/ /'dis ni sngags kyi rnal 'byor gyis/ /spro ba dang ni bsdu bar bya/ /oṃ badzra ātma ko3ham̐/ sangs rgyas kun gyi sku gang ni/ /snang ba med cing gnas pa med/ /ma skyes ma byas dag pa nyid/ /dngos po med pa la sogs spangs/ /gcad med dbyer med gzung du med/ /chos kyi sku ni gzugs med pa/ /rdo rje bdag med yang dag gyur/ /rdo rje'i sku ni gong na med/ /de ltar yang de rdo rjes mtshan pa bsgom par bya ba bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad nyon cig yang ni rdo rje sems dpa' ni/ /rnam pa kun gyi mchog ldan pa/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi gzugs brnyan ni/ /'di yi sngags kyis bsgom par bya/ /oṃ ya tha sarba ta thā gā tā sta thā ham̐/ sku dang gsang ba de bzhin spyod/ /spyod yul de nyid rtogs pa ni/

/mngon par byang chub rnam pa lnga/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi bdag nyid dge /de nas yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pas bcom ldan la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das gsang ba'i rdo rje dang / padma'i rigs kyi ming ci lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rdo rje de bzhin gshegs pa kun la gnas/ /padma'i rigs ni lha mo chen mo ldan/ /de yi rdo rje padma'i steng du gnas/ /de las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad don/ /de nas de ltar bdag nyid rnam par snang mdzad du bskyed nas steng dang 'og tu sngags kyi yi ge bkod de/ cho ga bzhin du ri rab dang / gru gsum rgya chen po bskyed par bya ste/ 'od zer sna tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor gyis brgyan pa las yang dag par byung ba'i mdzes pa'i gnas bsgom nas/ der pam̐ las byung ba'i sna tshogs padmar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /rlung dang me'i dkyil 'khor dang ldan pa ya ra la was brgyan pa'o/ /de nas de'i steng du sngags kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis gsol ba btab cing bstod pa/ rab tu bsngags pa/ nor bu rin po che chen po 'od gsal ba dang / kha dog sna tshogs shing dril bu dpyangs pa dang / rlung gis bskyod pa'i gos dang / 'phan dang / me tog gi phreng ba dang / do shal dang / do shal phyed pa dang / zla bas nye bar mdzes par rdo rje nor bu'i rtse mor gzhal med khang bsam par bya'o/ /hūm̐ gi sngags 'dis rang gi snying khar zla ba'i dkyil 'khor du sngags 'di bkod de gyur pa las rdo rje rtse lnga pa bsgom par bya'o/ /yang sangs rgyas thams cad spro ba dang bsdu bar bya zhing rdo rje de nyid kyang yongs su gyur pa las rdo rje sems dpa' rnam pa kun gyi mchog dang ldan pa zla ba'i kha dog gi 'od lta bu ste/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng na bzhugs shing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa/ dpa' bo shes rab dang dga' ba gcig pus mdzes pas rdo rje dang /

dril bu dang / ral gri dang / lcags kyu nyid dang / thod pa dang / zhags pa 'dzin pa nyid do/ /g.yas pa ni kha dog nag po'o/ /g.yon pa ni padma rā ga'i 'od do/ /zhal gsum pa dang / phyag drug pa nyid dang / spyan gsum pa nyid dang / bzang po'i gzugs can te/ rang gi rig ma'i padma la bzhugs pa/ dgyes pa'i dkyil 'khor bsgom par bya'o/ /rnam pa thams cad kyi mchog dang ldan par dkyil 'khor pa'ang rab tu brtag par bya'o/ /shar du ni rnam par snang mdzad do/ /lhor ni rin chen 'byung gnas so/ /nub tu ni 'od dpag tu med pa'o/ /byang du ni gdon mi za bar grub pa'o/ /dbang ldan du ni spyan no/ /mer ni mā ma kī 'o/ /bden bral du ni gos dkar mo'o/ /rlung du ni sgrol ma'o/ /phyi rol gyi 'phar ma la drag shul ma ni kha dog dkar mo'o/ /lho ru ni rdo rje gzugs brnyan ma ni kha dog ser mo'o/ /nub tu ni 'dod chags rdo rje ma kha dog dmar mo'o/ /byang du ni rdo rje zhi ba mo kha dog ljang gu ma'o/ /dbang ldan du ni rdo rje gnod sbyin mo kha dog dkar ser lta bu'o/ /me ru ni rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dmar ser lta bu'o/ /bden bral du ni sgra'i rdo rje ma ni sngon dmar lta bu'o/ rlung dang sa'i rdo rje ma ni kha dog ljang skya ma lta bu'o/ /phyi rol gyi 'phar ma la dbang ldan du ni gling bu ma'o/ /me ru ni pi waṃ ma'o/ /bden bral du ni mu kun da ma'o/ rlung du ni rdza rnga ma'o/ gling bu ma la sogs pa ni phyag gnyis ma la zhal gcig ma'o/ /phyi rol gyi snam bu la me tog ma la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ma de gzhag par bya ste/ de bzhin du phyag gnyis ma'o/ /shar gyi sgo la lha mo rdo rje lcags kyu ma nam mkha' sngo bsangs ma'i mdog bri bar bya ste/ zhal g.yas pa dang / gzhan pa ni gnag pa dang dkar po'o/ /phyag g.yas pa'i dang po ni lcags kyu'o/ /gnyis pa la ni ral gri 'phyar ba'o/

/gsum pa la ni 'khor lo'o/ /g.yon pa na ni zhags pa dang / sdigs mdzub dang / dril bu 'dzin pa ste phyag drug pa bri bar bya'o/ /lho'i sgor lha mo rdo rje zhags pa ma kha dog dkar ser te/ gzhan pa ni gnag pa dang dmar ba'o/ /g.yas pa na ni zhags pa dang / rdo rje dang / ral gri 'phyar ba'o/ 'khor lo dang / dril bu dang / sdigs mdzub zhags pa can te phyag drug go /nub kyi sgo la ni rdo rje lcags sgrog ma ste/ de bzhin du yang kha dog dmar zhing gzi brjid che ba ste/ zhal g.yas pa dang gzhan pa ni gnag pa dang dkar ba'o/ /phyag drug na lcags sgrog dang / rdo rje dang / ral gri dang / 'khor lo dang / dril bu dang / lcags kyu'o/ byang gi sgo la ni rdo rje dril bu ma 'jigs par byed ma ste/ zhal gsum ni ljang gu dang / nag mo dang / dkar mo'o/ phyag drug na ni dril bu dang / rdo rje dang / lcags kyu dang / 'khor lo dang / ral gri dang / zhags pa'o/ /thams cad kyang skra steng du 'bar ba ste/ sna tshogs padmar nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor du gzhag par bya'o/ me'i phyogs nas brtsams te me tog la sogs pa'i mtshan ma 'dzin pa'i rnal 'byor ma de gzhag par bya ste/ phyag gnyis mar gsungs so/ /shar la sogs pa'i sgo rnams su rnal 'byor ma lcags kyu ma dang / zhags pa ma dang / lcags sgrog ma dang / dril bu'i lag pa ma ste/ sgo srung ma dang yang dag par ldan pa'o/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes bya ba 'di rnams kyi snying po bstan pa ste the tshom mi za'o/ /de ltar bkod pa dang byas pa la sogs pa'i tshul gyis kyang mtshan ma dang phyag rgya dang ldan pa'i dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i phyi'i dkyil 'khor ro/ /gong ma lta bu de'i phyed kyis de'i nang du zla ba phyed pa'i dbyibs lta bu'i rlung gi dkyil 'khor dang ka ba brgyad kyis nye bar mdzes pa dang / phyi rol du ri mo bzhis yongs su bskor ba'o/ /lha mo thams cad kyi gnas su ji skad gsungs pa'i gdan rnams ni dkar mo la sogs pa rab tu brtag par bya'o/

/de la dbus su hriḥ'i yi ge rnam par bsgom par bya'o/ /de'i shar gyi re'u mig la ni hrīḥ'o/ /lho ru ni ho'o/ /nub tu ni gī'o/ /byang du ni dzi'o/ /me ru ni ham̐ ngo / bden bral du ni dzam̐ ngo / rlung du mam̐ ngo / dbang ldan du ham̐ ngo / dkyil 'khor gyi phyi rol du dgod pa ni me'i mtshams su ni am̐ ngo / /bden bral du ni u'o/ /rlung du ni e'o/ /dbang ldan du ni ai dgod par bya'o/ /shar sgo la dzaḥ'o/ /lho ru ni hūm̐ ngo / /nub tu ni bam̐ mo/ /byang du ni hoḥdagod par bya'o/ /phyi rol du dur khrod brgyad kyis yongs su bskor ba'i dkyil 'khor bsams te/ der dbang po la sogs pa'i 'byung po chen po brgyad po 'jigs par byed par dgod par bya'o/ /shar du ha ri bā sa la/ /lha yi tshogs ni yang dag bri/ /lho ru tsu ta'i shing la ni/ /gshin rje'i gtso bo'i dbang phyug bri/ /nub tu a sho ka gnas su/ /sprin gyi rgyal po der ni dgod/ /de bzhin byang du byang chub shing / /gnod sbyin sde dpon mnyam par gzhag /de bzhin mer na ka rañdzar/ /drang srong tshogs kyis yang dag khyab/ /bden bral la tā dzā ṭir ni/ /srin po la sogs de nas dgod/ /rlung du pārthi ba la ni/ /rlung gi bdag po yang dag bri/ /dbang ldan pa ṭa sd+ya lar ni/ /yi dwags tshogs ni yang dag bri/ /drag bcas dbang bcas nye dbang bcas/ /zla bcas nyi ma gshin rje'i cha/ /rgyas btab rmongs byas zos byas shing / /thal ba'i dngos bcas 'tsho bar byed/ /thabs dang shes rab rnal 'byor gyis/ /g.yon par kha ṭwām̐ brten nas su/ /dril bu sil sil sgra sgrogs shing / /khrag gis bkang ba'i thod pa bsnams/ /g.yas su rdo rje 'bar ba ste/ /'jigs pa yang ni 'jigs par mdzad/ /skyil krung phyed pa byas nas ni/ /nyid kyi brla steng g.yon pa mnan/ /tshangs pa la sogs mnan pa de/ /grags pa nye bar mi za ste/ /kun tu 'od zer sna tshogs kyi/

/sangs rgyas sprin dang mnyam pa 'dis/ /spro ba yang ni sbyin par bya/ /de lta rnal 'byor pas bsgom na/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba ste brtag pa'i rgyal po gsum pa'o// //bcom ldan rnal 'byor rnal 'byor ma'i/ /ngag gi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ci/ /gsang ba nyan par 'tshal lags na/ /thub pa chen pos bshad du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das mkha' 'gro ma rnam par rgyal ba'i stobs zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas mkha' 'gro ma'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya bka' stsal pa/ kolla i ri ṭiṭha a bolla/ mummu ṇi re kakko lā/ gha ṇa kri pīṭṭa ho bādzdza i/ kā ru ṇi ki a i na ro lā/ ta hiṃ ba lā khā dzdza i/ gha ḍe ma a ṇā pidzdza i/ ha le kwa liñdza ra pa ṇi a i/ du dhu ra badzdza a i/ tsa u sa ma kāsd+yū ri sihlā/ kappu ra lā i a i/ ma la indha ṇam̐ shā li dza/ ta hiṃbha ru khā i a i/ phreṃ kha ṇa kheṭṭa ka rante/ shuddha a shuddha na mu ṇi a i/ ṇi ram̐ su ang ge tsa ḍā bi a/ ta hiṃ dza sa rā wa pa ṇi a i/ ma la a dzam̐ kun du ru bāṭṭa i/ ḍeṃ ḍi ma ta hinna badzdza a i/ mu khe gho ghu gu ghu/ mu ghu lu ghu/ draṣṭā/ 'di rnams bltas nas rnal 'byor pas mtshan ma gsungs pa zhes bya ba la spro bar bya'o/ ḍā/ ḍī/ bu/ su/ ma/ yo/ bhi/ dhī/ lu/ satrī/ sa/ pe/ phī/ bha/ bhu/ pī/ bhu/ hī/ ga tri/ ku/ hā/ dzā/ ke/ bha/ swā/ pu/ dzā/ o/ a/ go rā/ de/ mā/ kā/ o/ tri/ ko ka/ la/ kā/ hi/ pre/ gṛ/ sau/ su/ nā/ si/ ma/ ku/ de nas ngag gi tstsho ma yi/ /cho ga'i rim pa bshad par bya/ /gang gis spun dang sring mor yang / /the tshom med par shes bya ba/ /po tam̐ gī dang / pra ti po tam̐ gī dang / ga mu dang / lumba dang / ni ga ra dang / tsa ṭu kam̐ dang / hṛ da yam̐ dang / kau ra ba dang / karṇiṇa kā dang / a li ka ra ṇam̐ dang / ba rā ha dang / shra wa ṇa dang / mantha na dang / na raḥdang / tā li kā dang /

na ra kam̐ dang / a mru kam̐ dang / kā khi lā dang / swa sa ṇam̐ dang / pa ri dhiḥdang / bi ra dhi dang / kru rā dang / antaḥdang / a li kā dang / bha gi nī dang / mu da kam̐ dang / gṛ hā ṇa dang / mu drā dang / danta sparsha dzi hwā dang / gandha bā hi nī dang / ā ga ma nam̐ dang / sd+yā nā ta dang / ki ra ṇaḥdang / go ma dang / nā dā dang / lambo da ra dang / dantaḥdang / ni ro dha dang / bi dzña pti dang / dhurya dang / dhū mra pri yā dang / swa nu dang / sa ri taḥdang / am̐ gulyā dang / wa da nam̐ dang / rā dzi kā dang / a da nā dang / pam̐ kti dang / tstshan do dang / tsa loḥdang / mṛ ga pa ti dang / maṇḍa lam̐ dang / sa mam̐ dang / phal gu ṣam̐ dang / ma hā kṣa ram̐ dang / tstshā/ nā/ go dang / ma dang / bha dang / hā dang / a pya kā dang / sd+ya dang / danta sparsha ne dang / mu kha sparsha ne dang / ho dang / hrī kā dang / shū n+ya sparsha ne dang / u ru sparsha ne dang / steng dang / 'og tu yod pa ni phyag rgya dang phyag rgya'i lan du gsungs so/ yi ge dang ngag gi tstsho ma ste bzhi pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //rdo rje snying po snying rje che/ /yid ni gcig tu gyur pas nyon/ /gzugs can ma dang 'o byed ma/ /lā mā yongs gyur byis bcas mo/ /mi ldog mo dang 'dod pa mo/ /'di dag mkha' 'gro bdun du gsungs/ /mngon par zhen pas lta ba dang / /smin ma yon por gang byed cing / /sngon gyi gzugs ni sdud pa dang / /phyis ni 'jigs par byed pa yang / /de ni gzugs can mar shes bya/ /dpa' bos gnyis med bstan pa 'o/ /sdug pa'am gal te mi sdug pa'i/ /byis pa lta zhing 'o byed ma/ /de ni 'o byed ma shes bya/ /mkha' 'gro mchog kyang de nyid yin/ /byol song lta stangs khro gnyer gdong / /'di ni smin sgyur sdigs par byed/ /gzhan du dbugs kyis 'jigs byed ma/ /de ni lā mār rnam par bstan/ /phag dang ce spyang byi la dang / /rta rnams thams cad 'jigs byed ma/ /de ni yongs gyur ma ru gsungs/

/rab tu dga' zhing gsal bar dgod/ /song ba gyur nas mi ldog ma/ /de ni byis bcas mo ru gsungs/ /gang zhig skyo bas lag pa 'am/ /bong pa 'am ni rkang pas sam/ /gos mtha'am yang na shing gis ni/ /des reg pa ni 'tsho mi 'gyur/ /de ni mi ldog mar shes bya/ /rgod dang smra dang ngu ba dang / /glo bur du ni khro 'gyur ba/ /de ni 'dod pa mar shes bya/ /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor mar gsungs so/ /thod pa dgra sta mche ba dang / chu srid rgyal mtshan ral gri dang / /'phang mdung dang ni bdun du gsungs/ /yang dag sbyor ba'i cho ga 'di/ /rnal 'byor rig pas rtag tu mchod/ /lus srul mo'i mtshan ma dang phyag rgya bzhi pa las rab tu byed gnyis pa'o// //de nas lā mā'i mtshan nyid ni/ /yang dag rab tu bshad par bya/ /dmar zhing dkar ba'i bud med gang / /padma'i 'dab ma lta bu'i 'od/ /dkar po'i gos la rtag dga' zhing / /tsan dan gsar pa'i dri dang ldan/ /bde gshegs 'dus pa nyid la dga'/ /chags shing mthong na rjes 'gro ma/ /khyim du padma 'dri byed pa/ /padma gar dbang rigs las byung / /smin ma'i dbus su rtse gsum son/ /lus ni sngo sangs skya ba dang / /utpal sngon po'i dri dang mtshungs/ /khyim du rdo rje bris nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /he ru ka dpal rigs byung ba/ /de ni mkha' 'gro mar shes bya/ /mig dmar dkar dang dmar ba dang / /de bzhin rkang pa lag pa dmar/ /ra skyes khyim bya dag gis kyang / /rtag tu dga' bar gyur pa dang / /de yi khyim du rdo rje ni/ /bris nas rtag tu mchod byed pa/ /he ru ka dpal rigs byung ba/ /mkha' 'gror 'di la the tsho med/ /'khor lo gang gi dpral ba 'am/ /lag par yang ni mthong gyur pa'i/ /ser zhing sngo sangs bud med gang / /rtag tu gos ser dga' ba nyid/ /me tog dkar po'i dri chen dang / /skal bzang phun sum tshogs ma de/ /khyim du 'khor lo 'dri bar byed/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i rigs rjes 'gro/

/gnag cing sngo sangs bud med gang / /so ni dkar zhing mtho ba dang / /rtag tu gdug pa'i g.yon pa ni/ /skra ni rtag tu grol ba yin/ /rtag tu khrus la dga' ba dang / /spyod cing mang du smra ba dang / /rdo rje khyim du bris nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /rdo rje phag mo'i rigs las byung / /dkar zhing gser dang mtshungs pa dang / /'bar ba'i mig dang ba spu gang / /rdo rje gang gi dpral ba 'am/ /lag par yang ni mthon gyur pa/ /rtag tu rgyal srid dga' ba dang / /snyems shing bden par smra ba dang / /ma li ka yi dri dang ldan/ /khyim du rdo rje bris nas ni/ /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /dum skyes ma yi rigs las byung / /rnal 'byor dbang phyug chen mo mchog /sha la dga' ba'i bud med gang / /mig sman nag po lta bu'i 'od/ /dpral bar mdung rtse'i rnam pa nyid/ /drag shul las la dga' ba gang / /rtag tu dur khrod 'gro gang dang / /'jigs med skyugs bro med pa dang / gang gi dpral bar bsdus nas ni/ /khyim du thod pa 'dri byed cing / /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /he ru ka yi rigs las byung / /char sprin mdog 'dra'i bud med gang / /so ni mi mnyam par gnas shing / /rtag tu drag shul las rnams dang / /g.yon pa'i mche ba byung ba ni/ /khyim du dgra sta 'dri byed cing / /rtag tu mchod pa byed pa ni/ /rnam par 'dren pa'i rigs byung ba/ /de ni mkha' 'gror the tshom med/ /gang gi skra ni li ba dang / /bzhin ni yongs su zlum pa dang / /rtag tu kha la sma ra dang / /smin ma ring zhing ba spu dang / /gos dkar gtsang zhing zhi ba dang / /mi bskyod bden par smra ba dang / /rtag tu dam pa'i chos dga' ba/ /dpa' bo'i sring mor de shes bya/ /padma'i phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /yang na ru sbal phyag rgya bya/ /ril ba spyi blugs mchod byed pa/ /phyag rgya'i lan du brjod par bya/ /de ni tshes bcu'i res dag la/

/khyim du padma 'dri bar byed/ /ma mchu 'phyang zhing mig yangs ma/ /mig ni dmar zhing ser ba dang / /che zhing skal bzang nor dang ldan/ /ser zhing tsam pa lta bu nyid/ /ring zhing lag pa ring ba dang / /sna tshogs gos la dga' ba dang / /ri mo gsum ni dpral ba 'am/ /steng gi mtshams su nges par gnas/ /rgod pa dang ni dga' ba nyid/ /lam gyi rnam pa gnon cing gnas/ /g.yul du shi ba rnams kyi ni/ /gtam la rtag tu dga' ba nyid/ /de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /mdung rtse'i phyag rgya rab bstan bya/ /rkang pa g.yon pa bskums pa yi/ /gar nyid kyang ni rab bstan bya/ /g.yon gyis yongs su bskor ba ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan du brjod par bya/ /bcu bzhi pa dang brgyad pa la/ /khyim du mdung rtse bris shing mchod/ /'jig rten dbang phyug mtshan nyid yin/ /dmar zhing dkar ba'i bud med gang / /mig ni ljang zhing ser ba dang / /de bzhin skra ni 'khyil ba dang / /dar dpyangs bcings par snang ba nyid/ /ri mo gcig par rab tu gnas/ /de bzhin steng du ring ba dang / /rtag tu gos dmar la dga' zhing / /rtag tu rgod cing glu len dang / /glo bur du ni khro ba dang / /khyad par du ni sems g.yo dang / /rtsod pa rtag tu dga' ba nyid/ /de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /'phang mdung phyag rgya rab bstan bya/ /gnyis pa yis kyang 'bad pa yis/ /dril bu'i phyag rgya rab tu sbyin/ /g.yon gyis yongs su bskor ba ni/ /phyag rgya'i lan du brjod par bya/ /thung zhing byin pa sbom pa dang / /rtag tu gos ser dga' ba dang / /mgrin pa nas ni gos 'phyang ba/ /de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /'khor lo'i phyag rgya rab bstan bya/ /gnyis pa'ang rab tu 'bad pas ni/ /dung gi phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /de bzhin yongs su bskor ba nyid/ /de yi dus ni bcu bzhi la/ /khyim du rdo rje 'dri bar byed/ /yan lag kun la ba spur bcas/ /mig ni nag cing ser ba dang /

/gtsigs shing rnam 'gyur 'jigs pa dang / /bzhin sbom kha ni sbom pa dang / /ma mchu 'phyang zhing khung mig dang / /sna ni nyams par gyur pa dang / /rtag tu dri za 'dod pa dang / /sprin gyi kha dog lto che ba/ /de 'dra'i rab myos mthong nas ni/ /klu yi phyag rgya rab sbyin bya/ /gnyis pa yang ni 'bad pa yis/ /'phang mdung phyag rgya sbyin par bya/ /yongs su bskor ba gong ma bzhin/ /de ni bcu gcig tshes la ni/ /mche ba 'dri zhing rtag tu mchod/ /mtshan ma'i phyag rgya ste bzhi pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //de nas yan lag phyag rgya yi/ /mtshan nyid yang dag rab bshad bya/ /bud med gang zhig spyi gtsug reg /spyi bo de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig dpral ba ston pa la/ /mkhur tshos de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig so ni ston pa la/ /lce ni de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig ma mchu ston pa la/ /kos ko de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig mgrin pa reg pa la/ /lto ba de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig lto ba ston pa la/ /lte ba de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig mjug ma ston pa la/ /sa ni de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig gsang ba ston pa la/ /liṅga de la rab bstan pa bya/ /gang zhig pus mo ston pa la/ /byin pa de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig lag pa ston pa la/ /dpung pa de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig rkang pa ston pa la/ /rkang mthil de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig sor mo ston pa la/ /sen mo de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig sa ni ston pa la/ /nam mkha' de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig nam mkha' ston pa la/ /nyi ma de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig chu bo ston pa la/ /rgya mtsho de la rab bstan bya/ /gang zhig sor mo gcig ston pa/ /legs par 'ongs zhes brjod pa yin/ /gang zhig sor mo gnyis ston pa/ /shin tu legs 'ongs brjod pa yin/ /g.yas pa'i smin ma sgyur tshul dang / /g.yon pa'i smin sgyur tshul ston pa/ /slob dpon gnyis dang 'du ba ston/ /rgyud thams cad kyi gsang ba yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i brda ste brtag pa'i rgyal po bzhi pa'o//

//de nas skye bo dam pa kun/ /'du ba yang dag rab bshad bya/ /de la zas gcig bza' bar bya/ /snod gnyis su yang ma lus brtson/ /kye bcom ldan 'das 'du ba'i gnas gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyi bka' stsal pa/ /gnas dang nye ba'i gnas dang ni/ /zhing dang de bzhin nye ba'i zhing / /tstshan do nye ba'i tstshan do ha/ /'du ba de bzhin nye 'du ba/ /dur khrod nye ba'i dur khrod dang / /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod nyid/ /'di rnams sa ni bcu gnyis te/ /sabacu'i dbang phyug mgon po nyid/ /'di ni gzhan gyis brjod mi bya/ /kye bcom ldan 'das gnas la sogs pa gang lags/ de bzhin du sa bcu gnyis po rnams rgya chen po las byung ba bka' drin gyis bskyab tu gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gnas ni dzā lan dha rar gsungs/ /de bzhin du ni o ḍyān nyid/ /gnas ni kolla gi ri dang / /de bzhin ar bu da nyid do/ /nye gnas go dā wa ri nyid/ /de bzhin dga' ba'i dbang phyug dang / /de bzhin de wī ko ṭar bshad/ /de bzhin mā la wa nyid dang / /de bzhin kā ma rū par gsungs/ /o dra zhing ni nyid du gsungs/ /nye zhing tri sha ku ni dang / /de bzhin ko sha la nyid dang / /ka li kar ni ci gsungs pa'o/ /de bzhin lam bā ka nyid dang / /kāñtsi kha ba'i gnas nyid ni/ /tstshan dor yang dag gsungs pa dang / /nye ba yi yang tstshan do 'o/ /pre ta a hi bā si gsungs/ /de bzhin khyim gyi lha nyid dang / /sau rāṣṭa dang gser gling nyid/ /'du ba de bzhin nye 'du ba/ /nā ga ra dang sin dhū ni/ /dur khrod nyid du brjod pa dang / /ma ru dang ni ku lu tā/ /nye ba yi ni dur khrod nyid/ /snying rje de bzhin las kyi brang / /ha ri ke la nyid dang ni/ /lan tshwa'i rgya mtsho'i nang song dang / /bindhā gzhon nu'i grong khyer nyid/ /'thung gcod nye ba'i 'thung gcod dang / /de dang nye ba dur khrod nyid/ /rab song dge 'dun rgya mtsho'i 'gram/

/skyed mos tshal dang rdzing bu'i 'gram/ /nye ba'i dur khrod brjod par bya/ /de nas gnas la lhag par gnas pa'i cho ga bshad par bya ste/ rdul bral gnas su tsu ta gnas/ /kong ka nar ni zla ba'i gling / /ka rañdzar gnas tsā ri tra/ /aṭṭa ha sar ka dampa/ /lha mo'i mkhar du ba ṭa gnas/ /ha ri ke lar hi ra gnas/ /o ḍyān a sho ka ni gnas/ /dzā landha rar gser shing gnas/ /gnas ni rab tu dga' ba'i sa/ /de bzhin nye gnas dri ma med/ /zhing ni 'od byed shes par bya/ /nye ba'i zhing ni 'od 'phro can/ /tstshan do mngon du gyur par nges/ /nye ba'i tstshan do sbyang dka' ba/ /'du ba ring du song ba ste/ /nye ba'i 'du ba mi g.yo ba/ /dur khrod legs pa'i blo gros nyid/ /nye ba'i dur khrod chos kyi sprin/ /pha rol phyin bcu'i sa rnams la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi kla klo'i skad/ /pū la sogs pa ci gsungs pa/ /phyi dang nang du bsam par bya/ /rnal 'byor ma rnams legs 'du ba'i/ /nyin par nyid kyang legs bshad bya/ /yi dwags zla phyed bcu bzhi dang / /brgyad pa la yang khyad par du/ /rgyal mtshan dang ni mtshon bsnun nyid/ /skye ba bdun pa khyad par du/ /'bad pas snying rje bskyed nas ni/ /mkhas pas gsad par bya ba nyid/ /snyeng rje med na mi 'grub pas/ /de phyir snying rje yang dag bshad/ /ji ltar bdag bzhin sems can nyid/ /ji ltar sems can de bzhin bdag /'di ltar sems pa'i rnal 'byor bdag /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /'du ba'i gnas te lnga pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //gsang ba'i padma'i mtshan nyid ni/ /ye shes dbang po nyan par 'tshal/ /ye shes sems dang 'dres pa yi/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim pa ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gnas bzhi mnyam par gnas nas ni/ /rdzogs byang rim pa rdo rje 'dzin/ /mnyam nyid sems ni bskyed nas ni/ /'dod chags la sogs ring du spangs/ /yid dang mthun pa'i gnas su ni/

/bde ba'i stan la 'dug gnas ni/ /brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po kun/ /snying rje phan pa'i sems kyis ni/ /spyi bo med pa'i spyi bo dang / /sgra mtha'i de bzhin gsang padma/ /cha ni sna tshogs yig 'bru rnams/ /de bzhin du yang stan rnams nyid/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje ni/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rnam par byed/ /bsdus nas gong bu'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /rdo rje sems dpar rang nyid 'gyur/ /chu yi khams dang me yi khams/ /ro gcig mchog gi gnas su ni/ /thabs dang shes rab bdag nyid sbyar/ /sangs rgyas gzugs brnyan dbang po drug /bstan bcos tshad ma slob dpon dang / /lung gi rjes 'brang de nyid shes/ /gsang don de nyid dngos po yang / /de nyid las ni gcig las gcig /sngar gyi mtshan nyid thams cad kyis/ /stong sogs de nyid mtshan nyid kyis/ /lus kyi dri ma bkrus nas ni/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim par sbyar/ /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes sems dpa' bsam par bya/ /mdog dkar kun da zla ba yi/ /'od zer rnam par spro ba ni/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /padma'i gnas la yang dag bzhugs/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /sangs rgyas lnga yis rnams par brgyan/ /phyag rgya chen po phyag gnyis kyis/ /snying gi gnas su gzir bar mdzad/ /gzugs dang gzi brjid yongs gang ba/ /ye shes sems dpar bsgom pa nyid/ /chu shing me tog lta bur ni/ /lte ba ru ni yang dag gnas/ /langs nas snying gar kun tu gnas/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid yongs gang ba/ /bton nas dang po'i padma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa shin tu mdzes/ /ze ba dang ni ze 'brur bcas/ /yi ge rnam dgod dgod par bya/ /dkyil 'khor dbus su gnas pa yi/ /phyag gnyis zhal gcig dkar po ni/ /bzang po dri med dbus su bsam/ /de yi dbus su rnam shes dang / /ye shes de nyid sbyar bar bya/ /dang po shar gyi 'dab ma la/ /byams par ldan pa'i mi bskyod pa/

/lho yi sgor ni snying rje nyid/ /rin chen de nyid sa bon las/ /nub kyi sgo yi 'dab ma la/ /'od dpag med pa'i sa bon dgod/ /byang gi sgo yi gnas su ni/ /sems kyi don yod gtso bo nyid/ /dang po'i dbyangs sogs sa bon gyi/ /zla ba'i thig le ji bzhin rim/ /zla ba'i 'od zer dkar brgyan pa'i/ /yi ge bzhi ni dgod par bya/ /mtshams rnams su ni ma ning nyid/ /rnam pa bzhi po sngar gsungs pa/ /de yi dbus su de yi sems/ /yi ge yis ni sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ sems la the tshom 'khrungs lags pa/ /bcom ldan bdag la bshad du gsol/ /ston pa mtshon du med pa la/ /yi ge'i rnal 'byor la sogs ci/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /de nyid ji ltar rdo rje nyon/ /mtshan gzhi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid/ /snying po med pa'i chu shing las/ /snying po bdud rtsi 'bras 'byung ltar/ /'bras bu rnam shes ye shes ni/ /gzugs med pa la ye shes gzugs/ /ye shes sku ni skyon med pa/ /mtshan nyid mtshon du med pa nyid/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol/ /yig 'bru med las yig 'bru'i gzugs/ /de dbus ngo bo stong pa nyid/ /de nyid rnal 'byor pa yis gzung / /ji ltar mtshan nyid shes kyang ni/ /mnyam nyid ye shes sems kyis ni/ /de yi rdzogs pa'i byang chub lam/ /myur ba nyid du mthong bar 'gyur/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /ye shes rnam shes ngo bo las/ /mtshan nyid bstan bcos mdor bsdus pa/ /de nyid dpa' bo ston pa po/ /'di yi bsgom pa thams cad kyi/ /'od zer dkar pos rnam par brgyan/ /lcags sgrog lnga po mchod rten gyi/ /bdud rtsi'i sa bon bsams nas ni/ /kha dog dkar po 'od gsal ba/ /bdud rtsi'i rgyun ni 'dzag par 'gyur/ /snying gi sa bon pad dbus su/ /mthe bong yongs kyi dkyil 'khor 'di/ /de yi dbus su sa bon ni/ ā li kā li yongs btus pa/

/kha dog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /zla ba'i 'od zer 'phro ba ni/ /de yi dbus su sgo rnams kyi/ /thig le bsam par rab tu grags/ /skra yi rtse mo brgya char ni/ /phra rab gzugs su yang dag gnas/ /rnam par shes pa'i rang bzhin las/ /ye shes can gyi mtshan nyid mtshon/ /go 'phang gnas kyi thig le ltos/ /sems kyi mtshan nyid thams cad shes/ /snying la tshangs pa'i sgo yis ni/ /thig le sgo yi lam las ni/ /bla ma'i man ngag brtson pa yis/ /rnam shes ye shes kyi yang blang / /lam gyi phyi rol bstan bcos kyang / /ma yin ring bar 'gyur ba yin/ /bstan bcos rnams ni rnyed sla yang / /sbyor ba de la rnyed par dka'/ /rnal 'byor pa yi thabs kyis ni/ /bla ma gsol ba 'debs la brtson/ /bla ma'i man ngag lam gyis ni/ /rnam par mkhas pas mthong bar 'gyur/ mnyam gzhag dngos po rang bzhin gyis/ /g.yo ba med cing 'tshe ba med/ /yid ni chos rnams sngon du 'gro/ /yid ni dag cing yid ltar mgyogs/ /yid kyi rgyal po'i bka' drin gyis/ /smra ba dang ni byed par 'gyur/ /de phyir yid kyi bdag nyid kun/ /yid la byung bar blo ldan pas/ /snying gar sems bsgom sdom pa ni/ /gal te 'dod na yo gis bzlas/ /rgyu ru gyur pa'i sa bon te/ /de nyid dpyad pas ma yin no/ /'bras bu rgyu yi sa bon te/ /de nyid mthong ba ma yin no/ /gzugs sogs srid pa'i longs spyod kyis/ /dmigs pa'i sa bon rnam pa lnga/ /spyi bo spyi med yang dag gnas/ /kun nas kun tu 'bab par 'gyur/ /rtag tu rtsa ba'i sa bon gyi/ /ye shes rnam shes sa bon las/ /thig le sgra dang yang dag ldan/ /'khor ba'i longs spyod 'dod pa yis/ /yid kyi bzlas pa yang dag ldan/ /yi ge ngag ni rnam par spangs/ /nges par rtag tu go 'phang gnas/ /rtag pa dang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /rtag tu phra zhing skyon med pa/ /ye shes la ni rnam shes nub/ /ye shes dngos pos rnam shes kyi/

/rdzogs pa'i byang chub rim mthong 'gyur/ /dang po mtshan ma thams cad kyi/ /mar me'i rnam pa mthong bar 'gyur/ /gnyis pa mtshan mo me khyer gyi/ /rnam pa'i rdul ni mtshon par byed/ /rdul dkar tsa na ka dbyibs su/ /phyogs bcur de bzhin mthong bar 'gyur/ /gsum par nyon mongs bcom pa ni/ /rnal 'byo pa yis rnam par brtags/ /lha yi longs spyod 'dod pa yang / /bzhi par yang ni bstan pa 'o/ /lha yi gzugs ni thams cad kyang / /lnga par sems kyis brtag par bya/ /drug pa gzugs ni med pa'i cha/ /bdun pa chos kyi dbyings nyid de/ /brgyad par rang 'dod rnal 'byor pa'i/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi 'bras bu'i don/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying rje che/ /yid ni gcig tu gyur pas nyon/ /nges par dngos po thams cad kyi/ /dag pa de bzhin nyid du brjod/ /phyis ni re rer dbye ba yis/ /lha rnams kyis ni brjod par bya/ /lus can rnams kyi phung po dang / /khams rnams dang ni skye mched rnams/ /rang bzhin gyis ni rnam par dag /nyon mongs mi shes sgrib sbyang bya/ /rang rigs bdag nyid dag pa nyid/ /dag pa gzhan gyis rnam grol min/ /yul gyi dngos po dag pa'i phyir/ /rang gis rig pa'i bde ba mchog /gzugs la sogs pa'i yul gang dang / /gzhan yang rnal 'byor pa snang ba/ /de kun rang bzhin dag pa ste/ /de phyir sangs rgyas sna tshogs dngos/ /kye bcom ldan 'das rnam par ma dag pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzugs la sogs pa'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa'i phyir ro/ /gsol ba/ gzung ba dang 'dzin pa gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mig gis gzugs ni gzung bar bya/ /sgra ni rna bas mnyan par bya/ /dri ni sna yis tshor bar bya/ /lce yis ro ni rig par bya/ /lus kyis dngos po rig par bya/ /yid kyis bde sogs thob pa ni/ /dag pas dug med byas nas ni/ /bsten bya 'di dag bsten par bya/

/gzugs ni sangs rgyas rnam snang mdzad/ /tshor ba rdo rje nyi ma ste/ /'du shes padma gar dbang phyug /de bzhin 'du byed rdo rje rgyal/ /rnam shes rdo rje sems dpa' nyid/ /kun gyi ngo bo he ru ka/ /mig la gti mug rdo rje bshad/ /zhe sdang rdo rje mngon thosapa/ /phrag dog rdo rje de bzhin sna/ /kha ni 'dod chags rdo rjer bshad/ /reg la ser sna rdo rje ma/ /khams dang skye mched thams cad ni/ /dam pa'i dbang phyug he ru ka/ /sa yi khams ni ltung byed ma/ /chu khams gsod par byed mar brjod/ /me yi khams ni 'gugs byed ma/ /de bzhin rlung ni gar dbang phyug /nam mkha'i khams su brjod pa ni/ /padma 'bar ba 'khyil ba nyid/ /'di ltar lus can rnams kyi lus/ /phung po la sogs lha bdag nyid/ /bde dang sdug bsngal de bzhin las/ /nyon mongs la sogs des bskyed pa'i/ /bskyed pa'i cha la legs gnas pas/ /srid dang mya ngan 'das pa thob/ /phung po dang skye mched rnam par dag pa ste lnga pa las rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //de nas spyod pas rtog pa rnams/ /'jig par byed pa bshad par byed/ /chos rnams kun la mnyam byung ba/ /de nyid spyod pa gong na med/ /sangs rgyas sras la phan pa'i phyir/ /rdzogs pa'i byang chub rnam gnas pa/ /gang zhig yang ni de nyid las/ /rdo rje yan lag med pa yi/ /shes rab pha rol phyin pa mchog /skye ba'i rgya mtsho 'jigs chen por/ /rga ba'i rlabs kyis 'khrugs pa las/ /sems can thams cad sgrol bar byed/ /tshong pa dge bar 'gro ba dang / /myur du dngos grub gsal byed cing / /snying po yon tan kun gyi gnas/ /sems kyi rin chen las byung ba/ /'dod don rab tu sgrub par byed/ /rdo rje 'dzin pas rab bsngags pa'i/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa'i yon tan kun/ /lus byung 'di las ma gtogs par/ /dga' ba'i dngos grub 'byung mi 'gyur/ /mkhas mchog spyod pa mtshungs med 'di/ /grol bar 'dod pas spyad pa gyis/

/lha yi dgra dang brgya byin dang / /grong khyer sum brtsegs dgra bo dang / /nor sbyin tshangs pa la sogs pas/ /zhabs kyi 'dam skyes mchod pa yis/ /sdig pa 'jigs byed 'di la spyod/ /myur du de bzhin gshegs pa yi/ /gnas kyi mchog ni thob par 'gyur/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpas ni/ /gang zhig 'gro la phan par ni/ /kun 'dar gyi ni spyod pa gsungs/ /de ltar mchog tu bsam yas gnas/ /shin tu gsang ba yo gis bsgom/ /rtog pa thams cad bral bar ni/ /dam tshig la ni spyad par bya/ /rgyu mthun 'bras bu rang bzhin las/ /dang po'i rtsom par yo gi gnas/ /de nas bsgoms pas dub pa na/ /bsdus nas byis pa'i rtse bar bya/ /sna tshogs gdul bya'i 'jig rten la/ /'jam pa'i gzugs can rang nyid bsgom/ /grub par grags pa ma lus pa/ /ci gsungs rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i/ /spyod pas bla na med pa yi/ /kun bzang mtshungs pa med 'grub pas/ /spyod pa nges rig rdo rje can/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal to/ /dpal ldan slob dpon rdo rje can/ /kun gyi mgon la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gsang ba'i spyod pas gnas nas ni/ /blo gros chen po bya ba byas/ /de nas rang gi 'dod sgyur bas/ /sbyor ba kun la kha phyir bltas/ /kun tu seng ge lta bur ni/ /de nyid ldan pas bdag gis spyad/ /ji ltar byung don yang dag rig /'gro ba 'don pa'i bsam pa yis/ /yang dag lta ba rab sgyur bdag /brtan pa'i sems ni gnas med pas/ /phung po khams sogs mtshan nyid ni/ /thams cad rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ /khams gsum 'di dag thams cad ni/ /mdor bsdus nas ni 'dir shes bya/ /sgrib pa kun las rnam par grol/ /'tsho bar dbang phyug 'du ba dang / /de bzhin 'jig rten chos brgyad ni/ /thams cad shin tu ring du spangs/ /rtag tu rtog pa med gyur pas/ /gnyis su med par nges byas nas/ /pha rol phyin drug rnal 'byor gyis/ /sangs rgyas dngos grub rab grub phyir/

/sems can don la legs nus kyang / /sems can yongs su brtag mi bya/ /byang chub la ni sems bzhag nas/ /phyogs las rgyal ba'i spyod pa brtsam/ /thabs/ dang shes rab ldan pa'i bdag /sbyor ba kun la rgyab kyis phyogs/ /de nyid goms par rab byas pas/ /skye ba 'dir ni grub par 'gyur/ /rtog pa kun las rnam par grol/ /sems can bsam pa'i khyad par las/ /sgyu ma ltar sogs rnal 'byor gyis/ /thams cad nyid ni bza' bar bya/ /chos kyi dbyings la yang dag byung / /gang yang kun tu lam grogs med/ /dogs pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /ji ltar 'dod par rab tu bza'/ /longs spyod rdzogs don 'di dag kun/ /khams gsum dag ni ma lus pa/ /sgrub pa po la phan pa'i phyir/ /rdo rje sems dpas rnam par sprul/ /ye shes mtha' yas thob pa yis/ /de bzhin gshegs phyag mi bya na/ /rtag tu sgom pa ldan pa yis/ /dbang bskur med sogs smos ci dgos/ /byang chub sems kyi rang bzhin las/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin 'di/ /de nyid bcom ldan rdo rje can/ /de phyir de nyid lha rnams nyid/ /dkyil 'khor smyung ba mi bya zhing / /phyag rgya mchod rten las mi bya/ /dpal ldan rdo rje mgon pos ni/ /gang yang gzhan du bstan pa rnams/ /lhag par mos pas gnas gang yang / /de rnams kyis kyang de nyid rig /ji ltar bdud rtsi'i don gnyer bas/ /snying po blangs nas dor ba spong / /de ltar chos kyi snying po ni/ /thob nas rtog pa thams cad spangs/ /rtog med gang tshe blo ldan pas/ /dogs pa spangs shing gnas med pa/ /thugs kyi rdo rje ci gsungs bzhin/ /de tshe 'grub 'gyur the tshom med/ /rtog pas dmyal bar 'gro 'gyur te/ /'gro ba drug gi 'khor ba yi/ /rgya mtsho ru ni 'khor bar 'gyur/ /rtog pa med na grol 'gyur zhing / /gnas ni dri med zhi ba nyid/ /de phyir rtog pa'i dgra gzhom phyir/ /dam tshig sangs rgyas mdzad pa gang /

/de ni rtag tu goms par bya/ /gang gis dam tshig gnas gyur pa/ /sngags shes bsam pa'i nus pas bya/ /dngosapo kun la blta bar bya/ /nges par thams cad ma skyes pa'i/ /rnam pa yi ni rnal 'byor gyis/ /khyi dang bong bu rnga mo dang / /glang po la sogs khrag 'thungs nas/ /sha yang rtag tu bza' ba nyid/ /sha chen khrag gis bsgos pa ni/ /thams cad khyad par du ni blta/ /dman pa'i sha ni thams cad dang / /srog chags 'bum phrag brgya ldan bza'/ /rnam snang shin tu rul ba yi/ /srin bu brgya phrag zi zir ldan/ /khyi dang mi skyugs bsres nas ni/ /sha ni rdo rje'i chus gos ldan/ /rnal 'byor pas ni spro ba yis/ /rnam snang bsres nas bza' bar bya/ /rdo rje'i chu ni btung bar bya/ /gang gi tshe 'ga' zhig tu sha'i bza' ba ma rnyed na bza' ba'i don du sha'i gzugs su rnam par brtags te bza'o/ /gang zhig gzhan pa'i 'jig rten za ba de bza' bar bya'o/ /de kho na'i sgrub pa po'i dbang po gang zhig bgrod par bya ba ma yin pa de la bgrod par bya ba dang / gang zhig bya ba ma yin pa de ni de'i bya ba dang / bgrod pa dang bgrod par bya ba ma yin par rnam par rtog pa dang / bza' ba dang bza' bar bya ba ma yin pa dang / sdug pa dang mi sdug pa dang / btung ba dang btung ba ma yin par sngags pas mi bya ste/ sku dang / gsung dang / thugs mnyam par gzhag par 'gyur ro/ /ji ltar yang sems 'khrul pa ma yin pa de ltar chang rnal 'byor pas rtag tu btung bar bya ba dang / dman pas shin tu sgeg pa dang / rigs dang bcas pa dang / rigs med pa dang / sdug cing phongs pa'i sems can thams cad la gcig pa'i tshul gyis rgyal ba lta bur blta ba dang / glegs bam bklag par gsungs pa mi bya ba dang / dkyil 'khor dang me tog bsdu bar mi bya ba dang / sngags kyi bzlas pa mi bya ba dang / lha dang dbang bskur ba la sogs pa la phyag mi bya ba dang / brdzun du smra ba dang / pha rol gyi bud med skal ba bzang mo bsten par bya ba dang /

gdug pa can la byams pa mi bya bar gsungs pa dang / sangs rgyas dang srog chags gsad pa dang / rgyal bas mchod pa'i slob dpon dang / ye shes kyi dam tshig ni sems can de dam tshig gis rtag tu dngos grub sna tshogs sbyin par byed de/ blo dang ldan pa la phyogs bcur rnam par bzhugs pa mchod par byed do/ /gang gi phyir rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa'i bsod nams gang zhig slob dpon gyi ba spu'i khung bu'i rtse mo la mthong ba de'i phyir byang chub sems dpas slob dpon la sangs rgyas kyis mchod pa byed pa mthong ngo / /nges par rang gi dam tshig sangs rgyas 'dod pas dngos grub sbyin par byed pas bla ma dam pa la smad par mi bya ba dang / rdo rje spun la mi gus par mi bya ba dang / gang zhig byin pa de bzung nas mchod rten la phyag mi bya ba dang / spun dang / bu dang / pha dang / rgyal srid kyi longs spyod dang / gter dang / nor dang / 'bru thams cad la rtswa lta bur mthong nas khams gsum gyi rgyal po bsgrub par bya'o/ /'khyud pa'i spyod pa ste lnga pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //de nas yang dag rab bshad bya/ /spyod pa pha rol phyin mtshan nyid/ /gang gi ring nas shes pa de/ /rdo rje yo gir the tshom med/ /mkha' 'gro ma sogs gtor ma ni/ /ji ltar rnyed dang bza' btung ni/ /de bzhin rnal 'byor pa yis bza'/ /ro yi dkris ma'i gos bzang dang / /ro bsregs thal bas rnam par brgyan/ /phru chag shin tu gsang bar ni/ /mtshan mo'i dus su rgyu bar bya/ /bzhi mdo dang ni ri bo dang / /shing gcig gam ni dur khrod dang / /bzhir ni de nas sngags pa yis/ /bsgom pa bzang po bya bar brjod/ /ma mo'i khyim dang mtshan mo dang / /yang na dben pa'am bas mthar ni/ /cung zad drod ni thob pa yis/ /gal te spyod pa byed 'dod na/ /bdag nyid gal te 'grub 'dod pas/ byis pa bzhin du spyad nas ni/ /sems can rjes su gzung ba'i rgyur/

/blo ldan chen pos rgyu bar bya/ /zhen pa med pa'i sems kyis ni/ /kha dog can gyi rtag sgrib pa/ /ba spu'i khung bu'i bu ga nas/ /phyogs bcu rnams su dbyung bar bya/ /'jam pa'i rdo rjer rang gyur nas/ /dkyil 'khor par ni rab tu brtag /padma'i tshal ni nyams dga' bar/ /chu bo 'dus pa rnams su yang / /der gnas rnal 'byor pas bsgoms na/ /dngos grub myur du thob par 'gyur/ /phug gam ri yi rtse mor ni/ /shin tu mnyam par bzhag pas gnas/ /ji ltar rnyed pa bzhin du bza'/ /zos shing zos nas gtor ma sbyin/ /'bras bu sna tshogs do shal sogs/ /'ol ma zi sogs de bzhin spras/ /srog chags yan lag gos gyon zhing / /bde don gnyer la bde ba sbyin/ /res 'ga' legs sbyar zur chag ni/ /bzlog pa yis ni 'don pa byed/ /bza' dang bza' min ci snyed pa/ /smyon pa'i sbyor bas bza' bar bya/ /gzhan pa'i yul 'khor grub pa dang / /ri yi phug dang tshang tshing dang / /gdod nas grub pa'i dur khrod che/ /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du yang / /der gnas shes rab can gyis bsgom/ /skrag pa thams cad rnam spangs te/ /de ltar byas nas rnal 'byor pas/ /yang ni phyogs las rnam rgyal brtsam/ /sgrib pa kun las rnam par grol/ /phyogs bcur rnam par gnas pa yi/ /skye ba'i sgrib pas bsgribs pa yi/ /kun gyi bsam pa 'gengs par byed/ /gzung ba dang ni 'dzin pa kun/ /bsgom pas spangs shing rnams par spangs/ /'dis ni bsgoms pa thams cad kyis/ /phyogs las rnam rgyal mngon par brjod/ /de ltar re zhig gnas byas nas/ /de nyid mi shigs rnal 'byor pas/ /rig ma'i lha mo 'dod pa yi/ /shin tu gzugs can bsdus nas bya/ /chus byung yid 'ong rin chen dang / /rig pa 'dzin pa'i nyams dga' 'am/ /lha yi bu mo gnod sbyin mo/ /yang na klu mo rkang 'og tu/ /gnas pa dang ni lha min mo/ /'di nang yo gis rig ma gcig /rang gi sems la mngon 'dod pa/

/lcags kyu zhags pa'i rab sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor pa yis bkug nas bsgrub/ /nye bar dgos pa rgyas pa kun/ /ma bslangs par ni lha yis ster/ /rga dang nad las rnam par grol/ /gnyis med gnas gsum sdig pa med/ /lus kyis sbyin pa byin nas ni/ /phyis ni spyod pa yang dag brtsam/ /skal dang skal med rnam dpyad pas/ /de phyir sbyin pa sbyin mi bya/ /bza' bca' de bzhin btung ba nyid/ /ji ltar rnyed pa bza' bar bya/ /yid 'ong mi 'ong rnam rtog phyir/ /zhen pa tsam du mi bya 'o/ /bslab dang dbang las rnam par grol/ /de bzhin ngo tsha'i bya ba nyid/ /dngos po kun gyi rang bzhin gyis/ /yo gis rnal dpyad snying rje che/ /mchod sbyin sbyin sreg dka' thub 'das/ /sngags dang bsam gtan rnam par spangs/ /dam tshig sdom las rnam par grol/ /shin tu rnal 'byor ldan spyod kyis/ /nges par sngon du lha min gang / /brgya byin lta bu yin na yang / /de la 'jigs par mi bya ste/ /seng ge'i gzugs kyi sa rnam par rgyu/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /rtag tu snying rjes btung bar bya/ /rnal 'byor btung dga' rnal 'byor pa/ /gzhan gyi btung bas bzi ba med/ /yang na dpal ldan rgyal tshab che'i/ /brtul zhugs spyod pa bsgrag par bya/ /gang gis dngos grub mthar 'gro ba/ /sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir/ /sgom pa po yis rnam gzung ba/ /rna ba dag la rna cha bzang / /spyi bor 'khor lo rnam par 'dzin/ /lag pa dag la lag gdub nyid/ /rked pa la ni ska rags nyid/ /rkang par de bzhin rkang gdub bo/ /dpung pa'i rtsa bar dpung rgyan nyid/ /mgrin pa la ni nor bu ste/ /bgo ba stag gi pags pa nyid/ /bza' ba mi 'chi bcu phyed de/ /he ru ka sbyor skyes bu nyid/ /mnyam par gzhag pas gnas par bya/ /shin tu bzhin bzang mig yangs ma/ /rang gis dbang bskur snying rje can/ /rdo rje'i bu mo 'di khyer nas/ /spyod pa brtul zhugs rtogs par bya/

/rdo rje'i rigs kyi dngos med na/ /gang zhig rang gi 'dod pa'i lha'i/ /rigs kyis kyang ni bya ba 'o/ /yang na gzhan gyi rigs byung ba/ /byang chub sa bon bcug pa yis/ /sbyang ba byas te khyer nas ni/ /gang tshe rdo rje mchog ldan par/ /de tshe glu ni blang bar bya/ /gang tshe dga' ba skyes pa na/ /thar pa'i rgyur ni gar bya ste/ /de tshe rdo rje rkang pas gar/ /rtag tu rnal 'byor pa yis bya/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyis mi bskyod pa/ /rna cha'i bdag nyid 'od dpag med/ /mgul gyi phreng bar rin chen bdag /lag par rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /ska rags la ni don yod gnas/ /shes rab kha ṭwāṃ ga gzugs can/ /thabs kyi gzugs kyis cang te 'u/ /sman ni rnam par bza' bar bya/ /chu ni rtag tu btung bya ste/ /rga shis zil gyis mi non cing / /kun tu bsrung bar gyur pa de'i/ /rkun ma'i skras kyang cod pan bya/ /de la hūm̐ byung sbyar bar bya/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi thod pa rnams/ /rnal 'byor spyod pas rnam par 'dzin/ /sor lnga'i dum bur byas nas ni/ /cod pan la ni rnam par 'dzin/ /thabs dang shes rab rang bzhin las/ /skra yi ska rags nyis skor nyid/ /thal ba skra yi mchod phyir thogs/ /rnal 'byor pa yi spyod pas 'dzin/ /cang te'u'i sgra ni bzlas pa ste/ /sems can thams cad mgron gnyer ba'o/ /kha ṭwāṃ ga ni shes rab ste/ /rdo rje bzlas dang bsgom pa yin/ /thod pa can du rang gyur pa/ /brkam dang rmongs dang de bzhin 'jigs/ /khro dang ngo tsha'i bya ba ni/ /rtag tu rnam par spang bar bya/ /he ru ka bdag rnal 'byor pa/ /rigs lnga la ni gnas par bya/ /rigs lnga dag dang mnyam par ldan/ /rigs ni gcig tu rnam par brtag /rigs gcig du ma nyid kyis ni/ /gang phyir dbye bas bskyed mi bya/ /bdag nyid kyis ni gnyid spangs nas/ /the tshom med par spyod pa bya/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba las/ spyod pa'i brtag pa ste lnga pa'o//

//lha lags nyan par 'tshal lags na/ /rang byin brlab pa'i rim ci lags/ /gsang ba la sogs dgongs pa ci/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying rje che/ /yid ni gcig tu gyur pas nyon/ /thams cad rgyud kyi gtan phab pa/ /mdor bsdus nas ni bsgrag par bya/ /e yi rnam pa gang gsungs pa/ /gnas kyi mtshan nyid mi gsal bar/ /'gro dang rjes su 'ong ba nyid/ /khams dang sems kyi rtag 'gro ba'o/ /khams zhes bya ba'i sgra du lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /'di ltar gsang ba'i yi ge bcu drug brjod par bya ste/ ra yi rnam pa khrag gi khams/ /ha ni de bzhin reg bya nyid/ /sye ni bad kan zhes byar gsungs/ /pa yi rnam pa sems nyid dang / /ra yi rnam pa ro nyid de/ /me ni de bzhin lto tshil dag /ra ni me nyid du ni gsungs/ /me yi rnam pa sha ru gsungs/ /sa yi rnam pa bshang bar gsungs/ /rbā yi rnam pas de bzhin tshil/ /tman pags pa nyid du gsungs/ /ni yi rnam par rus pa nyid/ /sa ni gci pa nyid du gsungs/ /dā yi rnam pas glo ba nyid/ /sd+yi ni padma nyid du gsungs/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i rdzas dang ldan/ /ta yi rnam pas khu ba ni/ /byang chub sems las byung ba yin/ /rtsa yi sgra yi rang bzhin las/ /de ltar lha mo bsgrags pa yin/ /byang chub sems kyis rang bzhin las/ /cha yi bdag nyid 'gyur ba nyid/ /ra ni me zhes bya bar gsungs/ /khrag las mkhris pa yang dag langs/ /mtshan nyid gcig 'dod bad kan las/ /rngul dang chu rgyus yang dag byung / /de yi mgon por brjod pa'i rlung / /ha ni kun du 'gro bar gsungs/ /rus pa'i mtshams ni 'di rnams su/ /sa bon lnga ni yang dag btab/ /rkan du ra dang thams cad du/ /sa bon bzhi ni dam pa nyid/ /dang po'i re'u mig gnas der ni/ /sa bon lnga ni mdzes pa nyid/ /ha ni dbyangs kyi drug ldan pa/ /rnam par shes par yongs su grags/ /ha yi rnam pas thams cad du/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam par sbyor/

/sgra yi tshul las byung bton zhing / /dam tshig spyod pa'i spyod yul nyid/ /'jig rten gsum du rnyed dka' ba/ /thog ma dbus mtha' yang dag gnas/ /bsrub dang srub byed sbyor ba las/ /ji ltar ba ni de bzhin no/ /sngags bzlas bsam gtan la sogs ldan/ /rgyud las gsungs pa mnyan par gyis/ /rtsa gnyis skye gnas dbus su ni/ /g.yon dang g.yas su de bzhin du/ /g.yon du khu ba rnam shes bya/ /g.yas pa la ni khrag nyid de/ /de yi phan tshun bsdu ba yang / /chos kyis dbyings ni sdud pa yin/ /snying stobs sku dang rdul dag bcas/ /mun pa sems kyi rang bzhin las/ /snying stobs khu ba rin chen rdul/ /mun pa skyed par byed pa nyid/ /rdo rje pad mo mnyam sbyor bas/ /dngos dang dngos med ro gcig 'gyur/ /bshang ba gci ba bad kan dang / /khrag dang lnga pa khu ba nyid/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi gong bu dngos/ /de phyir rdo rje can du brjod/ /rus pa rkang dang khu ba ni/ /pha las skyes par de bzhin gsungs/ /pags pa dang ni sha dang khrag /ma lus skyes pa zhes byar bsgrags/ /gong bu'i bsdu ba rnams kyi yang / /tshad ni 'di dag gsungs pa ste/ /gong bu gcig pu gnyis su 'gyur/ /gnyis su gyur pa du ma rnams/ /gcig pu du ma'i rang bzhin gyis/ /de phyir rdo rje can 'dir gsungs/ /rtsa yi kun spyod nyid gsungs pa/ /de yi sgo yang de gnyis la/ /de rnams 'du ba'i dus su ni/ /lha ni dmigs par 'gyur ba yin/ /steng gi sgo dang 'og nyid de/ /'og gi sgo ni rnam par shes/ /steng gi sgo ni dbyings nyid do/ /rtsa ni thams cad mnyam sbyor bas/ /rnal 'byor pas ni 'jug par bsam/ /de yi lus kyi steng sgo la'ang / /rdo rje can gyi rtag rgyun zhugs/ /steng gi sgor ni sbyor ba gsum/ /sgo dgu rnams kyis yongs su bskor/ /kye bcom ldan 'das/ sbyor ba gsum ni ci zhes bshad/ /ji ltar gang gi rnam pa yis/

/sems kyi rtag tu 'gro ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /gsum nyid sbyor ba sbyor ba gsum/ /rnam gsum dbye bas rnam par gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi rang bzhin gyis/ /tha ma 'bring po dam pa nyid/ /ka ba gcig dang sgo dgu pa/ /sbom po lnga ni lhag pa'i lha/ /bug pa dgur ni son pa'i sgo/ /dgu yi rnam par yongs su grags/ /tha ma'i sgo ni skur ldan pa/ /sbom po lha yi sprul pa 'o/ /sems dang skyes bu skyes bu can/ /khyed par rnal 'byor pa yi don/ /rtag par kun tu dus su ni/ /'gro dang 'ong ba'i khyad par las/ /rkang med rkang gcig rkang gnyis dang / /rkang bzhi la ni sogs pa yi/ /rlung la sogs pas rab dbye bas/ /rtag tu 'gro ba rlung rnam bzhi/ /sems kyi gnas pa rnam pa gnyis/ /nub dang rab rgyu'i cho ga yi/ /rtag tu nub dang rab rgyu ba/ /sems can kun la 'gro ba 'o/ /de ltar gang zhig mi rig pa/ /sems med skyed bu med pa dang / /yid dang ldan pa med pa dang / /rnal 'byor pa yi don med pa/ /me nyid gang dang rlung dang ni/ /dbang chen dang ni de bzhin chu/ /'khor lo sems kyi kun spyod pa/ /steng dang ngos dang brang 'og 'gro/ /zla ba nyi ma'i rab dbye bas/ /gsum pa'i sgo ni yid dang bcas/ /rngub dang dbyung ba gnyis ka yang / /sgo yi dam pa nyid yin te/ /gtso bo dam pa yi ni sgo/ /steng dang 'og tu rab tu grags/ /'og gi sgos ni rnam par shes/ /steng gi sgos ni dbyings nyid de/ /rnam snang la sogs sangs rgyas rnams/ /steng gi sgor ni g.yo zhing gnas/ /de rnams 'og tu rnam par gnas/ /steng gis gshegs su gsol ba nyid/ /spyan drangs gshegs su gsol ba yi/ /tshul gyis sems kyis rtag tu 'gro/ /dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad dang / /mkha' 'gro rnal 'byor ma mo rnams/ /'jug pa dang ni ldog pa la/ /yon tan skyon ni rab brjod pas/ /bde dang sdug bsngal rang bzhin gyis/

/lhan cig skyes pa grub pa'i gnas/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde chen po/ /bcom ldan rdo rje can gyis gsungs/ /de nas bcom ldan lha mos ni/ /bolla kakko lar bcug nas/ /sems dpa' chen po mnyes byas te/ /tshig ni 'di dag yang dag gsol/ /dpyid ces bgyi ba ji ltar lags/ /thig le bgyi ba ji ltar lags/ /mi phyed la sogs ji ltar gnas/ /de yi gnas ni ji ltar lags/ /pullī ra sogs ci gsungs dang / /'khor lo dgod pa de bzhin gzhan/ /ji ltar rtsa yi rdzogs pa yi/ /de yi dbye ba bdag la gsungs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /lha mo bshad par bya yis nyon/ /gsang ba las ni ches gsang mchog /rtsa'i rang bzhin dang / gnas la sogs pa dang / sa bcu dang / pha rol tu phyin pa'i sku dang / gsung dang / thugs kyi 'khor lor son pa gnas kyi nang gi rab tu dbye bas nyi shu rtsa bzhir gsungs pa/ spyi bo mā la ya yi yul/ /de bzhin spyi gtsug 'bar ba 'dzin/ /de bzhin du ni o ḍyān nyid/ /rna ba g.yas pa nyid du brjod/ /rtsib ma'i rgyab ni arbu da/ /bzhi ni gnas shes bya ba 'o/ /rna ba g.yon pa'i rang bzhin ni/ /de bzhin go dā ba rir shes/ /dga' ba'i dbang phyug bshad pa ni/ /smin ma'i dbus gnas rab tu bskul/ /de bzhin mig dag lha mo'i mkhar/ /lag pa'i rtsa bar mā la wa/ /de ltar nye ba gnas nyid de/ /thugs kyi 'khor lor rnam par gnas/ /gnas kyi khyad par rang bzhin gyi/ /mkha' spyod rnams kyi yang dag bshad/ /mchan khung kā ma rū pa nyid/ /nu ma o drar rab tu grags/ /'di dag zhing du yang dag brjod/ /lte ba tri sha ku nir brjod/ /sna yi rtse mor ko sha lā/ /nye ba'i zhing du brjod pa 'o/ /kha ni ka ling ka ru brjod/ /mgrin pa lam pa ka ru gsungs/ /tshan do ha zhes rnam par bshad/ /snying ni kāñtsir brjod pa ste/ /dbang po hi ma la ya nyid/ /nye ba yi ni tshan dor brjod/ /de ltar yul rnams thams cad du/

/gsung gi 'khol lor rnam par gnas/ /gnas kyi khyad par yul gyi ni/ /sa spyod rnams kyi yang dag bshad/ /rtags la yi dwags lhag par gnas/ /gsang ba la ni khyim gyi lha/ /'di dag 'du bar brjod pa 'o/ /brla ni sau rāṣṭa ru brjod/ /rje ngar gnyis ni gser gling gi /rang gi ngo bor rnam par bshad/ /nye ba yi ni 'du ba nyid/ /sor mo nā ga ra ru brjod/ /rkang pa'i rgyab ni sin dhur nges/ /dur khrod du ni yang dag brjod/ /mthe bong la ni ma ru zer/ /pus mo ku la dā ru brjod/ /'di dag nye ba'i dur khrod nyid/ /mkha' 'gro mar ni gsungs pa 'o/ /'di dag yul dang rang lus skyes/ /rang gi nang dang phyi rol gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi 'khor lo la/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhir phye ba yis/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni kun gyi gnas/ /thams cad du ni yang dag bshad/ /'di rnams gnas su mkha' 'gro ma/ /rtsa yi gzugs kyis yang dag gnas/ /drug pa las rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //de nas gzhan yang dam pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku ji ltar gnas su son pa'i rtsa'i 'khor lo bshad par bya'o/ /snying gi nang song padma ni/ /'dab ma brgyad pa snying por bcas/ /de yi nang du son pa'i rtsa/ /mar me'i rang gi ngo bo can/ /chu shing gi ni me tog ltar/ /brkyang zhing kha ni 'og tu 'o/ /de yi nang gnas dpa' bo ni/ /yungs kar gyi ni sbom phra tsam/ /mi shigs hūm̐ gi sa bon ni/ /kha ba lta bur 'dzag pa nyid/ /lus can rnams kyi snying dga' ba/ /dpyid ces bya bar rnam par bshad/ /rgod ma'i me yi gzugs kyis ni/ /bdag med ma ni thig ler brjod/ /las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis/lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni 'bar/ /dpyid thob pa yi chog shes pas/ /snyoms par 'jug pas rnam par gnas/ /dpa' bo shrī ni he ru ka/ /'di ni dpyid kyi thig ler brjod/ /rnal 'byor ma yi gzugs 'dzin ma/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu bcas par gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye bas ni/

/sgo ni rnam gsum 'byung ba las/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong bar byed/ /'di ni kun gyi lus la gnas/ /lte ba a yi gzugs kyis ni/ /thung ngu ru ni rab tu grags/ /snying la yang ni hūm̐ nyid ni/ /ring po ma mo gnyis dang gnas/ /mgrin pa oṃ gyi gzugs kyis ni/ /ma mo gsum brjod pa lu ta/ /dpral bar haṃ gi rnam pa 'di/ /sgra dang thig le mi shigs pa/ /'khor lo bzhi yi rab dbye bas/ /sa sogs 'byung ba chen po dang / /thun bzhir byin gyis brlabs pa dang / /padma bzhi las byung ba dang / /dga' ba bzhi yi ngo bo yis/ /rnal 'byor bzhi ni mngon du 'o/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i ngo bo yis/ /bya ba dbye ba'i dngos po las/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs kyis ni/ /'di ni ji ltar bde bar rol/ /'dab ma rnams kyi bzhi la yang / /'byung ba bzhi yi rtsa rnams ni/ /mar me'i rang bzhin lta bur ni/ /phyogs bzhi la ni rnam par gnas/ /rtsa rnams bzhi yang mtshams rnams su/ /rnam par gnas shing der son pa'ang / /bdud rtsi lnga ni 'bab pa ste/ /de mchod rang gi gzugs gnas pas/ /de yi dngos po'i ngo bo las/ /mchod pa bzhi ni rnam par bshad/ /lus kyi snying gi nang du ni/ /rtsa lnga rnams ni rnam par gnas/ /sku gsung thugs kyi dbye ba yis/ /nyi shu rtsa bzhi nye bar brjod/ /gnas sogs dbye ba la gnas nas/ /gnas dang gnas la rnam par gnas/ /spyi bor yang dag byung ba yi/ /rtsa ni spyi bo skyes zhes brjod/ /rdul dang snying stobs mun pa'i tshul/ /de yi nang nas gtso mo ni/ /pullī rar ni mi phyed ma/ /so dang sen mo 'bab par brjod/ /'bar ba 'dzin pa phra gzugs ma/ /de bzhin skra dang ba spu 'bab/ /o ḍyān gnas ni chen po la/ /rtse ba ma ni rnam par gnas/ /rna ba g.yas par gnas nas ni/ /pags pa dri ma 'bab ma gnas/ /arbu dar ni g.yon pa ma/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni sha 'bab ma/ /gang zhig chu rgyus 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /ba yi mchog sbyin rnam par gnas/

/de ni sra ba'i tshul gyis gnas/ /thung ngu mar ni rnam par bshad/ /gang zhig dga' ba'i dbang phyug rtsa/ /de bzhin rus sbal skyes mar grags/ /sra ba'i dngos pos gnas pa'i phyir/ /rus pa'i phreng ba 'khrugs par gnas/ /lha mo'i mkhar du gang zhig rtsa/ /'jam pa sgom pa ma ru brjod/ /de ni rtag tu mchin pa 'bab/ /thams cad lus la rtag par gnas/ /mā la bar ni dbang ma ni/ /rgyal ba'i dbang phyug snying la gnas/ /rtsa ni gang zhig mig 'bab ma/ /'dod pa'i gzugs su rnam par gnas/ /gzugs ni mthong bar 'dod pa ste/ /skyon bral ma zhes rnam par bshad/ /o ḍir mkhris pa 'bab pa'i rtsa/ /gang zhig 'jug ma chen mor brjod/ /tri sha ku ner byung ba ni/ /ma mo nges par glo bar bcas/ /ko sha lar ni mtshan mo nyid/ /rgyu ma'i phreng bzang khyab cing 'bab/ /ka ling kar ni bsil sbyin ma/ /ngos kyi chu rgyun yang dag bshad/ /tsha ba ma ni lto gnas nges/ /lam pā kar ni rab tu grags/ /'bab ma nyid ni kāñtsir gnas/ /thams cad du ni bshang ba 'bab/ /mtshams kyi mtha' yi nang du yang / /kha ba'i gnas su rangs ma'i gdong / /shin tu gzugs can bad kan ldan/ /yi dwags lha gnas yang dag gnas/ /gang zhig rtag tu rnag 'bab pa/ /khyim gyi lha ni yang dag gnas/ /mkha' 'gro dam pa'i dbang phyug gis/ /spyi ma nyid du rnam par bshad/ /sau rāṣṭar ni gang zhig rtsa/ /rgyu sbyin ma ni dmar po 'bab/ /rdul ni 'bab par gyur pa ni/ /gser gling du ni yang dag bshad/ /yan lag gzi brjid kun khyab ma/ /sbyor bral mar ni rab tu grags/ /nā ga rar ni sdu gu ma/ /tshil can sbom zhing myos byed 'bab/ /sin dhur shin tu grub pa nyid/ /mya ngan mchi ma 'bab mar brjod/ /ma rur gnas ma lud skam 'bab/ /'tshed pa ma zhes rnam par bstan/ /gu lu twar ni yid bzang ma/ /sha dang snabs ni 'bab ma 'o/ /drug pa las yul gyi dgod pa ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //lha lags mnyan par 'tshal lags na/

/nang gi dkyil 'khor mchod pa la/ /sogs pa'i las ni ji ltar lags/ /sbyin sreg las ni mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /he ru ka la sogs pa'i lha/ /rtsa gzugs mdzes par yang dag byung / /lus kyi dkyil 'khor nyams dga' bar/ /sgo bzhir ji skad gsungs pa 'o/ /rang gi yan lag brgyad byung bas/ /ka ba de yis bskor nas gnas/ /dngos po kun gyis mnyam pa'i phyir/ /gru bzhi par ni rab tu grags/ /sku gsung thugs kyi ngo bos ni/ /dkyil 'khor 'khor lo gcig tu gsungs/ /ri ni mgo bo'i ze 'bru la/ /ji ltar rtsom chen la sogs rim/ /bla ma'i dus thabs rim nyid kyis/ /de ni rdzogs pa'i dkyil 'khor gnas/ /rkang pa'i mthil du rtsom chen rlung / /gzhu yi dbyibs su rnam par gnas/ /sum mdo yi ni gnas su ni/ /de bzhin gru gsum 'bar ba nyid/ /zlum po'i rnam pa'i dbyibs kyis ni/ /chu ni lte bar rnam par gnas/ /snying gar yang ni sa nyid de/ /kun nas grub bzhi pa nyid do/ /sgal tshigs dbyug gu'i gzugs kyis ni/ /ri rab ri rgyal de bzhin no/ /der ni spyi bo'i 'char gnas pa/ /'dam skyes 'dab ma sum cu gnyis/ /dbyangs dang gsal byed mdzes par gnas/ /sum cu rtsa gnyis byang chub 'dod/ /padma'i nang du son pa gang / /de ni zla ba'i dkyil 'khor brjod/ /spyi bo'i nang du klad pa ni/ /gang zhig gnas pa de ru gsungs/ /de nang ham̐ gi rnam pa nyid/ /theg le'i gzugs can mi shigs pa/ /'jig rten kun gyi rtsa ba de/ /brtan pa'i bdag nyid g.yo ba'i bdag /gsal dang mi gsal gzugs las ni/ /sa bon gzugs kyi rnam par gnas/ /lus can rnams ni kun gyi gzugs/ /de phyir gdod nas rdzogs pa nyid/ /bdud rtsi'i gzugs kyis 'dzag pa ni/ /nyin dang mtshan du rnam par gnas/ /de nyid kyis ni sgra 'byed cing / /me ni dga' bar byed pa ste/ /des ni gang ba'i dkyil 'khor ni/

/yin pa nyid du the tshom med/ /de nyid dkyil 'khor zhes byar gsungs/ /dngos po rnams kyi snying po mchog /de ni len cing gcod pa'i phyir/ /lus ni dkyil 'khor nyid du brjod/ /rtsa chen sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi/ /'khor lor yang ni dkyil 'khor brjod/ /byang chub sems ni rin po che/ /dkyil 'khor de nyid dkyil 'khor nyid/ /phyi rol bcas pa'i nang gzugs kyis/ /sna tshogs khyab cing rnam par gnas/ /phyi rol gzugs dang sgra la sogs/ /dbang po thams cad 'jug pa 'o/ /nang gi khu ba la sogs pa/ /grub pa'i rdzas ni rnam par gnas/ /phyi rol bcas pa'i nang nyid kyis/ /rdo rje can gyi byang chub sems/ /sbom dang phra ba'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'gro ba'i gnyen gyi rang bzhin can/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /dam tshig don du gsungs pas ni/ /dkyil 'khor goms pas skye ba 'dir/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni thob par 'gyur/ /nyan thos rnams kyis sangs rgyas dang / /de bzhin rang rgyal rnams kyi dang / /tshangs pa la sogs lha rnams kyi/ /dkyil 'khor goms pas rdzogs pa nyid/ /shes rab me ni cher 'bar bar/ /nang gi khu ba la sogs dang / /de bzhin phyi rol gzugs sogs kyi/ /bsreg rdzas kyis ni sbyin sreg bya/ /skye mched drug dang khams rnams dang / /phung po la sogs khyad par las/ /de rnams kyi ni gzugs can lha/ /de bzhin mkha' 'gro ma nyid ni/ /des ni de mchog gang gi phyir/ /rnal 'byor mchod par yang dag bshad/ /thod pa 'di ni mgo bo nyid/ /bsreg rdzas kyi ni snod du gsungs/ /blugs gzar ro mar bshad pa ste/ /snying gi 'khor lo brkyang ma dag /dgang gzar zhes bya yang dag brjod/ /thab khung lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du/ /las kyi rlung gis bskyod pa yi/ /tshangs pa'i me ni sum 'dor gnas/ /sgra ni sngags zhes brjod pa ste/ /bzlas pa 'khor bar byed pa yin/ /bsgom pa mtshungs par snang ba nyid/ /dkyil 'khor gnyis med rnal 'byor phyir/

/lhan cig skyes pa zhon pa 'di/ /'di ni rgyal ba'i dkyil 'khor gsungs/ /dkyil 'khor bdag po'i gzugs kyi phyir/ /slob dpon sems kyi rgyal po nyid/ /de skad la sogs ci gsungs pa/ /rgyud ni thams can rtogs par bya/ /da dung bdag la the tshom mchis/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang / /bde ba chen po'i gzugs kyis ni/ /mgon po ji ltar rol bar 'gyur/ /de rnams dbye ba mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /spyi bo lter son 'khor lo ni/ /e yi dbyibs su yang dag gnas/ /snying dang mgrin par yang dag gnas/ /bam̐ gyi rnam pa lta bur brjod/ /lte ba'i nang gnas padma ni/ /'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhir ldan/ /'dam skyes 'dab ma sum cu gnyis/ /spyi bo'i nang du rnam par gnas/ /mgrin pa'i nang du son pa yang / /padma lo ma bcu drug nyid/ /de yi snying ga'i gnas su ni/ /padma 'dab ma brgyad du brjod/ /'dab ma drug cu rtsa bzhi nyid/ /sprul pa la ni rab tu grags/ /padma chen po 'dab brgyad par/ /chos kyi sku ni rab tu bskor/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa bcu drug rtsibs/ /de bzhin 'dam ma sum cu gnyis/ /bde chen ye shes chen po la/ /kun tu yang dag rnam par gnas/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo'i dbus su ni/ /sde tshan brgyad kyis yongs su bskor/ /yig 'bru dang po'i ngo bo yis/ /'di ni a ste yi ge mchog /chos kyi 'khor lor rnam bshad pa/ /hūm̐ ni mi shigs pa ru brjod/ /dbyangs lnga dang ni yang dag ldan/ /ya ra la was rnam par brgyan/ /longs spyod 'khor lo'i nang gnas pa/ /oṃ ni yig 'bru gsal bar byed/ /cha ni rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /kun tu yongs su bskor ba 'o/ /bde chen 'khor lo chen po la/ /ham̐ ni thig le'i gzugs can no/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i ngos dag la/ /zla ba nyi ma rnam par bshad/ /mgrin pa nas brtsams g.yon pa'i rtsa/

/longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku can ma/ /lte ba'i nang du ngal sos shing / /kha ni 'og tu myos byed 'bab/ /gang zhig lte ba las stengs rtsa/ /de bzhin kha ni steng du 'bab/ /mgrin pa'i nang du ngal sos shing / /khrag 'bab par ni rab tu grags/ /myos byed zla ba zhes byar bshad/ /khrag ni nyi ma zhes byar gsungs/ /sgo gnyis mnyam par zhon nas ni/ /steng dang 'og tu mnyam gnas pa/ /'di dag zla ba nyi ma gnyis/ /rtsa ni gnyis su rab tu grags/ /dpa' bo rnams dang mkha' 'gro ma'i/ /'gro ba dang ni 'ong ba'i rgyur/ /nub pa dang ni 'char don dang / /log dad sad pa lta bur gsungs/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i ngos la ni/ /dbyangs ni bcu gnyis yang dag gnas/ /kha ni steng du yang dag bshad/ /ka la sogs pa rnams kyis bskor/ /kha ni 'og gi gnas su gnas/ /lhag par byas nas sbyar ba nyid/ /kṣa ni srin po nyid gsungs pa/ /'og gi char ni rnam par gnas/ /gang tshe mgrin par chags chen gyi/ /gzugs kyi zla ba gnas pa na/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi dam pa'i sku/ /de tshe longs spyod rdzogs par bshad/ /gang tshe rdo rje'i rtser gnas pa/ /de tshe de ni sna rtser ro/ /gang tshe longs spyod rdzogs sku yang / /nub par gnas par gyur pas na/ /bha ga'i nang du son de yang / /yungs kar tsam du rnam par gnas/ /nyi ma'i gzugs su yang dag bshad/ /sprul pa'i skur ni brjod pa ste/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /spros pa de yis bskyed pa 'o/ /padma gar dbang rgyal po ni/ /'dab ma 'byed pa'i sbyor ba can/ /sprul pa'i sku yi gzugs su ni/ /der ni nyi ma nub pa na/ /gang tshe rdzogs pa'i byang chub sems/ /gong bur gyur pa rnyog pa med/ /'khor ba'i lam ni rnam bcad cing / /spros pa nyer zhi dge ba ste/ /gnyis med mchog tu dag pa nyid/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa'i gzugs/ /shrī ni he ru ka zhes brjod/ /rgyud ni srin bu'i gzugs can nyid/

/dgod dang lta dang lag bcangs nyid/ /rgyud du de nyid rnam par gnas/ /'dod chags nyid dang chags bral yang / /zos nas srin bu gnas pa nyid/ /rtsa thams cad kyi mnyam par sbyor ba mkha' 'gro ma'i dra ba'i sdom pa ste drug pa las rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dang / rnal 'byor ma bdag med ma la sogs pas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /'khor lo'i bsgom pa'i lam dang ni/ /lha rnams ji ltar 'byung ba dang / /mkha' 'gro'i 'khor lo'i khyad par dang / /dgongs pa'i skad kyi khyad par ni/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis sngar gsungs na/ /sdom pa'ang bdag la bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rnal 'byor ma lus dbus gnas par/ /a yi rnam par sdom pa'i gnas/ /ji ltar phyi rol de bzhin nang / /sdom pa de nyid rab tu phye/ /bolla'i bde ba phyag rgya che/ /rdo rje skye mched thams cad nyid/ /'di ni gsang ba'i snyoms 'jug pas/ /phyi rol gnyis gnyis bstan pa med/ /sku gsum lus kyi nang du ni/ /'khor lo'i gzugs kyis brjod par bya/ /sku gsum yongs su shes pa las/ /bde ba chen po'i 'khor lor brjod/ /chos dang longs spyod sprul pa dang / /de bzhin bde ba chen po nyid/ /skye gnas mgrin snying dbus su ni/ /sku gsum po ni rnam par gnas/ /ma lus pa yi sems can gyi/ /skye ba gang la brjod bya ba/ /gang zhig sprul pa gnas brtan phyir/ /de la sprul pa'i sku nyid yin/ /sems ni chos kyi rang bzhin te/ /chos kyi sku yang snying gar yin/ /ro rnams drug gi gzugs can gyi/ /bza' ba nges par longs spyod brjod/ /chos rnams kun la gnas brtan phyir/ /thams cad yod pa'i rang bzhin can/ /mgrin par longs spyod 'khor lo dang / /bde ba chen po spyi bor gnas/ /e wam̐ rnam pa rgyu mthun nyid/ /rnam smin chos kyi 'khor lo las/ /skyes bu byed pa longs spyod la/

/bde chen 'khor lor dri med nyid/ /rgyu mthun la sogs rab dbye bas/ /'bras bu rnam pa bzhi zhes brjod/ /las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis/ /las la bcom ldan shes rab brjod/ /gang zhig sprul pa gnas brtan phyir/ /sprul pa'i 'khor lo gnas brtan brjod/ /chos ni ngag las byung ba'i phyir/ /'khor lo thams chad yod pa smra/ /gang zhig mgrin par kun bkur phyir/ /longs spyod 'khor lor kun bkur nyid/ /gang zhig bde chen mgor gnas phyir/ /bde chen 'khor lor dge 'dun che/ /sde pa sku zhes brjod pa ste/ /lto ba gnas su brjod par bya/ /skye gnas 'dod chags bral ba nyid/ /mngal gyi phru ma chos gos te/ /de bzhin ma ni mkhan po nyid/ /mgo bor thal mo sbyar ba phyag /'gro ba'i bya ba khrims kyis gnas/ /de bzhin sngags bzlas a dang ham̐/ /sngags 'don skyes pa dge slong nyid/ /gcer bu skra dang kha spu bregs/ /'di rnams rkyen gyis sems can rnams/ /sangs rgyas nyid du the tshom med/ /zla ba bcu yang sa rnams te/ /sems can sa bcu'i dbang phyug go /btsum mo'i bha ga bde can du/ /khu ba zhes bya rnam par gnas/ /de med pas na bde med 'gyur/ /bde ba spangs na de med 'gyur/ /nus pa med phyir ltos dang bcas/ /lha yi rnal 'byor las bde ba/ /de phyir sangs rgyas dngos po min/ /de nyid dngos med tshul yang min/ /zhal phyag rnam pa gzugs can nyid/ /mchog tu bde ba gzugs med pa/ /de phyir 'gro kun lhan cig skyes/ /lhan cig skyes pa'i rang bzhin brjod/ /rnam dag rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /rang bzhin gyis ni mya ngan 'das/ /zhal phyag kha dog dbyibs las ni/ /lha yi gzugs kyi rnal 'byor ni/ /skyes pa tsam gyis rnam par gnas/ /'on kyang bag chags phal pas so/ /lha mos de skad bshad pa ni/ /rnal 'byor kun gyi gong na med/ /de nas rnal 'byor ma bdag med ma la sogs lha mo thams cad 'di lta ste/

spyan ma dang / mā ma kī dang / gos dkar mo dang / sgrol ma dang / khro gnyer can dang / skul byed ma dang / ri khrod ma shing lo can dang / 'og zhal ma dang / sdom pa ma dang / de dag la sogs pa ri rab kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'i rnal 'byor ma rnams mchog tu ngo mtshar bar gyur cing brgyal ba dang / skrag par gyur to/ /de nas mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to/ /rnal 'byor ma ni kun gyi tshogs/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bslang du gsol/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa rnam par rgyal ba'i rdo rje zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs nas/ /rnal 'byor ma thams cad bslang ba'i phyir 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sems can rnams ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /'on kyang blo bur dri mas bsgribs/ /de bsal nas ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /bcom ldan 'das de de bzhin no/ /rigs kyi bu/ gang zhig mi shes 'jig rten pa/ /btsan dug zos pas brgyal bar 'gyur/ /rmongs spangs de nyid yid kyis ni/ /de yi de nyid yongs su gcod/ /dug gi dum bu gang nyid kyis/ /skye bo thams cad 'chi bar 'gyur/ /dug gis de nyid shes pa des/ /dug gi dug ni 'bigs par byed/ /ji ltar rlung gis zin de la/ /ma sha'i bza' ba sbyin par bya/ /ldog pa'i sman ni brtags pa las/ /rlung gis rlung la snun par byed/ /so sor rtog las rnam rtog dang / /srid pa nyid kyis srid dag byed/ /ji ltar rna bar chu zhugs pa/ /chu gzhan gyis ni dgug par bya/ /de bzhin dngos po'i rnam rtog kyang / /rnam par nges pas sbyang bar bya/ /ji ltar 'tshed pas tshig pa la/ /yang ni me yis gdung bar bya/ /de bzhin 'dod chags mes tshig pa/ /'dod chags me yis gdung bar bya/ /skye bo mi bzad pa yi las/ /gang dang gang gis 'ching 'gyur ba/ /thabs dang bcas na de nyid kyis/ /srid pa'i 'ching pa las grol 'gyur/

/'dod chags kyis ni 'jig rten 'ching / /'dod chags nyid kyis rnam par grol/ /bzlog pa'i sgom pa 'di nyid ni/ /sangs rgyas mu stegs kyis mi shes/ /'byung ba lnga yi rang bzhin las/ /kun du ru las lnga ru 'gyur/ /dga' ba chen po gcig nyid las/ /dbye bas lnga ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ /bolla kakko la sbyor bas/ /reg pa sra ba'i bag chags kyis/ /sra ba gti mug chos yin phyir/ /gti mug rnam par snang mdzad brjod/ /gang phyir byang sems gsher ba nyid/ /gsher ba chu yi khams su brjod/ /chu ni mi bskyod ngo bo'i phyir/ /zhe sdang 'dren pa mi bskyod pa/ /gnyis kyi bskyod pa'i sbyor ba las/ /rtag tu drod ni skye bar 'gyur/ /'dod chags dpag med rdo rje yin/ /'dod chags drod las 'byung bar 'gyur/ /kakko lar ni gang zhig sems/ /de ni rlung gi rang bzhin can/ /don yon rlung las 'byung ba'i phyir/ /phrag dog don yod grub pa yin/ /bde ba 'dod chags sems yin te/ /rin chen khrag dang 'dod chags nyid/ /ser sna nam mkha' las byung ba/ /nam mkha' ser sna rdo rje yin/ /sems ni chen po gcig nyid la/ /lnga yi gzugs kyis mtshon pa nyid/ /rigs ni lnga po skyes pa lnga/ /de la stong phrag du ma nyid/ /de phyir 'di dag rang bzhin gcig /bde chen mchog tu phan pa nyid/ /'dod chags la sogs sems lnga yis/ /dbye bas lnga ru 'gro bar 'gyur/ /gaṅgā'i klung ni bcu yi bye ma snyed/ /rigs gcig la ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i tshogs/ /rigs chen lnga ni rigs ni du ma rnams/ /de rnams rigs las brgya phrag du ma rnams/ /de rnams la yang 'bum phrag rigs chen rnams/ /bye ba'i rigs la grangs ni med par 'gyur/ /de la rigs la grangs med rigs rnams nyid/ /mchog tu dga' ba'i rigs las byung ba rnams/ /zhes bka' stsal to/ /'dir gsol ba/ ci gong bu'i gzugs can 'di tsam du'am chung ba de snyed kyi rang bzhin du 'gyur ba ci lags/

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ skra yi khyon tsam phra ba la/ /sangs rgyas zhing khams du ma ni/ /gnas dang dog dang 'dzer min pa/ /de bzhin 'dir yang blta bya ste/ /stobs bcu dag dang ldan pa'i lha/ /bzhengs shig bzhengs shig bdag gi ni/ /sdum par stod mo bzhes par 'tshal/ /rdzu 'phrul stobs kyis rigs kyi bu/ /yang dag byung ba bka' stsal pa/ /yang dag sbyor byung mtshan nyid ni/ /bshad par bya yis lha mo nyon/ /gsang ba la ni sa yi khams/ /mchog la de bzhin du ni chu/ /dgyes pa la ni me ru bshad/ /thams cad bdag nyid rlung la gnas/ /rtag tu bzhugs par brjod pa 'di/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi sdom pa bdag /yang na me long lta bu'i tshul/ /de bzhin du yang mnyam pa nyid/ /so sor rtog pa'i cho ga bzhin/ /de bzhin bya ba nan tan la/ /rtag tu bzhugs par brjod pa 'di/ /shin tu rnam dag rang bzhin can/ /de bzhin rnam par snang mdzad nyid/ /gzhan yang mi bskyod pa nyid dang / /yang na rin chen 'byung gnas dang / /yang na 'od dpag med pa yis/ /gang tshe rtag bzhugs don yod la/ /bdud rtsi lnga yi gong bu'i dngos/ /thig le'i gzugs te yid lta bu/ /shin tu yang dag ye shes che/ /lha mo kun gyi rang bzhin can/ /rdo rje sems dpa' zhes byar bshad/ /bde ba dam pa ru ni brjod/ /rang byung ngo bo 'di nyid ni/ /chos kyi skur ni rab tu grags/ /de yi shes rab lhan cig skyes/ /de phyir gnas pa'i gzugs can ma/ /las kyi rlung gis bskul ba yis/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor du ni 'bar/ /bdag med ma zhes rnam par bshad/ /dpyid kyi thig le nyid du brjod/ /skra yi rtse mo brgya stong lus/ /glog gi zer ma mnyam pa'i 'od/ /lha yi rnal 'byor dus su ni/ /ba spu'i khung bu'i rtse bug nas/ /phyogs bcur rnam par phyung nas ni/ /kun tu lha dang lha min bsdigs/ /snying la chos kyi 'khor lor ni/ /bsregs nas longs spyod 'khor lor song /

/sna yi bu ga g.yas pa nas/ /thams cad du ni phyung nas ni/ /mdzod spur song ba dag gis kyang / /bug pa nges par phyogs bcu yi/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' yi/ /shangs kyi bu ga g.yon par ni/ /zhugs nas spyi gtsug 'khor lor ni/ /kun bsregs rnam par phyung nas ni/ /sngar gsungs nyid kyi bug pa nas/ /yang ni spyi gtsug zhugs par bya/ /sangs rgyas rnams ni bsregs pa yis/ /dga' ba de nas bskyed par bya/ /lte ba'i dkyil 'khor phyin nas ni/ /snga ma bzhin du gnas par 'gyur/ /yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rgyud chen po las dpyid kyi thig le zhes bya ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po ste drug pa'o// //ngag gi phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ni/ /bcom ldan bdag ni nyan pa 'tshal/ /dgongs pa'i skad ni ci zhes bgyi/ /rnal 'byor ma yi rtag dam tshig /nyan thos la sogs mi shes pa/ /rgod dang lta ba dag gis kyang / /'khyud dang de bzhin gnyis gnyis sogs/ /rgyud kyang rnam pa bzhi rnams kyis/ /dgongs pa'i skad ni ma bsgrags pa/ /bcom ldan nges par gsungs du gsol/ /dgongs pa'i skad ni skad chen po/ /dam tshig brda ni rgyas pa ru/ /rdo rje snying po ngas bshad kyis/ /de nyid rtse gcig sems kyis nyin/ /ma da na chang ba la sha/ /'du ba mā la ya dza nyid/ /'gro ba kheṭa ro ni shra ba/ /rus pa'i rgyan ni ni raṃ shu ba/ /'ong ba phreṃ ka ṇa ru brjod/ /cang te kri pri ta ru brjod/ /skal med du du ra zhes bshad/ /skal ldan kā liñdza ram̐ brjod/ /reg min ḍiṃ ḍi ma zhes brjod/ /thod pa padma bha dza nam̐/ /bza' ba ti pri tar shes bya/ /tshod ma mā la tin dha nam̐/ /bshang ba tsa tussa mam̐ brjod/ /gci ba kasatru ri zhes brjod/ /rang byung sihlar shes par bya/ /khu ba ga pur brjod par bya/ /sha chen shā li dza zhes brjod/ /dbang po gnyis sbyor kun du ru/ /rdo rje bolla zhes brjod do/ /padma kakko la zhes zer/ /mu khi/

sor mo kha ru bcug pa ni/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi mtshan ma'o/ /gho ghu/ thal mo spyi bor yang dag gzhag /mar me ma yi mtshan ma'o/ /ghu ghu/ mthe bong rgan po bcangs pa ni/ /'jib byed ma yi mtshan ma 'o/ /mu ghu/ lag pas rna ba brdebs pa ni/ /g.yo ldan ma yi mtshan ma nyid/ /lu ghu/ sna rtser thal mo brdebs pa ni/ /dge ba'i gtam ni 'dri ba 'o/ /draṣṭa ri dwags mgo ston pa/ /rnal 'byor ma yi mtshan mar mtshon/ /ḍa zhes bya ba skyes bur nges/ /ḍī ni bud med de nas brjod/ /pu zhes bya bar rengs pa nyid/ /su ni de bzhin za ba nyid/ /ma zhes bya ba ma ru brjod/ /yo ni de bzhin chung mar nges/ /bhi zhes bya ba sring mo nyid/ /dhi zhes bya ba mdza' mor brjod/ /lu zhes bya ba bu mor nges/ /satri ni khrag tu shes par bya/ /sa ni zhi ba'i btung ba nyid/ /pe zhes bya ba btung ba ste/ /bi zhes bya ba nges par sha/ /bha zhes bya ba bza' bar brjod/ /bhu zhes bya ba 'du ba nyid/ /bi zhes bya ba dur khrod nyid/ /bhu zhes bya ba ro ru brjod/ /ḍī zhes bya ba rnal 'byor ma/ /ga ni de bzhin lā mā nyid/ /satri zhes bya ba gzugs cad ma/ /ku zhes bya ba mkha' 'gro ma/ /kha zhes bya ba dum skyes ma/ /dza zhes bya ba byin pa zung / /ke zhes bya ba lag pa gnyis/ /bha zhes bya ba phyag 'tshal ba/ /swā ni legs 'ongs bya ba yin/ /'di rnams ni yi ge re re zhing yang brda ste/ dpa' bo dang srong mor des shes par bya'o/ /yi ge'i dam tshig gi phyag rgya'i ye shes so/ /rdo rje snying pos gsol ba/ ngag gi brda ni mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdor bsdus nas ni bshad bya ba/ /de ni nga yis bshad kyis nyon/ /po tam̐ gi zhes bya ba ni phyag go /pra ti gi zhes bya ba ni phyag gi lan no/ /ga mu zhes bya ba ni 'gro ba zhes brjod par 'gyur ro/ /lum pa zhes bya ba ni 'ong ba nyid do/

/ni ga ram zhes bya ba ni byin cig ces brjod par 'gyur ro/ /tsaṭṭu ka ba zhes bya ba ni khyer cig ces brjod pa yin no/ /hri da ya zhes bya ba ni dpa' bo zhes bya ba yin no/ /kau ra ba zhes bya ba ni gsod pa zhes brjod pa yin no/ /karṇaṇi ka zhes bya ba ni dril bu zhes brjod pa yin no/ /a li ka ra ṇa zhes bya ba ni spyi bo zhes brjod pa yin no/ /ba ra ha zhes bya ba ni skra zhes brjod pa yin no/ /shra ba ṇa zhes bya ba ni rna ba'o/ /mantha zhes bya ba ni bdud rtsi'o/ /na ra zhes bya ba ni mnyam par sbyor ba zhes brjod pa yin no/ /tā li kā zhes bya ba ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /nā ra ka zhes bya ba ni dkyil 'khor ro/ /a mu kam̐ zhes bya ba ni dur khrod do/ /kā khi la zhes bya ba ni sgo'o/ /swa sa ṇam̐ zhes bya ba ni bram ze'o/ /pa ri dhi ni rgyal rigs so/ /bir ti ri ni rje'u rigs so/ /kru ra zhes bya ba ni dmangs rigs so/ /anta ni gdol pa'i rigs so/ /a li ka ni phyugs so/ /bha gi ni ni mkha' 'gro ma'o/ /mu da kam̐ ni tshil bu'o/ /grihna zhes bya ba ni phyag rgya'o/ /danta sparsha ti dzi hwa zhes bya ba ni bkres so zhes brjod pa yin no/ /ghanda pa hi ni sred pa'o/ /ā ga ma na zhes bya ba ni gan du'o/ /sd+yā na zhes bya ba ni che ge mor ro/ /ki ra ṇa ni me tog go /lam po ni 'jigs pa'o/ /danta ni rgod pa zhes brjod pa yin no/ /ni ro dha ni char pa'o/ /bi dzā pti ni chog par 'dzin pa'o/ /dhu mā ni sprin no/ /dhu mra pri ya dang / sā nu ni ri'o/ /sa ri to ni chu bo'o/ /am̐ gu lya ni yan lag dang nying lag go /ba da nam̐ ni kha'o/ /rā dzi kā ni lce'o/ /a da nā ni so'o/ /pam̐ ka ti ni rgyal mtshan no/ /tstshan do ni phreng ba'o/ /tsa la ni rlung ngo / /mṛ ka pa ti ni phyugs so/ /maṇḍa la ni mnyam pa'o/ /swā sa ni lam gyi bzhi mdo'o/ /phal gu sha ni skye bo'o/ /ma hā kṣa ra ni phyugs chen po'o/
