/de yi rgyab tu zhon par ni/ /bsgrub par bya ba yongs su brtag /rdo rje khro bos gzir nas ni/ /lho yi phyogs su khyer bar bya/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor lo ma dang / /de yi nges par rkang rjes sa/ /rdo rje'i mgo bo rkang par ni/ /de yi ming ni gzung bas sba/ /de ltar bsgom pa'i sbyor bas ni/ /cho ga yis ni las rnams bya/ /brgya byin yang ni skrod byed na/ /sa yi skye bo smos ci dgos/ /bram ze'i skra dang dge sbyong spus/ /'ug pa'i gshog pa dkris nas ni/ /de ming sngags kyi nang bcug ste/ /bris nas sa la sbas nas ni/ /rdo rje khro bo gnyis dag gis/ /'thab pa ru ni rnam par bsam/ /de ltar rnam bsam sbyor bas ni/ /ji ltar 'dod pas sdang bar byed/ /tsi yi yi ge dang ldan pas/ /rta'i rnam pa'i gdung du byed pa ni chang 'gugs par byed pa la mchog ste/ sku mdog ljang gu dang / zhal bzhi pa dang / zhabs bzhi pa dang / phyag brgyad pa dang / rta mgrin gyi rgyal po chen po dam pa'i dbang phyug 'grub par 'gyur ro/ /dang po ni ljang gu la cung zad ser ba ste/ spyan gsum pa'o/ /zhal g.yas pa dang / gzhan pa ni nag po dang dkar po'o/ /de bzhin du steng ma ni rta gdong ste/ rnam par gtsigs shing ljang gu'o/ /g.yas pa ni ba dan lce gsum pa 'phyar ba'i tshul lo/ /gnyis pa na ni sna tshogs rdo rje/ gsum pa na ni ral gri/ bzhi pa na ni mda'o/ /g.yos pa na ni sna tshogs padma'o/ /gnyis pa la ni 'phang mdung / gsum pa la ni me long / bzhi pa la ni gzhu'o/ /g.yon brkyang pas nyi ma la zhugs shing gar dang bcas pa dang / sred med kyi bu dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa 'gyel bar 'gyur ba de ltar sngags pas cho gas bsgom par bya'o/ /bsgrub bya'i lte bar yam̐ gyi rnam pa bsgom par bya zhing / mam̐ gyi rnam pa gyur pa las chang lto bar bsgom par bya ste/ phyis skyug par byed par bltas na chang skyug par 'gyur ro/

/rlung gi phyogs su song ste/ dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas nas dri'i thig le bdun blo dang ldan pas bya zhing / kham phor gyis sba bar bya'o/ /der ri rab zur brgyad pa rwa brgyad kyis kun tu spras par sprul te/ sprul pa'i rdo rjes mnan nas ya'i rnam pa rlung bdun po kun gyi sa bon dbugs rngub pas nang du sbas te/ dbang chen lam̐ gyis mtshan pas sba'o/ /de ltar sbyor bas bsgrubs na 'jig pa lta bu'i rlung 'ching bar byed do/ /padma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsgoms nas/ de'i 'dab ma la klu bdag brgyad dang / dbus su 'bar ba'i 'bar ba chen po can bkod nas rdo rje khro bo'i skus zhabs kyi mthil gyis gzir bar bya ba dang / lto 'phyes sprin gyi chu gtor bar byed pa dang / hūm̐ gnyis kyi nang du bcug nas dbus su klu'i sa bon bcug ste gzir bar bya zhing hūm̐ gi bzlas pa byas pas char 'bebs par 'gyur ro/ /'jigs pa chen po byed pa'i nyi ma'i mdog gi 'od ltar shin tu dmar bas kha gdangs nas nam mkha' la bzhugs pa dang / hūm̐ 'bar ba'i ljags kyi sprin la bldag pa dang / rol mtsho bdun yongs su gang ba 'gugs pa dang / dbugs rngub pa dang / dbugs 'byin pas ras bal gyi phur ma ltar gtor ba dang / de nas rang gi phyag rgya'i tshogs 'bar ba bton pas skad cig gis 'dral ba dang / gcod pa dang / hūm̐ gi rnam pas sdigs par byed do/ /ston ka'i dus kyi nam mkha' lta bu/ me'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i mi g.yo mgon dpral ba'i nang nas bton te/ rnam par snang mdzad kyi gnas su phyag drug na ral gri dang / sdigs mdzub dang / mda' dang / zhags pa dang / gzhu dang / rdo rje ste/ char rab tu 'bebs shing khro bo grangs med pas yongs su bskor bas bdud las rnam par rgyal ba dang / bgegs thams cad bskrad pa dang / hūm̐ gi sgras gang bas 'jig rten gsum gang ba yang 'jig par byed do/ /skyes pa'i khrag dang /

rkang rjes kyis las mi'i gzugs byas nas mig la mi'i rus pa'i phur bu 'od zer can gyi sngags lan nyi shur mngon par bsngags te/ gdab par bya zhig btab ma thag tu de tshogs kyi bdag po'i khar bcug nas rgyab tu rdo rje gtun shing gis brdung bar bya ste/ /oṃ sumbha ni sumbha hūm̐ badzra mu ṣa le na tsūrṇaṇa ya bi ghnān hūm̐ phaṭ/ de ltar bsam gtan gyi las kyis skyes pa'i bgegs zlog par byed do/ /nam mkha' lding mig sman gyi kha dog lta bu klu brgya stong gis brgyan cing / lus la klu brgyad dang / brgya stong gi gdong dang / nam mkhar gnas pa'i bka' sprin de rnams kyis thos nas sprin gyi tshogs kyis char zlog par byed do/ /nam mkha' lding gi gshog pa'i mdog sngon po yang mchus bsnun pas chu mo'i tshogs skems par byed do/ /oṃ badzra nā rā ya ṇa nirb+bā pa ya ba hninna pā tsa bāmbu me ghaiḥhūm̐/ nam mkha'i khams kyi nang son par/ /zhal gsum pa la spyan gsum pa/ /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /stag gi pags pa mnabs pa dang / /kha dog dmar po gzi brjid che/ /nyi ma shar ba'i 'od lta bur/ /ral gri nyid dang kha ṭwāṃ ga /gzhu dang de bzhin mda' nyid dang / /sha chen gyi ni thod pa dang / /de bzhin du ni cang te'u nyid/ /zhags pa nyid dang lcags kyu dang / /g.yon na utpal rnam par spras/ /g.yos brkyang 'jigs pa chen po ni/ /nyi mar gnas shing gar dang ldan/ /dmar po 'bar zhing 'khyil ba dang / /gos ni chen po bla bre dang / /dur khrod du ni rab tu bya/ /hrīṃ las byung ba'i lha mo ni/ /sgrol ma 'khor ba sgrol ba mo/ /de ltar bsgoms pa tsam gyis ni/ /yo gis sangs rgyas nyid thob na/ /dngos grub gzhan lta smos ci dgos/ /de nas dbang du bya 'dod pas/ /mya ngan med pa'i brgyad la mya ngan pa'i 'og tu song ste/ gos dmar pos bgos nas thams cad kyis brgyan cing sngags bzla bar bya'o/

/zhal gsum pa'i rnal 'byor la gnas nas bdag nyid kha dog dmar por bsams te/ phyi nas rang gi sku las phyag gnyis ma dmar mo lag pas lcags kyu dang / /zhags pa 'dzin ma dbyung bar bya'o/ /des bsgrub bya'i snying dang mgrin pa bcings nas dgug par bsam par bya zhing rang gi lus la lha mo de gzhug par bya'o/ /bsgrub bya myos par gyur nas de'i snying gar sngags kyi yi ge bcu kha dog dmar por dgod par bya ste/ yang na bsgrub bya dang ye shes kyi gzugs kyis yi ge de rnams la de zhugs pas de rnams lhan cig tu 'dres par gyur par bsam par bya'o/ /bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba 'dis nyi ma bdun gyis 'khor los sgyur ba yang ji srid 'tsho'i bar du dbang du byed par the tshom mi za'o/ /de nas rdo rje'i bar chad bzlog pa'i don du bka' stsal pa/ dpal mchog dang po'i gzugs su bdag nyid zhal gsum pa/ zhabs bzhi dang / phyag bzhi dang / zhal dmar po'i 'od zer 'bar ba/ snyem ma la sogs pa'i lha mo bzhis yongs su bskor bar rnam par bsams nas rdo rje mtshon cha ma dang / rdo rje kī li kī li dang / rdo rje sdug pa dang / rdo rje snyems ma'i g.yas na rdo rje mda' 'gengs shing 'dzin pa'o/ /g.yon pa bsgyings shing rked par gzhag pa dang / gzhu 'dzin par bsams te/ de nas sems dpa' phyug ste/ sangs rgyas kyi mdzad pa'i sprin rnam pa thams cad kyis rnam par spras pa'i g.yas na mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa dang / dbang gi thod rin po che 'dzag pa nam mkhar son pas ni rdo rje zlog par byed do/ /oṃ ma hā su kha badzra te dzaḥhūm̐/ de ltar shin tu dga' ba'i bcing ba byas nas rnal 'byor bla na med par bshad do/ /gang zhig rnam par phye bas gsod par byed pa 'di bka' stsal to/ /zhi ba la ni mtha'i ya dang ni gnyis dang / phyi nas ya dbu ma phyi bas yig 'bru lhag mas ji ltar bde bas so/ /lha mo de ltar bshad pas ni las thams cad rab tu sgrub par byed do/

/rab tu myos ma dbang du bya bar 'dod pas yang brgyad pa la ku ru kulle'i rnal 'byor la gnas nas bsam gtan 'di bya'o/ /myos byed kyi 'bras bu bza' zhing / de nas ka kā ma tsi ka'i khu bas thig le byas nas sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ a mu kī me hriḥb shī bha ba tu/ khri bzlas pas 'grub bo/ /de nas dug gis zin pa bslang ba'i phyir rang gi snying ga na padma 'dab ma brgyad pa bsam par bya'o/ /de'i steng du dbyangs kyi gsum pa 'dab ma brgyad la kha dog dkar po bsam par bya zhing / bdag nyid yang 'og gi klu'i gzugs kha dog dkar po i'i bdud rtsi 'dzag po bsam par bya'o/ /klu de'i mig las bdud rtsi byung bas der bsgrub par bya ba de'i lus la ltung bar bsam par bya'o/ /bsam gtan gyi sbyor ba 'dis khams gsum yongs su gang ba'i dug med par byed do/ /de nas zla ba dang nyi ma rnam par gzung bar 'dod pas sā lu btags pa'i bdag nyid las zla dang nyi ma byas te/ rdo rje'i chu la gzhug par bya zhing sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ tsan drā rkaka mā tsa la mā tiṣṭha tiṣṭhi he badzrā ya swā hā/ bye ba phrag drug bzla bar bya ste/ phyi nas las 'di yang dag pa brtsam par bya'o/ /zla ba dang nyi ma dag gnas shing nyin mtshan bye brag med par gnas par 'gyur ro/ /pha rol gyi sde rnam par gzhig pa'i phyir bsgrub par bya ste/ kha ṭi kā dang / bdud rtsi lnga dang / ku ṭaṭhā ra tshinna dang lhan cig btags la ril bu bya'o/ /oṃ badzra kart+ta ri he badzrā ya swā hā/ dngos grub kyi don du bye ba bzlas shing de grub na bsgrub bya ril ba spyi blugs kyi mgrin pa bskor nas/ bcag na dgra thams cad kyi mgo 'chad par 'gyur ro/ /lha dgas par 'dod pas thig le bsgrub par bya ste/ rdo rje bcings pas rdo rje can gyi me tog bsgrubs te/ sta re bcad pa dang bsregs nas nyi ma gzas zin pa dang mi bskyod pa dang btag par bya zhing /

btags nas dgra sta bya ste/ de rdog pas mnan nas sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ badzra ku ṭaṭhā ra sphā ṭa ya sphā ṭa ya phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ /dngos grub kyi don du bye ba bzlas la/ phyi nas thig le byas na gang la phyag byas pa de 'gas so/ /de nas char gyi rab tu sbyor ba bshad par bya ste/ oṃ ā phu/ yi rnam pa'i cho ga ltar mtha' yas kyi gzugs brnyan byas la bdud rtsi lngas ni blugs par bya'o/ /me tog nag pos ni mchod par bya/ klu 'dul ba'i khu bas ni byug par bya/ glang po che'i chang gis ni mgo bo byug par bya/ kham phor kha sbyar du ni gzhag par bya/ ba nag po'i 'o mas dgang bar bya/ gzhon nu ma nag mos bkal ba'i skud pas ni dkri bar bya/ rlung gi phyogs su rdzing bu byas nas der mtha' yas gzhag par bya/ de'i 'gram du cho gas dkyil 'khor bzhengs par bya/ de'i dbus su mtha' yas gzhag par bya'o/ /mtha' yas mnan pa'i kyai rdo rje bri bar bya ste/ zhal brgyad pa/ zhabs bzhi pa/ phyag bcu drug gis brgyan pa/ spyan nyi shu rtsa bzhi par bsgom par bya'o/ /phyis ni slob dpon nang gis ma rungs pa'i sems kyis dben pa'i gnas su sngags bzla bar bya'o/ /oṃ ghu ru ghu ru/ ghu ṭa ghu ṭa/ sha ma sha ma/ gha ṭa gha ṭa/ gho ṭa ya gho ṭa ya/ a nanta kṣo bha ka rā ya/ nā gā dhi pa ta ye/ he he ru ru kam̐/ sapta pā tā la/ ga tannā gā nā karṣa ya/ barṣa ya/ gardza ya/ tardzaya/ phuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥphuḥhūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ phaṭ swā hā/ gal te char mi 'bab na de'i tshe sngags 'di bzlog nas bzlas na char 'bab par 'gyur ro/ /gal te mi 'bab na de'i tshe mgo ardza ka'i dog pa ltar 'gas par 'gyur ro sprin dral bar 'dod pas de'i tshe dur khrod kyi ras la sngags 'di bri bar bya'o/ /oṃ tardzadza ya tardzadza ya/ shma shā na pri yā ya phaṭ swā hā/ dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba'i rgyal po chen po las las thams cad kyi bsam gtan 'byung ba zhes bya ba brtag pa'i rgyal po ste bdun pa'o//

//gzhan du mtshan nyid mtshon pa ni/ bcom ldan bdag ni nyan par 'tshal/ /de nyid bzhi ni mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /'khor ba sgrol ba'i mtshan nyid kyi/ /ji ltar de nyid rdo rje nyon/ /dang por rdo rje'i de nyid de/ /dril bu yang ni gnyis pa la/ /gsum pa la ni phreng ba nyid/ /bzhi par ye shes mtshan nyid do/ /de nyid bzhi yi rba rlabs las/ /pha rol 'dod pa 'dren pa 'o/ /dbus su rnam par snang mdzad mgon/ /shar du mi bskyod de bzhin yang / /rin chen lho yi rwa la 'o/ /'od dpag med ni nub tu dgod/ /byang du don yod grub pa ste/ /rwa lnga rnams kyi lha nyid do/ /padmar byang chub yan lag brgyad/ /sa ji lta bar gzhag par bya/ /phyag na padma byams pa dang / /nam mkha' kun tu bzang po bzhin/ /gnod sbyin dbang po 'jam dpal dang / /rnam par sel dang sa nyid kyang / /lha rnams brgyad po 'di rnams kyis/ /sa ji lta bar gzhag par bya/ /dbus su skabs gsum sgo nga la/ /ye shes lha ni thim par bya/ /padmar lha mo brgyad po rnams/ /ji bzhin gnas su sbyar bar bya/ /rdo rje lcags kyu la sogs bzhi/ /de bzhin rtsen ma phyogs bral lo/ /rwa la mkha' 'gro ma lnga ste/ /dbus su ye shes ming can te/ /shar du rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /byang du drag mo'i ming can te/ /ro langs ma ni phyogs kyi mthar/ /gtum mo lho yi dbang phyug ma/ /rdo rje'i de nyid lha rnams su/ /mkhas pas shes par bya ba yin/ /gang phyir de nyid rdo rje yi/ /rdo rje'i bdag nyid bdag sems la/ /rdo rje snying can rnal 'byor pa/ /rdo rje sems ni byed du gzhug /rdo rje dag pa bstan par bya/ /rdo rje chos la brtson pa'i yid/ /rdo rje de nyid can kun rnams/ /rdo rje las la mngon par 'gro/ /rdo rje spro ba'i sbyor ba yis/ /rdo rje sems can 'khor ba sgrol/ /rdo rje dgug pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /rdo rje rengs pa'i rnal 'byor rig

/mun pa lta bu'i nyon mongs pa/ /rnam shes mar me dang lhan cig /ye shes rdo rjes gzhom par bya/ /snang ba'i phyogs ni 'thob pa 'o/ /rdo rjes bsgrubs pa thams cad la/ /rdo rje'i bdag ces bstan pa yin/ /rdo rje chos kyi snying po can/ /rdo rje thar pa'i lhur len pa/ /rdo rje padma rnam mnan te/ /bsgrub bya de nyid thams cad nas/ /rdo rje padma kun zhugs pa/ /rnam par mkhas pas bsgrub par bya/ /rdo rje dril bu'i mtshan nyid ni/ /rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rgyal po nyon/ /shes rab dkrol ba'i de nyid ni/ /lha ni kun gyis thos par 'gyur/ /cha gsum gsal bar gzung ba la/ /ska rags byas pa bzang po nyid/ /zhi ba utpal ku mu ta/ /rin chen padma rnam par gnas/ /phyogs mtshams brgyad pa'i dbus su ni/ /dgu pa la ni sangs rgyas nyid/ /lha dgu la sogs rtse mo ni/ /lha rnams dgu yis byin gyis brlabs/ /chu srin kha la byung ba yi/ /rtse mo 'od zer zla bar gnas/ /rtse mo dgu pa rnam par bshad/ /ye shes rdo rje 'gro ba 'don/ /nam mkha'i khams kyi mthar thug par/ /byang chub snying por rnam par gnas/ /phyogs bcu thams cad rig pa'i gnas/ /'jig rten khams ni mtha' yas pa/ /phyogs ni brgyad ces bya bar ni/ /lha mo brgyad du rab tu grags/ /yi ge brgyad kyi sa bon ni/ /phyogs ni brgyad du rnam par dgod/ /shar du lha mo sgrol ma ste/ /byang du yang ni gos dkar mo/ /nub kyi phyogs su mā ma kī/ /lho ru yang ni sangs rgyas spyan/ /gser dang sbrang rtsi gzi brjid ma/ /rdo rje phreng ba bzhi pa 'o/ /nang gi gzugs ni nam mkha' ste/ /gzugs kyi gang ba gzi brjid can/ /padma kha phye las byung ba/ /gzugs med srid pa'i gnas su ni/ /shes rab bdud rtsi bum pa ltar/ /ye shes bdud rtsi'i gnas su ni/ /de yi yang ni dbus su yid/ /lha mo shes rab pha rol phyin/ /gzugs ni mdzes shing yon tan gnas/

/steng gi padma rdo rje rnams/ /ji ltar gong ma bsam par bya/ /nang gi ye shes dbyug gu ni/ /thams cad sdud cing 'byin par byed/ /ā li kā li sgom pa ni/ /gnas ni brgyad du bskyod par bya/ /ā li kā li rab sbyor bas/ /'khor ba thams cad gcod par byed/ /rdo rje dril bu'i thabs nyid de/ /thabs ni yang ni nang du nyid/ /de la lag gnyis rab tu brkyang / /rnam lnga 'dod pa'i bskor ba bya/ /g.yas par nyi ma yang dag bsam/ /g.yon par zla bsam g.yon pa nyid/ /lus can rnams kyi thabs nyid de/ /rang 'dod lhar ni bsam par bya/ /byang du rdo rje gsor nas ni/ /phyi nas blo ldan yang dag gdab/ /hūm̐ gi glu yi rnam pa yis/ /sangs rgyas thams cad dgyes par byed/ /rdo rje gsor bas mdzes pa yis/ /rmongs pa'i sems can rnam par sgrol/ /chos kyi rnam thar 'bras bu nyid/ /rdo rje dgyes pa 'dzin pa ste/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho/ /thabs dang shes rab rab dkrol zhing / /thabs dang shes rab lag pa'i dngos/ /oṃ badzra dharma ra ṇi ta pra ra ṇi ta sam̐ pra ra ṇi ta sarb+ba buddha kṣe tra pra tsā li ne/ pra dzñā pā ra mi tā nā da swa bhā be tsa badzra swa twa hri da ya sam̐ to ṣa ni hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ ho ho ho swā hā/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta sid dhi badzra sa ma ye tiṣṭha e ṣa twāndhā ra ya mi hi hi hi hi hi hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ swā hā/ thabs dang shes rab chos kyis ni/ /'gro ba thams cad sad par byed/ /mi shes 'dam du bying ba yi/ /sems cad sangs rgyas don du dkrol/ /rdo rje de nyid kyis ni gzung / /chos kyi dril bu dkrol bar bya/ /thabs dang shes rab cho ga yis/ /sems can don ni yo gis byed/ /de nyid med sems rnal 'byor pa/ /glang po dril bu dkrol ba nyid/ /rnal 'byor de nyid dman pa yi/ /rang gi dngos grub ring du brtag /brgyad pa las dril bu'i de kho na ste rab tu byed pa dang po'o//

//phreng ba la sogs mtshan nyid ni/ /yang dag ji ltar rdo rje nyon/ /gang gi yang dag cho ga yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /shel dang nya phyis mu tig dang / /khams ni dkar po la sogs gzhan/ /zhi ba'i las la khyad par du/ /phreng ba yi ni mtshan nyid do/ /gser dang dngul dang zangs ma pa/ /padma'i sa bon khyad par du/ /rgyas pa la ni phreng ba nyid/ /rnam par mkha' pas bgrang bar bya/ /gur gum la sogs dri sogs kyi/ /dri ni thams cad khyad par du/ /bsgrubs shing ril bu byas nas ni/ /dbang la yongs su rab tu grags/ /rudrākṣ dang lung tang dang / /de bzhin skyes pa'i rus pa nyid/ /drag po'i las la sbyar bar bya/ /mngon spyod la ni yongs su grags/ /zhi rgyas dbang dang mngon spyod la/ /phu tra dzī wa las kun byed/ /sngags kyi bsgrub pa lnga bcu ste/ /dbang la de yi phyed nyid do/ /brgya phrag gcig ni zhi ba la/ /de bzhin rgyas la lhag par brgyad/ /mngon spyod la ni drug cu nyid/ /khyad par du ni las la sbyar/ /ji ltar las kyi bye brag gis/ /phreng ba la sogs bya ba 'o/ /phyogs dang mtshams ni brgyan rnams kyi/ /dbus su dgug pa sangs rgyas kyi/ /lha ni dgu sogs srad bu la/ /lha dgus byin gyis brlab par bya/ /phreng ba kun ni dgra bcom pa/ /mchod rten steng du rab tu brtag /mchod rten chos kyi dbang po'i phyir/ /steng du yang ni chos kyi dbyings/ /lag mthil nyi ma bsams nas ni/ /dbyangs yig dang po la sogs pa/ /lag pa'i dbus su rnal 'byor pas/ /bsgom zhing bdud rtsi yi ge nang / /'od zer 'phro ba du ma dang / /kha dog dkar po bsams nas ni/ /sor mo rdo rje rtse mo ste/ /g.yon pa padma 'dab mar bsgom/ /padma rdo rje snyoms 'jug pa'i/ /kha sbyar dbus su phreng gzhag la/ /kun gyi de nyid bsgom bya zhing / /phreng ba byin gyis brlabs par bya/ /sor mo la sogs bye brag las/ /phyis ni sngags pas bzlas pa bya/

/rdo rje gnyis med dngos po las/ /g.yon pa'i rdo rje can gyi dngos/ /zhi la khro bor dgod par bya/ /rgyas la dbu ma'i de nyid la/ /srin lag la ni dbang du gsungs/ /kun gyi mtha' mar mngon spyod la/ /mthe bong rdo rje lcags kyu lha/ /dngos po las ni dgug par bya/ /mnyam gzhag bzlas dang sgom pa yis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nyid med pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /de nyid med pa'i sngags zlos dang / /rdo rje dril bu de nyid med/ /phyag rgya'i de nyid skye mi 'gyur/ /rnal 'byor pa yis de nyid dmigs/ /de nyid thams cad byed pa nyid/ /yi ge rnams kyi rgyu las ni/ /gzugs kyi snying po mdzes pa ste/ /sngags kyi snying po bgrang ba'i grangs/ /rdzun pas rnal 'byor ma snying 'grub/ /oṃ pa de pa de ma hā dzñā nam̐ sarb+ba bud dha ma ham̐ bha be ta hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ ho ho ho a kham̐ swā hā/ sngags kyi phreng ba sbyangs nas ni/ /gang 'dod de nyid bsgrub par bya/ /de nyid las ni 'grub par 'gyur/ /kun tu gsal ba med na ring / /ye shes de nyid khyad par du/ /ye shes chen po yang dag nyon/ /mnyam nyid sems kyis dbye ba las/ /mnyam par gzhag pas 'khor lo brtag /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /ye shes sa bon gyis ni sprul/ /sku mdog dkar po bsgom par bya/ /padma'i gdan la bzhugs par ni/ /phyag gnyis sems dpa'i skyil mo krung / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /phyag rgya chen po phyag gnyis kyis/ /snying ga'i gnas su btsir ba nyid/ /sku mdog dkar po shin tu mdzes/ /'phags pa rnam par snang mdzad gtso/ /kun tu 'od zer sna tshogs kyis/ /sangs rgyas dam tshig sprin gyis spro/ /zung ltar rim pa'i cho ga yis/ /sngags kyi bzlas par rab tu grags/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag gnyis kyis/ /bskor ba mkha' 'gro ma de bde/ /ā li kā li sa bon ni/ /hūm̐ gi srad bus brgyu ba nyid/

/'di yi sa bon rnal 'byor pas/ /bsgoms na myur du sangs rgyas thob/ /brgyad pa las sngags kyi bzlas pa dang sgom pa ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //'pho ba'i rnal 'byor mtshan nyid kyi/ /de nyid ji ltar rdo rje nyon/ /bzang po'i lam du rnal 'byor pas/ /'gro ba mdzes pa khyod la bstan/ /ye shes dbang po nyan par 'tshal/ /sgo rnams dgu ni ji ltar lags/ /ye shes sgo yi dbye bas ni/ /yon tan skyon ni ji ltar lags/ /dus su srog ni 'chad pa yi/ /yang dag rab tu sbyor ba nyon/ /legs pa'i lam ni mdzes pa'i gnas/ /ngan pa'i lam yang skyon rnams nyid/ /lte ba'i steng na thig le dang / /mig dang sna sogs rna ba dag /btung dang btung ba min pa'i sgo/ /mtshan nyid lte bar 'dod pa can/ /mtho ris thig les gzugs lus can/ /steng nas steng du gnas pa yi/ /'gro dang 'ong bar yongs su grags/ /sna las gnod sbyin dag tu 'gyur/ /rna ba dag las grub pa'i lha/ /gal te mig las shes 'gro na/ /mi rnams kyi ni rgyal por 'gyur/ /srid pa'i sgo las yi dwags te/ /gci las de bzhin byol song ngo / /dmyal ba brgyad ni btung min pas/ /de ltar spang phyir rigs kyi bu/ /srid pa'i 'pho ba'i mtshan nyid ni/ /gang phyir sgo yi khyad par ni/ /'khor ba'i dbye ba yang dag 'byung / /de phyir sgo yi khyad par gyis/ /rnal 'byor pas ni mnyam gzhag pa/ /'chi ba'i dus kyi thob pa ni/ /'chi ba'i mtshan ma bstan pa nyid/ /rim la sogs pas ma phye ba'i/ /'pho ba'i rnal 'byor dam pa nyid/ /bum pa dang por brtsams nas ni/ /sgo rnams thams cad rengs par byed/ /mchod rten rnams kyi lcags sgrog lnga/ /sgo yi bug pa'i bsgom pa ni/ /de bas dma' ba'i sgo nyid do/ /sa bon chu ltar dkar po nyid/ /btung dang btung min me yi ni/ /de yi sa bon 'bar ba ltar/ /de yi dang po dbugs kyi yang / /de la shin tu mnyam gzhag pas/

/dbugs ni bum pa can bsgom bya/ /lus kyi rlung gi kha dog dang / /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sems kyis ni/ /rlung gi sa bon rtsa ba rnams/ /rlung ni mtha' yi rtsab can/ /thig le sgra dang ldan pa yis/ /sems kyi sa bon gyis ni drang / /rdo rje can gyi sa bon gyis/ /'jigs pa'i lcags kyu la sogs sbyar/ /gnas ni bcu dang nyi shu ni/ /rtsa bzhi'i gnas las 'jigs mas dgug /go 'phang gnas ni go 'phang ste/ /bug pa dgu yi steng mas so/ /mdzod spu skra dkar sa bon gyi/ /yi ge phyed dang gnyis kyis sbyar/ /drag po'i sgra yis brjod nas ni/ /brgyad kyi mtha' yi sa bon gyis/ /'jigs dang 'jigs pa'i sde tshan gyi/ /dang po la sogs dang po yi/ /yi ge phyed pas sbyar nas ni/ /rlung gis sa bon 'og ma las/ /sgra ni sgra yis bskul bar bya/ /rlung gi sa bon ldan pa dang / rlung gi dkyil 'khor sems kyi ni/ /gnas ni nyi shu rtsa bzhir ni/ /de nas steng nas steng du mchog /rnal 'byor pas ni skra dkar bas/ /steng gi yi ge bza' bar bya/ /bu ga dgu yi steng mchog nas/ /'phral du yid kyis 'pho bar byed/ /nyin zhing bram ze gsod pa dang / /mtshams med lnga ni byed pa dang / /chom rkun las kyi longs spyod pa/ /'di yi lam gyis grol 'gyur te/ /sdig pas gos par mi 'gyur zhing / /srid pa'i skyon las shin tu grol/ /dper na 'dam las skyes pa yi/ /padma gzi brjid dri ma med/ /de bzhin 'dam sogs lus kyis ni/ /ye shes sku ni rang 'dod pas/ /dus thob na yang 'pho bya ste/ /dus min lha ni gsod pa nyid/ /de phyir lus kyi mtshan shes nas/ /blo dang ldan pas rnal 'byor brtsam/ /rnal 'byor bsgrub bya'i khyad par las/ /ji ltar de nyid rdo rje nyon/ /mnyam nyid sems kyi dngos po ni/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyin thams cad las/ /snying gi dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sangs rgyas lnga yi sa bon rnams/

/'di ni nyi ma'i 'od zer 'bar/ /ngo bo sems kyis mtshon par bya/ /sngar gsungs stong pa nyid kyis ni/ /sngar gyi mtshan nyid yang dag ldan/ /hūm̐ la gnas pa'i sems kyi ni/ /gzugs la sogs pa thams cad gzhig /zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dbus gnas par/ /sa bon gyis ni gzugs bskyed nas/ /padma'i gdan la bzhugs par ni/ /ye shes mkha' 'gror bdag nyid bsam/ /zhal gsum pa la phyag drug nyid/ /spyan gsum dbu rgyan gyis ni brgyan/ /bzhad dang khro zhing sgeg pa dang / /rgyan rnams kun gyis rnam par brgyan/ /kun da zla ba'i mdog ltar dkar/ /shin tu mdzes pa'i gos kyis brgyan/ /sangs rgyas sprin ni spro bar bya/ /sems dpa' skyil mo krung du gnas/ /dang por mda' ni dgod par bya/ /de bzhin gnyis par lcags kyu nyid/ /gsum par rdo rje 'phyar ba 'o/ /g.yon pa sdig mdzub zhags pa nyid/ /gnyis par dpag bsam shing lcug ma/ /gsum par gzhu yi cho gas khyab/ /'od zer phreng ba du ma dang / dbug ni g.yo ba med par bsgom/ /sa bon brgyad la sogs pa yis/ /yi ge rnam dgod dgod par bya'o/ /ā li kā li rab sbyor bas/ /ji ltar btus pa'i sa bon bzhin/ /thams cad kha dog dkar po rnams/ /sa bon zla ba'i 'od zer ldan/ /padma'i chu shing me tog gi /snying la sgong skyes gzhag par bya/ /de yi dbus su ye shes dang / /rnam par shes pa lhan cig tu/ /dngos po'i ngo bos bsgom par bya/ /g.yo ba med cing 'tshe ba med/ /de nas phyi rol rnal 'byor rnams/ /rnam par mkhas pas gzung bar bya/ /gnas gnyis kyi ni sems dang ni/ /rlung gi dkyil 'khor sems kyis ni/ /de yi dbus su me nyid de/ /de yi steng du nyi ma der/ /ā li kā li ldan pa yi/ /sa bon de nyid dmar po 'o/ /rnal 'byor pa yi khyad par du/ /dbyung dang rngub pa'i bzlas pa bya/ /ye shes sa bon dbus su ni/ /'byung ba yis ni bsnun bya zhing / /bsnun pas snying ga'i ye shes ni/

/me tog lta bur bsnun par bya/ /dbyung dang dbyung min bzlas pas ni/ /dbyung dang rngub pa'i rnal 'byor pa/ /bdag nyid phyi rol du ni byed/ /dbyung ba'i mtshan nyid mtshon pa dang / /rngub pa'i mtshan nyid mtshon par bya/ /dbyung dang rngub pa'i rnal 'byor gyi/ /mtshan nyid de nyid bsgoms pas ni/ /mnyam gzhag dngos po'i rang bzhin gyis/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nas phyi rol rnams kyi lus/ /sgrub pa pos ni rnam par sprul/ /gzhan gyi sems kyi rjes su sems/ /rnam par mkhas pas shes par bya/ /bsgom dang bzlas pa'i khyad par gyis/ /mnyam par gzhag pa'i sems kyis ni/ /legs pa'i lam ni bsam byas na/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /de nas ye shes gzugs gyur dang / /de phyir mar me'i sems kyis ni/ /rnam par mkhas pas las rnams byed/ /nyan thos la sogs de nyid ni/ /legs par bshad pa bsgrags pa nyid/ /shel ltar sems ni brtan byas nas/ /mar me'i rnam pa'i sems kyis ni/ /spros pa thams cad dmigs nas ni/ /spros pa nyid ni spros med byed/ /rang bzhin rnal 'byor dmigs nas ni/ /'di dag thams cad yongs su spang / /kye bcom ldan 'das ye shes gang gis ye shes khyad par du 'phags lags/ bcom ldan kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ye shes rnam pa lnga ru gsungs/ /gsang ba'i me long ye shes lha'i/ /khro bo'i ye shes lha ma yin/ /yi dwags ye shes nyi ma ste/ /dmyal ba'i 'jigs shing ngu ba nyid/ /gti mug ye shes byol song rnams/ /sems med brtan pa la sogs pa/ /mi la rnam shes khyad par ni/ /rnam pa lnga ru shes par bya/ /lnga yi dbye bas ye shes bsgrags/ /glen zhing lkugs pas khebs pa yi/ /byis pa'i shes pa'i shes pa can/ /ye shes de nyid khyad par dang / /rnal 'byor bstan bcos khyad par las/ /skye ba bye ba stong phrag tu/ /nga yi ye shes kyis bskul ba/ /mkhas pa rnal 'byor bstan bcos la/

/'bad pas dad pa bskyed par bya/ /phyi rol bstan bcos sgra la sogs/ /dper na gar mkhan kha dog bzhin/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos rjes btsal bas/ /bza' dang grol ba'i gnas su bya/ /snying po las ni snying po mchog /rnal 'byor zhal mchog khyod la bshad/ /brgyad pa las mu stegs kyi ye shes 'jigs pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //sngags rnams kyi ni mtshan nyin ni/ /rdo rje gtso bo rgyal po nyon/ /oṃ badzrā mṛ ta ma hā su kha ham̐ swā hā/ snying po'o/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hūm̐ swā hā/ rdo rje sems dpa'i bzlas pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥ.am̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje drag mo'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.ām̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje gzugs brnyan ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.iṃ ham̐ swā hā/ 'dod chags rdo rje ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.īṃ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje zhi ba ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.um̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje gnod sbyin ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.ūm̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.am̐ ham̐ swā hā/ sgra'i rdo rje ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.aḥham̐ swā hā/ sa'i rdo rje ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.oṃ ham̐ swā hā/ gling bu ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.auṃ ham̐ swā hā/ pi wang ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.eṃ ham̐ swā hā/ mu kun da'i'o/ /oṃ āḥ.aiṃ ham̐ swā hā/ rdza rnga ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥbadzrām̐ ku shi dzaḥham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje lcags kyu ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥbadzra pā she hūm̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje zhags pa ma'i'o/ /ooṃ āḥbadzra spho ṭa bam̐ ham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje lcags sgrog ma'i'o/ /oṃ āḥbadzra ghaṇḍe hoḥham̐ swā hā/ rdo rje dril bu ma'i'o/ spyan la sogs pa'i sngags ni snga ma bzhin du sngags pas bzlas par bya'o/ /oṃ ཾṛ swā hā/ me tog ma'i'o/ /oṃ ཾṝ swā hā/ bdug pa ma'i'o/ /oṃ ཾl̥ swāhā/ dri ma'i'o/ /oṃ ཾl̥̄ swā hā/ mar me ma'i'o/ /'di dag ni rdo rjesems dpa'i'o/ /oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ he ru ka'i'o/ /oṃ badzra gu hye si dha pa ra ma yo gi shwa ri ka pā la mā la dha ri ṇi/

ru dhi ra pri ye shma shā na bā si ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dkar mo'i'o/ /oṃ badzra tsaṇḍe shwa ri kha ṭwām̐ gi ma hā badzri ṇi ka pā la mā lā mu ku ṭe ā kaḍḍha ā kaḍḍha sarb+ba duṣṭa hṛ da ya mā kaḍḍha ru lu ru lu bhyo hūm̐ phaṭa/ chom rkun ma'i'o/ /oṃbadzrā pa rā dzi te pa ra ma gu hye ka pā la mā lā bi bhū ṣi te/ sarba duṣṭa mo hi ni pri ye e hye hi bha ga wa ti badzra gu hye shwa rī ba hu bi bi dha be sha dha ri ṇi/ sarba duṣṭa ni bā ra ṇi hūm̐ phaṭa/ rab tu rmongs ma'i'o/ /oṃ badzra bai tt+ra li kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba duṣṭānbhi kṛ ta be ṣa dhā ri ṇi bi kri tā lam̐ kā ra/ bhū ṣi te ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ pa tsa pa tsa/ mā bi lamba mā bi lamba/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra pra we sha ya maṇḍa la ma dhye/ utthā pa ya sarb+bam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ro langs ma'i'o/ /om̐ e hye hi bha ga wa ti badzra gu hye shwa ri ba hu bi bi dha be sha dha ri ṇi sarba ta thā ga ta dzuṣṭe sa ma ya ma nu sma ra/ ha na ha na/ ram̐ ga ram̐ ga ram̐ gā pa ya ram̐ gā pa ya/ pū ra ya pū ra ya/ ā bi sha ya ā bi sha ya/ sarba bhū trān na/ rta na rta na/ rtā pa ya rtā pa ya/ haḥha ha ha ha/ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ pukka sī'i'o/ /oṃ badzra shū lā gri bhinda bhinda sarba duṣṭa hṛ da yam̐/ ā karṣa ya ā karṣa ya/ ha na ha na/ da ha da ha/ nirma tha ni rmā tha mā ra ya mā ra ya/ mā bi lamba mā bi lamba/ sa ma ya ma nu sma ra hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ gdol pa mo'i'o/ /oṃ badzra ma he shwa ri ham̐ ham̐ ham̐ ham̐ haḥru lu ru lu bhyo hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ bha kṣa ya sarba duṣṭānnirma tha hṛ da yam̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ ghasma rī'i'o/ oṃ sum̐ bha ni dipta sa ma ya badzre hūm̐ phaṭa/ he ru ka dang mtshungs pa'i'o/ /oṃ badzra bam̐ she hūm̐ swā hā/ gling bu ma'i'o/ /oṃ badzra bī ṇe hūm̐ swā hā/ pi wang ma'i'o/ /o badzra mu kunde hūm̐ swā hā/ mu kun da'i'o/ /oṃ badzra mṛ dam̐ ge hūm̐ swā hā/

rdza rnga ma'i'o/ /oṃ badzra ba ḍa bā mu khi yo gī shwa ri hī hi hi hi hi hūm̐ dzaḥ rta gdong ma'i'o/ /oṃ badzra dam̐ ṣṭ+rā wa rā ha mu khi trām̐ ba trām̐ ba hūm̐/ rdo rje phag gdong ma'i'o/ /oṃ tsand+ra sūrya hu tā sha ni sing ha ni rnā de sidha wakt+re siddhi ni ṭam̐ ṭam̐ bam̐/ seng ge gdong ma'i'o/ /oṃ badzra dhā tu sam̐ dzī ba ni ma hā yakṣi ṇi shwā na rū pi ṇi ma hā prā la ya ni rṇaṇa de kā ma rū pi ṇi trām̐ tra ṭa tra ṭa ho/ khyi gdong ma'i'o/ /swā hā/ zhes bya ba ni thams cad du'o/ /'di rnams ni dpal he ru ka 'khor dang bcas pa'i'o/ /oṃ am̐ swā hā/ bdag med ma'i'o/ /oṃ ām̐ swā hā/ rdo rje ma'i'o/ /oṃ iṃ swā hā/ dkar mo'i'o/ /oṃ īṃ swā hā/ chu'i rnal 'byor ma'i'o/ /oṃ um̐ swā hā/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i'o/ /oṃ ūm̐ swā hā/ pukka sī'i'o/ /oṃ ṛṃ swā hā/ ri khrod ma'i'o/ /oṃ ṝṃ swā hā/ gdol pa mo'i'o/ /oṃ l̥ṃ swā hā/ g.yung mo'i'o/ /oṃ l̥̄ṃ swā hā/ dkar mo'i'o/ /oṃ eṃ swā hā/ chom rkun ma'i'o/ /oṃ aiṃ swā hā/ ro langs ma'i'o/ /oṃ oṃ swā hā/ ghasma rī'i'o/ /oṃ auṃ swā hā/ sa spyod ma'i'o/ /oṃ am̐ swā hā/ mkha' spyod ma'i'o/ /'di rnams ni bdag med ma 'khor dang bcas pa'i'o/ /oṃ de wa pi tsu badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ kyai rdo rje'i snying po'o/ /oṃ trai lo kyā kṣe pa hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ /phyag gnyis pa'i'o/ /oṃ dzwa la dzwa la bhyo hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag bzhi pa'i'o/ /oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badzra hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ phyag drug pa'i'o/ /oṃ na mo bha ga wa te bī re shā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma hā kalpā gni sanni bhā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dza ṭā ma ku ṭotka ṭā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ dam̐ṣṭ+rā ka rā lo gra bhī ṣa ṇa mu khā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sa ha sra bhu dza bhā su rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/

oṃ pa ra shu pā sho dya ta shū la kha ṭwām̐ ga dhā ri ṇe hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ byā ghrā dzi nāmbha ra dha rā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ/ oṃ ma hā dhū mrāndha kā ra wa pu ṣā ya hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ phyag 'bum pa'i'o/ /oṃ shrī he he ru ru kam̐ badzra ḍā ki nī dzā la sam̐ wa raṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ dur khrod la dgyes pa phyag gnyis pa'i 'o/ /oṃ shrī he ru ka badzra sarb+ba duṣṭa sa ma ya mu drā pra bham̐ dza ka hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ drag po'i gdan can gyi phyag gnyis pa'i'o/ /oṃ hrīḥha ha hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ rig pa'i rgyal po'i'o/ /'di rnams ni he ru ka 'byung ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye buddha ḍā ki nī ye swā hā/ yi ge bcu drug po 'di rnams ni/ mkha' 'gro ma'i rtsa ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ mā rī tsyai swā hā/ 'od zer can gyi snying po'i'o/ /oṃ mā rī tsyai battā li ba dā li ba dā li/ ba rā ha mu khi swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po'i sngags so/ /oṃ pi shā tsi parṇaṇa sha wa ri sarb+ba mā ri pra sha ma ni hūm̐ hūm̐ ma ho da ri phaṭa/ ri khrod ma shing lo can gyi'o/ /oṃ badzram̐ ku shā karṣa ya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra pā sha bandha hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kā li tardza ya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra muṣṭi gṛhna hūm̐/ oṃ badzra kī li kī la ya hūm̐/ oṃ badzra muṅga rā ko ṭa ya hūm̐/ sngags 'di rnams ni shin tu grub pa ste/ don yod pa'i dngos grub sgrub pa'o/ /oṃ badzra ḍā ki ni i mam̐/ /ba liṃ gṛhna gṛhna hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ sa ma ya satwam̐/ dṛ shya hoḥ de ltar lan gsum bzhi lngar bzlas nas gtor ma sbyin par bya'o/ /rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i gtor ma'i sngags so/ /oṃ kha kha khā hi khā hi/ sarba yakṣa rākṣa sa bhū ta pre ta pi shā tsinmādā pa smā ra ḍā ka ḍā ki n+ya da ya i maṃ ba liṃ gṛ hṇatu sa ma ya rakṣantu sarb+ba siddhi mme pra yatstshantu hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ 'byung po thams cad kyi gtor ma'i sngags so/

/oṃ ki ṭi ki ṭi badzra hūm̐/ byin gyis brlab pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ āḥhūm̐ sho dha ya sho dha ya rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ phaṭa/ sa sbyang ba'i sngags so/ /oṃ badzra ḍū ki ni hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ gau rī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tsaṇḍa lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ baittā lī hūm̐ phaṭa swā hā/ sngags pas cho gas bsnun pa dang / gsad pa dang / dgug pa dang / gar byed pa'o/ /oṃbadzra si hi ni ām̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra byā ghri īṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dzam̐ bu ke ūm̐ swā hā/ oṃ badzra u lū kā sye ṝṃ swa hā/ oṃ badzra ra dze nd+ri l̥̄ṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra dīpta te dze aiṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra tsū ṣi ṇi tsū ṣa ya sarb+ba sa twām̐ auṃ swā hā/ oṃ badzra kambo dze aḥswā hā/ oṃ hrīḥswā hā/ dbus su ste/ ye shes kyi mkha' 'gro ma 'khor dang bcas pa'o/ /oṃ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥkham̐ ram̐/ mchod yon gyi sngags so/ /oṃ kham̐ ni rī hūm̐ kham̐/ zhabs bsil gyi sngags so/ /oṃ dhwam̐ dhwam̐/ dri dang bshos gtsang la sogs pa'i sngags so/ /oṃ ha ho hrīḥswā hā/ phyag rgya chen po'i sngags so/ /oṃ ku ru ku ru sa ma yā dhi pa ti hūm̐ dzaḥswā hā/ dgug pa 'i sngags so/ /ha hi hu he ho ham̐/ yan lag drug la dgod pa'i sngags so/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rgyud las byung ba bya ba thams cad yang dag par 'byung ba'i brtag pa'i rgyal po ste brgyad pa'o// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis bcom ldan 'das la mchod nas/ phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /mya ngan 'das pa'i gnas rgyas pa/ /bcom ldan lha yis bshad du gsol/ /gang du gnas su bzhugs gyur pas/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu bcas par rol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /ci rigs brtags pas sems 'dzin pa/ /nga yis bshad par bya yis nyon/ /gang zhig de skad sngar gsungs pa/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/

/dkyil 'khor lus zhes brjod par bya/ /sgo bzhi ji skad gsungs pa 'o/ /lte ba'i dbus gnas pad chen po/ /kun mkhyen ye shes mngon par grags/ /gnas der gnas pa'i dpa' bo ni/ /dri med dri ma rnam par spangs/ /lus la gnas shing nag nog med/ /lus can kun la rnam par rol/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi rdzu 'phrul che/ /rnam par mdzad cing rab tu bsgyur/ /kha cig tu ni byang chub chen po'i sems/ /kha cig tu ni ji ltar spyod rjes 'brang / /kha cig tu ni dga' ldan lha rnams lags/ /kha cig tu ni 'bab par gyur pa dang / /kha cig tu ni bltams pa rnam dag cing / /kha cig tu ni khab nas gsal byung dang / /kha cig tu ni byang chub chen por mchod/ /kha cig tu ni bdud las mchog tu rgyal/ /kha cig tu ni mngon par rdzogs byang chub/ /kha cig tu ni 'khor lo rab tu bskor/ /kha cig tu ni phas kyi rgol ba dag /lhan cig chos kyis tshar ni gcod pa po/ /kha cig tu ni dngos grub kun dbang phyug /kha cig dpal ldan 'jig rten gsum las rgyal/ /kha cig tu ni dpag bsam shing mchog kun/ /dngos grub dbang phyug bla na med pa nyid/ /de ltar la sogs mtha' yas mchog /sangs rgyas kun bdag sdom pas ni/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam par grol/ /de phyir gti mug yongs su spangs/ /ā li bung ba zhes byar brjod/ /bung ba rdo rje 'jigs byed nyid/ /ā li nam mkha'i mthar gtugs par/ /chos kyi dbyings kyi rang bzhin las/ /rgyu dang mi rgyu gsang blo 'dzin/ /phung po khams dang skye mched dang / /dbang po kun gyi bdud rtsi dang / /las rnams thams cad skye ba nyid/ /de phyir thams cad bkug nas ni/ /rtsa ba'i dbus su thim par bya/ /'jigs byed rdo rje sgra yis ni/ /rdzogs pa'i rnal 'byor rdzas las ni/ /rlung dang me dang bdun pa'i don/ /rdo rje can gyi sa bon sbyar/ /thig le sgra yis yang dag mnan/ /char gyi rgyun zhes brjod par bya/

/dbyangs kyi dang po mchog sa bon/ /de yi dbus su gzung bar bya/ /kā li me tog shes par bya/ /me tog rdo rje can gyi lus/ /ma mo kun gyi sa rnams kyang / /kun la 'khor ba bskyed par 'gyur/ /ye shes chu bo rgya mtsho 'dir/ /shes rab chu srin dbyangs kyi nyas/ /gnyis med 'dam gyis dbus su ni/ /thabs kyi rnam pa'i myu gu nyid/ /bam̐ du lta bur bya ba nyid/ /sbrang rtsi dang ni bdud rtsi gnas/ /kā li dang ni bdud rtsi nyid/ /chu dang me tog nang du 'khor/ /bdud rtsi chu yi cho ga mchog /gnyis las lus ni skye bar 'gyur/ /gang du bdud rtsi dang ni chu/ /lnga yis bdag nyid du ni gsungs/ /me ni tsha ba nyid yin te/ /reg pas rlung ni du bar lta/ /chu ni gsher ba'i dngos po ste/ /sa ni gzugs su blta bar bya/ /ye shes rdo rje byin brlabs pas/ /rnam pa lngar ni rab tu bskyed/ /yang ni chu ni kun gyi dbyibs/ /de bzhin me yis zad par byed/ /de bzhin rlung ni rtag pa yi/ /sa ni dbang po'i gzugs can ma/ /hūm̐ gi glu yi rnam pa yis/ /rnal 'byor ma kun mnyes par byed/ /rdo rje yan lag dgyes pa'i mthus/ /spyan gyis gzigs par mdzad pa yi/ /yi ge'i dngos po rang bzhin ni/ /stong par rol pa nyid kyis ni/ /dngos dang dngos med rnam spangs pas/ /snying po yang ni 'tshal ba nyid/ /ma lus pa yi bsam pa dang / /yi ge thams cad gzhom par gyis/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i rnal 'byor pas/ /chu rnams kyi ni dgos pa can/ /gnyis med chos ni thob pa ni/ /thar pa yang ni thob pa nyid/ /'khor ba'i bde bas rmongs pa la/ /grol ba yang ni spangs pa nyid/ /thams cad stong pa'i rang bzhin la/ /rnal 'byor ma yi sngags kyis rol/ /rnal 'byor ma ni lnga po rnams/ /sangs rgyas de nyid mtshon par bya/ /sgyu mar gnas pa du ma kun/ /sna tshogs gzugs kyis sems can smin/ /rdo rje brkyang ba'i dgos pa ni/

/chos kyi rmongs pa bral bar byed/ /rnal 'byor ma yi thar pa can/ /snying po chos la phyag 'tshol cig /rigs kyi bu bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi glu 'dis rgyal ba thams cad kyis bdag nyid las skye bar 'gyur ba la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /dgu pa las de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi skyed pa zhes bya ba rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //gtor ma'i las chog ji lta bar/ /rdo rje gtso bo rgyal po nyin/ /khru gang tsam gyi tshad du ni/ /dmar po'i dri yis dkyil 'khor bya/ /dkar pos phyi rol gru gsum bya/ /mchod yon mchod sogs rim gro dang / /nya dang sha sogs bza' ba dang / /chang dang myos byed spro ba yang / /g.yon du nye bar dgos pa kun/ /g.yas pa dag tu chu yi snod/ /sngon du mchod yon dag gi snod/ /rdzas ni 'di dag thams cad rnams/ /bdud rtsi lnga yis sbyang bar bya/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i ting 'dzin nam/ /yang na he ru ka dpal brtson/ /las kyi cho ga mthong ba yis/ /sngags dang phyag rgyas dgug par bya/ /me tog dmar pos bdug pa sogs/ /dri la sogs pa dbul bar bya/ /oṃ gyis mtshan pa'i padma'i snod/ /lce hūm̐ de nyid khyad par las/ /ye shes lcags kyu'i rab dbye bas/ /yid kyis thams cad dgug pa 'o/ /kye bcom ldan 'das ye shes kyi lcags kyu dur gsungs/ de gang lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /dang po skye dgu'i bdag por brjod/ /de bzhin gnyis par sgrol ma nyid/ /gsum pa la ni rab mchog brjod/ /bzhi pa la ni mang po skyes/ /lnga pa la ni stobs zhes bya/ /rigs lnga rnams kyi sngags 'di dag /ye shes lnga yis rab dbye bas/ /ye shes chen po lnga po 'di/ /khyod la phan pa'i bsams pas bshad/ /ye shes lcags kyu'i rab dbye bas/ /las rnams kun la sbyar bar bya/ /gal te las la phan 'dod pas/ /rnal 'byor ma kun tshim par bya/ /'dod la dga' bar mi bya zhing / /longs spyod la ni sbyor mi bya/

/sems can don rgyu rnal 'byor pas/ /mchod pa thams cad yang dag brtag /dbyangs kyi bcu gsum las byung ba/ /gang zhig zla ba de rab grags/ /de yi dbus su sa bon gyi/ /ā li kā li mnyam sbyar bas/ /lha kun de nas tshim par bya/ /'bud pa sbar ba nyid dang ni/ /khyad par du ni bskol ba nyid/ /shel gyi gzugs kyis bskyed bya zhing / /de phyir thams cad brtag par bya/ /de yi dbus nas blangs nas ni/ /de nas bdud rtsi myang bar bya/ /lhag ma la sogs dngos po kun/ /phyi rol dkyil 'khor tshim par bya/ /g.yon pa'i cha yi snod dang ni/ /g.yas pa'i khro bo bstan par bya/ /rkang pas mnan cing steng du blta/ /spyi bor pheṃ gyi rnam pa 'byung / /zla ba mar ngo'i bcu bzhi dang / /khyad par du ni brgyad pa dang / /yar gyi ngo yi bcu pa la/ /mchod pa mchod pa'i bdag nyid gyur/ /oṃ/ shing gcig dang ni dur khrod dang / /ri bo dang ni 'bab chu dang / /khyim dang grong gi ngos dag dang / /zhing dang grong ni stong pa dang / /sems can snod dang thang stong dang / /chu la yang ni khyad par du'o/ /drag po nag po drag chen po/ /lha mo yang ni mnyam par gnas/ /nag po thod pa can 'jigs rung / /dga' las 'das dang log 'dren rnams/ /rgan byed ma dang drag mo dang / /gdol pa mo dang 'jigs pa'i gzugs/ /lha mo dka' zlog thams cad du/ /rgyal ma dang ni rnam rgyal nyid/ /mi thub ma dang gzhan mi thub/ /nag mo bzang mo nag mo che/ /rtse mo nag mo rnal 'byor mo/ /dbang mo zla mo 'jigs pa ma/ /gdug pa can dang lam ba kī/ /sum cu rtsa gsum dbang phyug ma/ /g.yo ldan mar me 'jib byed ma/ /grong du gnas pa'i rnal 'byor ma/ /'jigs pa'i gzugs dang gzugs chen ma/ /mche ba gzugs ngan gtsigs pa nyid/ /thod pa'i phreng ba 'phyang ba can/ /mthu chen lag na kha ṭwām̐ ga /lag na dgra sta ral gri dang / /rdo rje lag ma gzhu yi lag /mkha' 'gro ma yi de nyid che/

/las rnams rjes su sgrub par byed/ /rnal 'byor dkyil 'khor rgyal mo che/ /de bzhin rdo rje'i dbang phyug gtso/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku chen las/ /skyon med dbang phyug 'byin pa mo/ /rdo rje dbang phyug bka' lung 'dis/ /thams cad las ni thams cad dgug /oṃ ka ka ka ḍhya na ba ba bandha na kha kha khā da na sarb+ba duṣṭā nām̐ ha na ha na/ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ a mu ka sya shāntiṃ ku ru hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭ phaṭ dzaḥswā hā/ bdud rtsi'i bsam gtan dmigs nas ni/ /bdud rtsis kha ni dgang bar bya/ /las sogs bsams nas rnal 'byor dang / /rnal 'byor ma ni bsgom par bya/ /las rnams thams cad rab grub 'gyur/ /has ni kha dog 'phrog par byed/ /hos ni dri ni 'jig par byed/ /hrīḥni brtson 'grus 'joms par ni/ /rim pa 'di ni brjod par bya/ /rnam gsum lan gsum brjod pas ni/ /gsum gyis lha rnams tshim par bya/ /padma'i dbang phyug gzugs gser mdog /gzi brjid dri chu rnam snang dang / /rdo rje'i dbang phyug myang ba ni/ /lag na rdo rje lha gsum dag /rnam pa gsum du shes par bya/ /'dir ni chos rnam bzang por ltos/ /'du ba rnams la the tshom med/ /bram ze khyi dang gdol pa rnams/ /rang bzhin gcig pa nyid du zo/ /tshigs bcad 'dis ni de nas sbyin/ /rol bcas mchog tu rjes bskor bas/ /g.yon dang g.yas pa'i lag pa yis/ /'dod pas bskor bar bya ba 'o/ /rang 'dod lha yi rnal 'byor gyis/ /ji ltar rab tu bsgyur bas 'jug /bde gshegs chos ni rin thang med/ /'dod chags dri ma rnam par bsal/ /gzung dang 'dzin pa rnam par spangs/ /gus pas de la phyag 'tshol cig /tshigs bcad 'dis ni blang bar bya/ /yang dag spyod pa'i de nyid 'di/ /gtsang sbra kun tu rnal 'byor pa'i/ /ji ltar bde ba zhes byar brjod/ /yan lag yan lag bde gsol 'debs/ /gnyis gnyis 'khyud pa'i sbyor ba yi/ /sgyu ma yis ni rnam par brgyan/

/dngos po rnam grol phyag 'tshol cig /rdo rje dril bu'i sgra rnams kyis/ /ci 'dod pa yi bkra shis glus/ /hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ rdo rje thal mo sbyar byas nas/ /snying ga ru ni gzung bar bya/ /de nas sems can kun sogs la/ /smon lam rnams ni gdab bya ba/ /sems can thams cad bde gyur cig /sems can thams cad skyon med par/ /gang gi lam gyis 'gro 'gyur ba/ /de ni sangs rgyas nyid thob gyur/ /ma bsgral ba dag bsgral bar bgyi/ /ma grol ba dag bdag gis dgrol/ /rnal 'byor bstan bcos bya ba'i dngos/ /da lta ru ni yang dag brtags/ /rdo rje khu tshur dam bcings nas/ /g.yon pa snying gar gzhag par bya/ /lag pa g.yas pa brkyang nas ni/ /sa la bzhag nas gshegs su gsol/ /oṃ ātma tiṣṭha hūm̐ swā hā/ phyi ni bdag gi dbug kyis ni/ /bdag gi lus la thim par bya/ /skad cig gcig pa'i rnal 'byor gyis/ /bdag gi dngos pos mchod par bya/ /oṃ sarb+ba duṣṭa gṛhṇa gṛhṇa gatstsha hūm̐ phaṭ/ se gol gsum gtogs nas phyi rol gyi lha rnams gshegs su gsol bar bya'o/ /dgu pa las gtor ma'i mchod pa ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //gsang ba'i padma bde ba can/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag bzhugs la/ /gsang ba la ni rnam gnas nas/ /de la lha mo des zhus pa/ /sbas pa dam pa'i dngos spyod yul/ /bde gshegs kun gyi dkyil 'khor dang / /khro bo rnams dang lha rnams dang / /thams cad lha ni khyod kyis gsungs/ /ji ltar nang la rnam gnas pa'i/ /de nyid bla med bdag 'tshal yang / /bdag la da dung the tshom mchis/ /gang gi cho gas bris sku dang / /glegs bam yang ni bri bar bgyi/ /lha lags 'di dag mi 'tshal bas/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /de bdag lang tsho dal ba dang / /rgyas shing rnam rtog med pa dang / /khro med lkog 'phyas med pa dang / /shin tu cha phra mkhas spro dang / /bzod dang dad pa snying rje ldan/

/de ltar gyur pa'i ri mo mkhan/ /yang na dam tshig can gyi yang / /ri mo mkhan gyis bri bar bya/ /sgrub pa po dam pas dpa' bo shi ba'i ras sam/ ro la dkris pa'i ras sam/ bu btsas ras sam/ khrag chen pos btsos pa'i ras sam/ bud med kyi me tog gis rab tu bsgrubs pa'i ras rnams la sgrol ma dang / 'od zer can dang / de bzhin du ri khrod ma shing lo can la sogs bri bar bya'o/ de la 'di'i cho ga ni gsang ba'i phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas shin tu mnyam par gzhag pas 'drir gzhug par bya'o/ /skyes pa'i thod par gnas par ji ltar gsungs pa'i kha dog lngas sihla dang / ga bur la sogs pa bsres pa dang / ro'i skra'i pir gyis bris sku 'jigs pa bri bar bya'o/ /dang por slob dpon gyis mnyam par gzhag pas shes rab dang ldan zhing / rgyan thams cad kyis rnam par brgyan pa dang / dpal yang dag par sbyor ba'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas yan lag la ni ram̐ shu bsam zhing gcer bur gyur pa dang / de bzhin du yang lhag ma dang / ma dag pas mkhas pas mi bya'o/ /kye bcom ldan 'das gal te sihla la sogs pas bsres pa lags na/ de'i tshe ji ltar ma dag pa lags/ bcom ldan kyi bka' stsal pa/ /pho nya gtsang sbra dang po ste/ /gnyis pa la ni zhi bar 'dod/ /snod gcig tu ni zas nyid ni/ /gtsang sbra gsum pa nyid du gsungs/ /phyi rol rnal 'byor la dga' bas/ /gtsang sbra 'di dag yang dag brtsam/ /rang sems dri ma can gyur la/ /gnas ni 'di yis ci zhig dgos/ /gang yang log pa'i chos gnas pa/ /'dod pa'i don kun 'dod pa ni/ /khyi yi skye gnas brgyar 'gro ste/ /sme sha can du skye bar 'gyur/ /dper na kha cig mar don gnyer/ /dad pas chu ni bsrub gyur kyang / /mar gsar thob par mi 'gyur te/ /lus nyon mongs pa kho nar zad/ /'dzin dang mchod pa ma gtogs par/ /gzhan du bzang mo don med 'gyur/ /'tsho ba'i thabs kyi rgyu yi phyir/ /rnal 'byor gzhan la brten pa nyid/

/dung dang nya phyis mu tig rnams/ /gsum char rgyu las byung ba nyid/ /chos kyi sku yi lus can gyi/ /thod pa la ni su zhig smod/ /mchod phyir thogs pa dag byed kyang / /dam pa'i chos kyi rim par gsungs/ /gtsang sbra he ru ka dpal gnas/ /de phyir kun tu rab 'bad pa/ /phyag rgya lhan cig sgrub pas mchod/ /shin tu bzhin mdzes snying rje can/ /gzugs dang lang tsho skal bzang ma/ /gzugs bzang sgrub pa po la dga'/ /rang gi phyag rgya g.yon du gzhag /pir la byin brlabs 'dri mkhan la/ /byin te bris sku 'jigs pa ni/ /dngos grub thams cad rab ster ba/ /de nas yang dag dang bri bar bya/ /'jig rten gzhan la mi bstan zhing / /ri mo mkhan dang sgrub pos blta/ /glegs bam khyod la bshad bya yis/ /lha mo skal ba chen mo nyon/ /gro ga'am ta la'i 'dab ma la/ /glegs bam sor ni bcu gnyis pa/ /sbrang chen snag tsha byas nas ni/ /mi yi rus pa'i smyu gu yis/ /dam tshig can gyis bris bar bya/ /glegs bam dang ni bris sku nyid/ /gal te skal ba med mthong na/ /skye ba 'dir ni 'grub mi 'gyur/ /'jig rten pha rol spyod yul min/ /dam tshig sems dpa' sbyin par bya/ /res 'ga' tsam 'ga' zhig bstan pa 'o/ /glegs bam lam gyi spyod yul du/ /skra dang mchan khung dag du sba/ /dam tshig sems dpa' sbyin par bya/ /dgu pa las bris sku dang glegs bam gtan la dbab pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //sil snyan yang dag sbyor mtshan nyid/ /bshad par bya yis lha mo nyon/ /a ra a ra dzeṃ dzeṃ sma ra sma ra tsa ṭa bam̐ hoḥ ra ṭa bam̐ ho hu lu hu lu hūm̐ dzaḥhūm̐ dzaḥ a la a la hū ṇu hū ṇu hū ṇu/ hram̐ hram̐ hram̐ hu tam̐ ghai hu tam̐ ghai ghai ghai ghai ta ṭa ghai ghai tam̐ ṭa ghai ghai tam̐ ghai ta ghai ta ghai hando hando do hūm̐ do hūm̐/ ka ka ka ka/ kau kau kau/ kauṃ kauṃ kauṃ/ /bai ྃkaiṃ bai ྃkai ཾbai ྂkai /bi ྃbadzra badzri bai ྃbadzra badzri bai ྂཿkai ྃཿbai ྂཿkai ྃཿbai ྂཿkai ྃཿbai ྂཿkai ྃཿbai ྃhūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ bhyo/

ru lu ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ bhyo hūm̐ bhyo/ rdo rje 'dzin pa la sogs pa'i'o/ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ ṭakki hūm̐ dzaḥ ṭakki dzaḥ/ 'di ni rol pa'i'o/ /ta ḍa ba ta ḍa ba/ brahme brahme/ rta mgrin gyi'o/ /hrī ྃṣṭ+rī ྃhrī ྂṣṭ+rī ྃhrī ྃṣṭ+rī ྃṣṭ+rī ྃṣṭ+rī ྃṣṭ+rī ྃ/ hrī ṣitrā hrī ṣitrā hrī ṣitrā/ gshen rje'i rgyal po'i'o/ /hrīm̐ hrī ྃ/ kum̐ hrī ྃkum̐ hrī ྃkhanta khe ྃkhanta khe ྃkhanta khem̐/ padmam̐ padmam̐/ hrī ྃpadmam̐ hri ྃpadmam̐ hrī ྃpadmam̐/ trī ྃtrī ྃtrī ྃtrāe ྃtrāe ྃtrāem̐/ hrī ྃhrī ྃhrī ྂhrī ྃhrī ྃhrī ྃ/ hri ྃtam̐ hrī ྃtam̐/ hrī ྃhri ྃhrim̐/ sgrol ma'i'o/ /de nas cang te'u'i mtshan nyid bshad/ /badzri shirsha rtsa ba dang / /tsandan dmar po las byung dang / /gzhan rnams gang rnams de rnams ni/ /yid la 'dod pa rnams la bya/ /de yi tshad 'di bka' stsal pa/ bcu gnyis pa dang bcu pa nyid/ /kha la sor ni drug dang lnga/ /dgu pa dang ni bcu gcig nyid/ /kha la de yi phyed nyid do/ /gzhan pa yi yang rnge'u chung ni/ /thod pa las ni bskor ba nyid/ /spre'u'i pags pas g.yogs pa 'o/ /de bzhin kha sbyor gnyis la ni/ /padma dag ni bri bar bya/ /bud med khrag gis mdzes pa dang / /dur khrod skyes pa'i skra las ni/ /bkal nas rus pa gnyis ni bcing / /khyim gyi me tog gnyis kyis ni/ /padma ze 'bru gnyis pa la/ /dkyil 'khor nyid ni bri bar bya/ /mtshan mo bzhi mdo dag du ni/ /rkang pa g.yon pa'i mthe bong gis/ /dkyil 'khor gru bzhi mtshams su ni/ /rdo rje lcags kyu bri bar bya/ /der gnas g.yon pa'i ngos su ni/ /ji ltar dang por ming bzung ba/ /kheṃ hūm̐ zhes ni brjod nas ni/ /chu skyar rkang pa'i rus pas gdab/ /de ltar g.yo ldan ma la sogs/ /thams cad 'gugs par byed par 'gyur/ /gal te 'ongs par ma gyur na/ /de tshe mkha' 'gro ma kun 'chi/ /nges pa nyid du 'grub 'gyur bas/

/ngas gsungs pa la the tshom med/ /gal te khros pas slob dpon gyis/ /can te'u rdung bar byed pa na/ /de tshe mchi ma 'dzag cing ngu / /khyod ni dam tshig la ni khro bo sngon po mdzes/ /dngos grub phyag na dbyug to rin chen bcings pa 'dzin/ /kye dpal ldan dpa' bo 'du bar 'khor ba sgrol ba 'khums/ /mkha' mdzes rnal 'byor ma yi nang du bdag thongs shig /tshogs kyi 'du ba bzang po nyid/ /lha mo skal ba chen mo nyin/ /'dod pa'i don kun sgrub pa mo/ /gang du zos pas 'grub 'gyur ba/ /dur khrod ri yi tshang tshing dang / /rgya mtsho chen po'i 'gram du 'am/ /yang na dben pa'am bas mtha' ru/ /bza' ba 'di dag yang dag brtsam/ /me tog bdug pa mar me dang / /de bzhin bza' ba bca' ba nyid/ /chang ni sgeg mo ru ni brjod/ /sbrang chang rab tu myos mar brjod/ /bu ram chang ni myos byed gsungs/ /snying po bdud rtsi rgun chang yin/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi kla klo yis/ /bdud rtsi lam ni yan lag brgyad/ /rgun 'brum sbrang rtsi dpa' bo gcig /nya phyis rtsub pa'i 'dod pa can/ /sings po bshang bar brjod pa ste/ /rtsabs dang bran mo sings por brjod/ /de ltar bza' ba sna tshogs dang / /chang dang nya dang yang dag ldan/ /dga' ba'i longs spyod skal bzang bas/ /dpal ldan rdo rje sems dpa' 'grub/ /a mra smin dang pa na sam̐/ /rgun 'brum nā ri ke la dang / /ā lu ka la sogs pa ni/ /'bras bu sna tshogs tha dad pa/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor dbul bar bya/ /'dis ni glu dang phyag rgya dang / /nges par gar kyang khyad par du'o/ /ka ka ka ka ka ka ka ka/ /hi hi hi hi hi hi hi hi/ hrī ྃhrī ྃhrī ྃhrīm̐/ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/ hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā hā/ i hā hā i hā hā/ hā hā hā/ dzām̐ dzām̐ dzām̐ dzām̐/ a i a i.a i/ dzam̐ dzā/ i ྃdze ྃdzām̐/ i ྃdzā i ྃdzā i ྃdzā i ྃdzem̐ dze ྃdze ྃi ྃte am̐/

hi hi hi hi hī/ hi hi hi hi hī/ hi hi hi hi hī/ hi hi hi hi hī/ hi hi hi hi hī/ ñdza hī hī hi hi hi hī ñdza hī hī hi hi hi hī ñdza hī hī/ kardza hi hi/ de ltar kla klos kun 'dar nyid/ /he ru ka yi sbyor bas gar/ /phyag rgya nyid kyang khyad par du'o/ /gang phyir lta stangs de khu tshur/ /lta stangs khu tshur rkang pas rkang / /ji ltar rnal 'byor rim pa las/ /sangs rgyas kun gyis rnam par mdzad/ /sring mo'i bu mo sgyug mo dang / /ma dang sring mo yin na yang / /de rnams gang bar mchod nas ni/ /tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor 'grub par 'gyur/ /skyes pa'i thod chen cha gcig par/ /chang ni bzang pos yongs bkang ste/ /bla ma la dbul skal chen ma/ /phyag 'tshal nas ni rang yang btung / /padma'i lag pas blang ba dang / /de nyid kyi ni lag pas dbul/ /yang nas yang du phyag 'tshal ba/ /de la sgrub pa po yis bya/ /dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba bya ba bzhi'i de kho na'i rgyal po ste brtag pa dgu pa'o// //rdo rje slob dpon dam tshig gi /grub rtags lag na rdo rje nyon/ /dang por dkyil 'khor chen po ni/ /snying ga yi ni dkyil 'khor du/ /rang gi dbang sogs rgyas pa yis/ /rang gi nang du zhugs pas na/ /rdo rje slob dpon mtshungs med pa/ /'grub 'gyur 'di la the tshom med/ /gang phyir thos pa de nyid kyi/ /bsam gtan spro ba nyid kyi phyir/ /rdo rje slob dpon 'grub par 'gyur/ /rdo rje sems dpa' snying po sogs/ /'bum du bzlas pas rab du 'grub/ /skal kun gyi sngon grub pas/ /slob dpon chen po gdod nas grub/ /cho ga 'dis ni sems cad rnams/ /rgyal bar 'gyur bar the tshom med/ /gnyis med spro bar bcas pa rnams/ /de nyid gnas shing go cha bgos/ /thams cad mkhyen pa gang gang gi /rigs kyi rab tu dbye ba las/ /phyag rgya gang dang gang gsungs pa/ /de dang de ni cho gas blangs/

/de dang de nyid kyis ni bsgrub/ /gti mug bdag nyid nges par ma/ /lha mo'am skye gnyis bdag nyid skyes/ /gti mug rnam dag bsam gtan pas/ /blangs nas mngon du rnam snang 'gyur/ /ma ni rig ma dam pa ste/ /gal te pha yis sngar bstan kyang / /de bzhin de nyid kyis kyang 'grub/ /bde ba chen po bka' stsal to/ /zhe sdang bdag nyid gdol pa mo/ /bu mo'ang gnod sbyin bu mo blang / /zhe sdang rnam dag bsam gtan pa/ /mi bskyod pa ni mngon du 'gyur/ /'dod chag bdag nyid gar mkhan ma/ /sring mo'am klu mo lha min blangs/ /'dod chags rnam dag bsam gtan pa/ /'od dpag med pa bsgom par 'gyur/ /phrag dog dbang nyid bzo shes ma/ /chu 'byung dga' ma'am sring mo yi/ /bu mo yang dag blangs nas ni/ /phrag dog rnam dag bsam gtan pa/ /dpa' bo don yon grub par 'gyur/ /nga rgyal bdag nyid mna' ma 'am/ /rgyal po'i bu mo'am rig 'dzin ma/ /blangs nas nga rgyal rnam dag pa'i/ /bsam gtan pa de nor bu'i rigs/ /'byung gnas su ni 'gyur ba 'o/ /spyan dang lhan cig sangs rgyas nyid/ /mā ma kī dang mi bskyod par/ /'grub 'gyur dkar mo lhan cig tu/ /padma can dang sgrol ma ni/ /lhan cig don yon grub par 'gyur/ /rin chen rin chen ma dang 'grub/ /rigs pas 'dod pa 'di dag 'grub/ /gzhan yang 'dis ni khro bo yi/ /lha dang rgyal ba'i sras po dang / /khro bo rab gtum cho ga dang / /zhi la zhi ba'i cho ga yis/ /zhi ba rab tu 'grub par 'gyur/ /'dod chags rgya chen zhen pa dang / /nga rgyal ldan pas 'grub par 'gyur/ /de ltar dka' ba med pa'i thabs/ /kun mkhyen thugs rje bcas pas bsngags/ /shin tu bde ba sgrub pa'i thabs/ /brtul zhugs dka' thub spyod pa spangs/ /de ltar bdud rtsi'i ro rnyed nas/ /nyon mongs gzhom phyir mi brtson gang / /ji ltar dkar thub brtul zhugs des/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni bya ba nus/ /rang gi bde ba'i thabs rnyed nas/

/gang zhig bdag don mi byed pa/ /rmongs pa'i bdag nyid de yi ni/ /sangs rgyas nyid ni gang du 'gyur/ /yang ni de ni shes mi 'gyur/ /'dis ni sangs rgyas thams cad du/ /skye bo dam pas mthong ba nyid/ /las kun rmi lam sgyu ma ltar/ /sangs rgyas chos la mi shes pas/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol du/ /ji srid ma phyin bar du bya/ /bcu pa las slob dpon dang phyag rgya byin gyis brlab pa ste rab tu byed pa dang po'o// //de nas gang du rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa der 'di lta bu'i phun sum tshogs pa 'byung ste/ sa 'di dag dga' zhing mgu la rangs pas rnam pa drug tu g.yos nas bdud kyi gnas su cha lang lta bu'i sgra grags pa dang / phyogs bcur bskal pa'i me lta bu'i skar mda' ltung ba dang / rgya mtsho chen po 'khrugs pa'i sgra dang / thams cad du gnam rdo ltung ba dang / de nyid du bskal pa'i me'i gzugs lta bu'i ye shes kyi snang ba 'bar ba dang / phyag rgya'i skye gnas kyi snying por khams gsum thams cad snang ba dang / /tshangs pa dang / khyab 'jug dang / chu bdag dang / brgya byin dang / drag po dang / me dang / stobs bzang po dang / nyi ma dang / zla ba dang / gnod sbyin dang / grub pa dang / dri za dang / mi'am ci dang / lto 'phye dang / lha'i mchog dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang / chus byung la sogs pa gang zhig gzhan yang sum cu rtsa sum du gnas pa'i lha rnams der 'ongs nas yang dag par dga' bas me tog gis mchod par byed do/ /pi wang dang / gling bu dang / mu kuṇḍa dang / tambu ra dang / dung dang / zangs dung dang / nandi dang / pa ṭa ha dang / rdza rngas nam mkhar gnas te/ der rtag tu mchod par byed do/ /lha'i bu mo dang / rig pa 'dzin pa'i rgyal po'i bu mo thams cad kyis gar byed pa dang / sil snyad du ma byed pa dang / mi'am ci dang / gnod sbyin gyis glu len par byed cing gar byed pa dang / de la dga' ba dang bcas pas rgyal ba rgyal ba zhes bya ba'i sgras rtag tu rol par byed pa dang /

gang zhig grub pa nam mkhar gnas pa'i lha rnams kyis ni legs so'i rnam pa rab tu gsol bar mdzad do/ /gang zhig dga' ldan du gnas pa'i lha rab mchog dang / gang zhig lha'i bu dang / rig pa 'dzin pa dang / 'og min gyi bar du 'ongs nas phyag 'tshal zhing me tog sna tshogs kyi rnam pa dang / dri sna tshogs kyi char dang / bdug pa sna tshogs kyi khyad par gyis gus pa'i tshul gyis mchod par byed do/ /gzhan yang khyod la rgyas par bshad pa'i tshul gyis ci zhig dgos te/ bsgrub par bya ba'i bsod nams kyis khams gsum du skyes pa'i mchod pa de rnams kyis mchod par byed do/ /bcu pa las bde ba chen po'i dngos grub kyi mchod pa dang rim gro zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gnyis pa'o// //rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa ni/ /gang du mchi zhing gang du gnas/ /bdag la the tshom 'di dag ni/ /bde ba chen pos bshad du gsol/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /rig ma'i skyes bu grub pa ni/ gang du yang mi 'gro/ gang du yang mi gnas/ thog ma dang / tha ma dang / dbus dang bral ba/ gnyis su med pa/ gnas gsum du snang ba/ thams cad son pa/ thams cad mkhyen pa/ thams cad pa/ thams cad kyi don thams cad sems can thams can kyi sems la gnas pa/ sdig pa thams cad las rnam par grol ba/ yon tan thams cad kyis brgyan par byas pa/ thams cad dang ldan pa/ zhi ba dang / mnyam pa med pa dang / rtag tu 'char bar mdzad pa/ mgon po/ skyob pa/ kun tu rtog pa spangs pa/ dbyibs dang kha dog dang bral ba/ rgyal ba'i yang spyod yul ma yin pa/ rgyal po phyed par dka' ba'i phyir rdo rje/ nyon mongs pa'i nye bar gdung ba las grol ba'i phyir zla ba/ dogs pa med pa'i phyir seng ge gting dpag par dka' ba'i phyir chu'i phung po'o/ /de ltar dpe sna tshogs kyis rnal 'byor pa rnams kyi dper bya'o/ /de nyid gcig pus sems can rnams kyi don byed pa dang / rnam par rtog pa thams cad spangs pas kyang bltams pa ston pa dang /

khab nas mngon par 'byung ba dang / gzhon nu'i rol rtsed mdzad pa dang / rab tu byung ba dang / rdo rje gdan gyis mnan pa dang / bdud btul ba mnyam pa med pa dang / sangs rgyas pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi 'khol lo bstan pa dang / lha las babs pa nyams dga' ba dang / shin tu sna tshogs pa'i cho 'phrul dang / /glang po che nor skyong 'dul ba dang / /skal ba dang ldan pa'i skye bo dag pa gzhug pa dang / phas kyi rgol ba tshar gcad pa dang / bsod snyoms kyi lhung bzed la ltos pa med pa dang / 'jig rten gsum gyi 'khor lo 'dul ba dang / byang chub sems dpa'i rgyal tshab nyid dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / khams gsum gyi chos kyi rgyal po chen po ste/ de ltar rigs kyi bu 'di ltar khyad par du ma rmi lam lta bur sangs rgyas kyi rol pa mchog tu ston par mdzad de/ gang zhig grub pa sgyu ma'i tshul gyis 'gro ba thams cad kyi don mdzad do/ /bcu pa las sangs rgyas kyi sgyu ma rnam par mdzad pa zhes bya ba ste rab tu byed pa gsum pa'o// //gong du bshang gci khrag dang ni/ /nya dang sha yi sbyin sreg ni/ /lha ni khyod kyis gsungs pa nyid/ /ji ltar ye shes sems dpa' la/ /mi gtsang bas ni kha bkang na/ /sdig pa ji ltar skye mi 'gyur/ /gal te sdig las ji ltar 'bras/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ /mi shes rmongs pa'i sems cad gang / /ye shes thabs ni rnam par spangs/ /phyi rol dngos por mngon zhen pas/ /rtog pa'i dra bas dra bar byas/ /de yi sdig dang bsod nams kyi/ /cha gnyis rnam par rtog pa ste/ /'di rnams chos ni rang bzhin dag /ma skyes pa dang gnas med cing / /sems can ye shes 'phel ba'i phyir/ /don dam las ni bsod nams nyid/ /thabs ni sangs rgyas rnams kyis bstan/ /skye ba dang ni spangs med na/ /bsod nams min la su zhig zhen/ /dper na sems can pha rol 'gro/ /chu klung chu yis gang ba la/ /shing dang rtswa ni bsdus nas ni/

/chu la gzings ni byas nas su/ /de la 'jus nas brgal nas kyang / /spangs nas bde bar 'gro bar 'gyur/ /de ltar 'khor ba'i pha rol du/ /chos dang chos min zhon nas ni/ /bde bas byang chub 'thob par 'gyur/ /chos dang chos min rnam par spangs/ /de phyir rtog pa'i dra ba ni/ /spangs nas zab mo'i chos ni 'phel/ /de bzhin gshegs pas gsungs pa'i lam/ /lam rig rnam par rtog mi bya/ /rnam rtog gti mug chen po ste/ /'khor ba'i rgya mtshor ltung byed yin/ /mi rtog ting 'dzin la gnas pa/ /mkha' bzhin dri ma med par 'gyur/ /dbang po gnyis ni mnyam sbyor bas/ /sku gsung thugs ni 'dus pa yis/ /nga rgyal las ni rgyal ba'i gzugs/ /rnam pa thams cad yongs su spangs/ /rnam par shes pa rdzogs pas ni/ /skye ba 'dir ni ye shes can/ /bud med dang ni skyes pa'i lus/ /las ni du mas bskyed pa ston/ /mi shes pas kyang mi bya ste/ /sku yi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /sems cad sna tshogs gdung ba dang / /kun rtog ngan pa'i rnam rtog gis/ /sems la smad par mi bya ste/ /thugs kyi rdo rje'i dam tshig go /phra dog nyid kyis ma rungs pas/ /tshig rtsub la sogs smra mi bya/ /rna ba bde bar byed pa nyid/ /gsung gi rdo rje'i tshig go /sha yi khams gnas sangs rgyas ni/ /rnam snang chen po rtse mor skye/ /rkang la mi bskyod gnas pa nyid/ /khrag ni rin chen lta bur ni/ /nor bu chen pos rnam par brgyan/ /rus pa la ni 'od dpag med/ /sems cad rnams kyi rigs bcas 'bab/ /rtsa yis 'ching ba'i tshogs kyi sgor/ /don yon thub pa rgyal po nyid/ /khyod la gsang ba nga yis bshad/ /dam tshig ye shes rig pas bstan/ /blo ldan thugs kyi rdo rje yis/ /rtag pa ru ni bsgom par bya/ /'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug dang / /sred pa dang ni 'du byed 'phel/ /'di lnga thub pa'i rgyal pos gsungs/ /bshang gci khu ba bad kan dang / /khrag dang yongs su 'dzag pa rnams/

/'byung ba bzhi ni yongs gzung nas/ /blo yis rdzogs pa yongs bsgoms pas/ /gang zhig dam tshig bstan par bya/ /thams cad du ni zos pas 'byung / /dper na bud med byis pa yis/ /gtam la rjes mos smra ba yi/ /'du ba'i gtam ni brjod pa ste/ /lam yang 'ching ba med par brjod/ /de lta'i cho gas rnal 'byor pa'i/ /legs pa'i lam ni ston pa 'o/ /de nas rnal 'byor pa dang / rnal 'byor ma dang / mkha' gro ma dang / mkha' 'gro bye ba phrag brgyad cu dang / byang chub sems dpa' dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i dge 'dun du ma'i 'khor thams cad dga' zhing mgu ba'i sems kyis de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi ye shes thams cad kyis thob par gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pa thams cad dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par dga'o/ /rgyud thams cad kyi gleng gzhi dpal yang dag par sbyor ba las byung ba de kho na nyid thams cad kyi gleng gzhi brtag pa'i rgyal po chen po ste bcu pa rdzogs so// //rgyud kyi rgyal po 'di ni paṇḍa ta gā ya dha ra dang / bdag nyid chen po 'brog mi shākya ye shes kyis bsgyur ba las/ slad kyis thams cad mkhyen pa bu ston zhabs kyis rgya dpe rtsa 'grel dang bstun nas hor kong bsabs shing 'gyur bcos legs par mdzad pa las bris so// //de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pas yang mchod pa byas nas phyag 'tshal te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /thig ler thig le dag gi don/ /gtan phab yang dag gsal gsungs na/ /bdag gi dbus su rang byung bas/ /des na rang byung brjod par bya/ /rang byung zhes bya 'byung chen gyi/ /don ni rjes su dpag bya'i phyir/ /'di ni rang byung bcom ldan 'das/ /gcig pu nyid ni lhag pa'i lha/

/lhag pa'i lha zhes bya ba ni/ /gong du gsungs pa'i khams rnams so/ /de rnams dbus su phul byung che/ /zhes bya gtso bo'i gzugs kyis so/ /gsang ba mchog tu dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /ji lta bur ni bcom ldan 'das/ /sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i sdom/ /gzhan du ji ltar rnam pa 'dis/ /sdom pa mchog tu phan pa lags/ /gsang ba'i sgras ni yon tan can/ /gsang ba'ang yon tan du ni grags/ /rdo rje can ni yon tan can/ /'jig rten mchog dgyes smod pa spangs/ /gsang ba'i sgra ni kla kla'i skad/ /phyi rol rjes su btsal bas kyang / /'di ni mngon sum shes par bya/ /rjes dpag yon tan can gyi sgras/ /gang tshe sems ni mi mthong ste/ /sems zhes bya ba 'di yang ni/ /yon tan can dang yon tan gsungs/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /gsang ba 'di la chos nyid gnas/ /de la thams cad bdag nyid ni/ /de ni thams cad rnam par gnas/ /de gang stong pa'i rdo rje can/ /sdug dang lhan cig dga' ba 'o/ /gang tshe sems kyi gzugs kyis ni/ /sngo sogs mig gis mi dmigs shing / /rna sogs thos pa par mi 'gyur ba/ /de tshe sems ni ji ltar bur/ /de tshe rjes dpag ji ltar lags/ /'di ni sna yis mi dmigs na/ /dri bzang dbus su gnas sam ci/ /sems ni phyi rol mi dmigs shing / /de bzhin nye ba'i longs spyod med/ /ro ni mngar dang kha la min/ /de bzhin du ni reg bya nyid/ /gsang ba mchog gi dgyes pa na/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /gsang ba 'di ni ji ltar bur/ /rjes su dpag pas bsam par bya/ /ji ltar yi ge'i dbyibs su ni/ /phyin pa yi ni ye shes nyid/ /gzhan du bcom ldan sgra ji ltar/ /lha zhes bya ba ji ltar lags/ /sangs rgyas kun gyi nges don ci/ /mnyam par sbyor ba ci zhes bgyi/ /mkha' 'gro ma ni gang gi ming /

/dra ba ji lta bu zhig lags/ /sdom pa zhes bya ci zhig bshad/ /de bzhin spyad par dka' ba nyid/ /khyod kyis 'dod chags med gsungs ci/ /chags bral med pa de bzhin gzhan/ /dbu ma zhes bya gang gi ming / /bud med kun gyi sgyur ma ci/ /stong nyid gzugs khams la sogs pa/ /ci zhig bshad cing mnyam nyid sbyor/ /dang po rnam pa drug 'gyur dang / /sna tshogs padma bris sku dang / /ā li kā li phyag rgya che/ /de nyid med sems rnal 'byor dang / /de nyid bzang po ji ltar lags/ /rnal 'byor nyid la mnyam gzhag dang / /phyi rol drag kyang yang dag bshad/ /zla ba nyi ma rdzogs sangs rgyas/ /'byung ba ji lta bu zhig lags/ /bris pa dang ni ma bris pa'i/ /dkyil 'khor ji ltar gzhag par bgyi/ /de bzhin sngags dang rgyud nyid dang / /gsang ba'i gnas ni mi 'tshal zhing / /padma bzhi ni khyad par du/ /bdag dang bdag gi ji ltar lags/ /de bzhin sems dang sems byung nyid/ /sems kyi ngo bo ye shes gsungs/ /de bzhin rnam par shes pa nyid/ /rgyu dang 'bras bu'i dngos po dang / /de bzhin chos dang chos can nyid/ /chu bo'i rgyud ni ci zhes bshad/ /rgya mtsho yang ni khyad par du'o/ /sna tshogs nyid ni khyod gsungs na/ /mang po ji ltar 'thob mi 'gyur/ /rnam shes ye shes khyod kyis gsungs/ /de bzhin bcud kyis len nyid dang / /g.yon brkyang la sogs ci lags dang / /gzhu yis rnam rgyal de bzhin gzhan/ /gtso dang gtso min sgra ci lags/ /brtag pa yang ni ci zhig gsungs/ /byang chub chen po'i chos rnams ni/ /sum cu rtsa bdun nang gi dang / /sku la sogs pa de bzhin gzhan/ /nyan thos rnams kyis khyod gsungs dang / /des kyang dgos pa ci zhig mchis/ /rdo rje sems dpa' bde ba che'i/ /rnam pa'i rnal 'byor gyis ni ci/ /tshangs pa dbang phyug khyab 'jug kyang / /de bzhin gsol ba ci yi don/ /'dod pa'i lha ni chung mar bcas/ /lha mo dka' zlog gzugs bzang ma/

/gong du skyabs su song ba nyid/ /gnyis gnyis sbyor ba 'dod mdzad pa/ /'di ltar sbyor ba'i 'thab mo dang / /de la gsang ba ji lta bu/ /rdo rje can gyis rdzun pa yi/ /phyis ni tshig tu smra bar mdzad/ /sangs rgyas rdo rje sems dpa' yang / /tshangs pa khyab 'jug dbang phyug dang / /zla ba sngar gsungs gzhan du ni/ /thams cad bdag nyid rtag tu bzhugs/ /ji ltar rdo rje can zhi bas/ /khro bo'i gzugs can ji ltar lags/ /chos kyi sku ni ji ltar lags/ /longs spyod rdzogs pa ci zhig lags/ /sprul pa rdo rje nyid 'byung dang / /he ru ka ni ji ltar gsungs/ /padma gar dbang ji ltar lags/ /gshin rje'i gzugs su ji ltar 'gyur/ /de bzhin du ni rta mchog nyid/ /ji ltar cho gas ci gsungs dang / /lha mo de bzhin khro bo nyid/ /kla klo khyod kyis bshad pa ni/ /des kyang dgos pa ci zhig mchis/ /re zhig lha mo rnams kyi tshig /btu bar byas pa ji ltar lags/ /sngags kyi smra pos 'di dag ni/ /ji ltar rdo rje sems khyod kyis/ /thams cad yang dag rnam par shod/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'di skad bdag gi zhes bya ba la sogs pa nas gzung ste/ dang por brtsam par byas nas 'dir yang rjes su 'byung ste/ rigs kyi bu yang brjod pa bya'o/ /gsang ba'i sgras ni bdun gyi rnam pa ste bdun pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /brgyad pa ni brjod du med pa'i mtshan nyid do/ /gsang ba zhes bya ba'i sgras ni sems dang sems las byung ba gnyis su med pa ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gsungs so/ /de bzhin nyid du ro gcig pa nyid ngo bo gcig pas der gsang bar byung ba'i phyir gsang ba ste/ nam mkha' thams cad du khyab par 'gro ba ni bcom ldan 'das kyi tshad de/ dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i ye shes kyi phyag rgya la sogs pa dang / rdo rje'i lha mo dang ldan pa ni gnas so/ /kye bcom ldan 'das khyad par du 'phags pa'i gnas gang lags/

/bcom ldan kyis bka' stsal pa/ mchog ces bya ba ni khyad par du 'phags pa ste ye shes dam pa'i yul lo/ /dgyes pa na zhes bya ba ni nyams dga' ba na ste/ dpe thams cad dang bral ba'o/ /spyan la sogs pa dang yang dag par sbyor bas dga' bar byed pas nyams dga' bar byed pa'i phyir dgyes pa na'o/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i sbyor ba dang / lha mo thams cad dang mnyam par 'gro bas nam mkha'i khams kyi mthas gtugs par lha mo thams cad kyi bde ba chen por sbyor ba thams cad kyi bde ba dang ldan pa 'di las 'byung ba'i stobs ni gzhan du med de/ phan tshun du rab tu rangs pas dga' bar byed cing / skyes bu rnams dang de rnams kyi dga' ba ni dgyes pa na'o/ /thams cad bdag nyid ces bya ba ni thams cad kyi bdag nyid de/ rigs kyi bu de ltar bcom ldan 'das kyis gnas gang sngar gsungs pa'o/ /de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid du gsungs te/ thams cad bdag nyid kyis ni de gsungs so/ /de ltar gyur pas thams cad bdag nyid ces bya ba 'dis gnas phun sum tshogs pa gsungs so/ /ji ltar gsungs pa'i gnas su so so bskyed pa'i rang bzhin gyis ji snyed btsun mo'i 'khor gyi dbus su rtag tu bzhugs so zhes gsungs so/ /sangs rgyas dang kun 'dis sangs rgyas kun te/ 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyi rdul phra rab dang mnyam pa'o/ /rtag pa la sogs pa de bzhin gshegs pa de rnams kyis byas pa'i phyir ram/ rang bzhin gyi phyir gnas ni sangs rgyas kun dngos zhes bya ste/ sgyu'am rang bzhin la dngos po'o/ /sems dpa' ni sems can gyi don la nus pa'i phyir ro/ /rdo rje ni thabs dang shes rab kyi ye shes kyi rang bzhin gyi phyir ro/ /sems dpa' ni rnam par rtog pa thams cad kyis mi bskyod pa'i phyir ro/ /bde ba ni sngar gsungs pa'i dga' ba'i sbyor ba las shin tu ldan par zhi ba'i yid kyi rang bzhin gyi phyir ro/

/mchog ni khyad par du 'phags pa ste/ bde ba'i go 'phang 'di rnams kyi sems dpa' 'di rnams kyi don dam pa'i phun tshogs pa gsungs so/ /'on kyang sangs rgyas kun dang mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i sdom/ /zhes bya ba mi 'dod pa'i phyir ro/ /'on kyang gzhan nyid du brjod par bya ba'i phyir dogs pa bsu nas bka' stsal pa 'di ni zhes bya ba ni gang de skad du rigs kyi bu de ni gsungs pa de nyid/ sangs rgyas thams cad mnyam sbyor ba/ /mkha' 'gro ma yi dra ba'i sdom/ /zhes bya ba'i don to/ /lha mo thams cad kyis yongs su bskor cing / dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i bdag nyid kyi rnal 'byor rdzogs pa ni skal ba bzang po ste/ rang gi bdag nyid kyi sgrub pa shin tu sbyor ba de nyid mchog tu 'dod chags pa dang ldan pa'o/ /skyes bu med pa'i gar mkhan rang gi btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du gnas pa'i phyir shin tu don la rnam par mi g.yeng bas lha mo rnams dang yang dag sbyor ba'i bde ba myong bar bya'o/ /yang dag par sbyor ba ni rnal 'byor te zhes pa'o/ /brtan pa/ rtag pa/ mchog tu yang yid srub pa'o/ /yang na brtan pa ni rnam par rtog pa'i rlung gis mi g.yo ba'i phyir ro/ /gzhan yang mtha'i mtha' ji srid gnas pa'i phyir rtag pa'o/ /mchog tu yid srub pa ni lha mo thams cad kyi bde ba rjes su myong ba'i phyir ro/ /brtan pa dang / rtag pa dang / mchog tu yid srub pa 'di brtan pa dang / rtag pa dang / mchog tu yid srub pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kun zhes bya ba ni gzugs dang / sgra dang / dri dang / ro dang / reg bya ste/ yul gyi rang bzhin rnams so/ /rang gi bsod nams kyi tshogs kyi rgyu mthun pas ci zhig byed ce na/ /'di ni rang gi longs spyod dang / de rnams za bar byed do/ /gzhan du na ni tha dad pa'i dngos po la rang gis nye bar longs spyod pa nyid ma yin no/ /ye shes kyi rang bzhin so sor skyes pa ni rgyal ba rnams kyis kyang shin tu mi spong ste/

rnam pa sna tshogs pa'i rim pa'i sbyor ba 'dod chags kyi spyod pa la sogs pa'i rang bzhin las gang zhig 'dod chags kyi spyod pa de rnams ni rdo rje sems dpa' pa'i cho ga 'dod pa'o/ /gang zhig rang bzhin bzang po de rnams ni rnam par snang mdzad kyi dngos grub 'dod pa'o/ /de ltar zhe sdang dang / 'dod chags dang / ser sna dang / le lo la spyod pa rnams kyis he ru ka dang / padma gar gyi dbang phyug dang / rdo rje nyi ma dang / rta mchog gi cho ga 'dod par 'gyur ro/ /rigs kyi bu de lta de ltar 'dod chags la spyod pa la sogs pa mi mthun pa'i phyogs kyis ji ltar dpal rdo rje sems dpa' la sogs pa skyed par 'gyur ba bskyed nas/ tshogs kyi dkyil 'khor rnal 'byor las bskyed de/ /rnal 'byor gyi gtam gyis slob ma 'dul bar byed do/ /gtam ni brjod pa'o/ /bcom ldan gtam ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa'i gtam brjod pa ste/ kun rdzob kyi bden pa'i rang bzhin du byas pa'o/ /dpal rdo rje sems dpa'i chos kyi sku'i rgyu mthun pa nyid kyis ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i rang bzhin la nye bar spyod pa'i phyir dpal rdo rje sems la sogs pa bskyed pa'o/ /rang bzhin brjod par bya ste/ brtan pa zhes bya ba ni chos ri rab ltar brtan pa'o/ /dper na ri rab rlung gis bzlog par dka' zhing rab tu gtum pas kyang bskyod pa mi nus so/ /de bzhin du bcom ldan dpal rdo rje sems dpa' 'di ni 'dod chags la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa dang / nye ba'i nyon mongs pa dang / mu stegs pa can ngan pa'i rgol ba rab tu gtum zhing rab tu 'joms pas rang lhag par 'gro zhing bskyod pa nus so/ /dur khrod du bzhugs pas kyang sems can thams cad kyi rgyud du rgyu zhing rnam par dag pa'i sems chos kyi sgo du mar rjes su 'khor zhing / lhan cig tu bcom ldan 'das 'khor bar bzhugs pa'o/

/brtan pa zhes bya ba ni gnas pa'i phyogs so/ /g.yo ba zhes bya ba ni sems can gyi rgyud las gzung ste/ de rnams ni bcom ldan 'das kyis shes par bya'o/ /ji ltar rnam par dag pa'i bdag nyid de rnams nyid de gzhan dang rnam pa gcig pa'i ngo bo ste/ de nyid kyi phyir bcom ldan 'das 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi thugs rnams la bzhugs so/ /sems can nyid kyang de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad de/ dngos po'i don dam pa la gnas pas de bzhin gshegs pa zhes gsungs so/ /g.yo ba ni spre'u lta bu ste/ gang zhig sems can thams cad kyi sems brtan pa'i phyir sems dpa' zhes gsungs so/ /'dzin pa'i phyir ting nge 'dzin te/ nges pa 'byed pas rdo rje nyid du 'gyur ro/ /de'i phyir sems kho na g.yo ba nyid du gsungs shing phyi rol sogs pa ma yin te/ de rnams ni gcig dang du mas dngos po med pa'i phyir ro/ /thams cad ces bya ba ni ma lus pa'o/ /dngos po zhes bya ba ni gnas kyi don to/ /srid pa zhes bya ba ni skye ba'o/ /brtan pa dang g.yo ba zhes bya ba ni brtan pa dang g.yo ba'o/ /dngos po dang thams cad 'di ni dngos po thams cad de/ de ni brtan pa dang g.yo ba thams cad dngos po dang srid pa'o/ /brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin ni gang gi thams cad kyi bdag nyid kyi rang bzhin 'dii ni brtan pa dang g.yo ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi bdag nyid de/ de nyid kyi phyir bcom ldan 'das rdo rje can gyis rdo rje 'dis bka' stsal to/ /rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs kyi chos nyid kyis brtan pa dang / g.yo ba'i dngos po thams cad kyi bdag nyid de/ 'dis 'di dag brjod par 'gyur ba'i chos kyis dbyings rnam par dag pa dang / me long lta bu la sogs pas bsdus par 'gyur ba rtag pa dang / mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i sangs rgyas lnga po thams cad kyi phun sum tshogs pa bsdus par 'gyur ba'o/

/kun gyi sgras ni yongs su zhes bya bar gzung ngo / /mnyam par sbyor ba ni 'du ba'o/ /gang du zhe na/ gsang bar te/ thams can kyi chos kyi 'byung gnas kyi bdag nyid du yin gyi gzhan du ni ma yin no/ /gang dang lhan cig zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' dang ste/ de dang yang dag pa'i rang gi ngo bos sprul pa la sogs pa'i yan lag dgu yis so/ /'on kyang longs spyod rdzogs pa can du mdzad pa'i sku gcig gis thams cad nas de'i bdag nyid kyi chu dang 'o ma lta bur 'ong ba yongs su 'dzin to/ /de nas dkyil 'khor chen po'i rnal 'byor gyis phyi dang nang gi dngos po thams cad kyi nang du de kho na skad cig gis ji ltar sangs rgyas thams cad kyis mdzad pa ltar rtogs shing shes so/ /de bas na sangs rgyas thams cad dang / de las gzhan pa rnams kyi lhan cig yang dag par sbyor ba ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'o/ /mnyam pa'i dus ni dbyer med pa'i dus te/ sbyor ba'i gnas kyis thams cad kyi des sems tsam du snyoms par zhugs pas gcig tu gyur ba'i dngos pos phan tshun du bsdus pas dngos po thams cad kyi rang bzhin gyis thams cad du 'gro ba'i phyir sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba zhes gsungs so/ /de bas na sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor bas ni phyogs bcu'i nam mkhar 'gro ba yang dag par mthong ba 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i mkha' 'gro mar gsungs so/ /dra ba'i sgras kyang sgyu ma'i rnam grangs su blta ste/ shing la sogs pa rnams las sgyu ma'i rnam pa'i sprul pa'i glang po che la sogs pa ltar mi bskyod pa la sogs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams lus med kyi 'dul ba'i sems can mi spong ba'i phyir ro/ /dkar mo la sogs pa'i rdo rje lha mo'i gzugs la reg pa'i phyir de nyid gyur pas sangs rgyas thams can dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sgyu ma'i mtshan nyid kyis gang zhig zag pa med pa'i bde bas yid zhi ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa mang por 'gyur ro/

/de nas sdom pa'i sgras brjod par bya ste/ sam̐ zhes bya ba ni bde ba'o/ /ba ra zhes bya ba ni khyad par du 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /bud med kun ni gong du gsungs so/ /sgyu ma ni ji skad du gsung pa ste/ sgyu mas sgyu ma'i rang bzhin des zhes bya ba'i don to/ /de yang rang bzhin gyis grub ste grub pa rdzogs pa'o/ /ji ltar rang gi ngo bo yongs su gyur pa zhe na/ rang rnams dang de rnams kyi gzugs can ni rang gi gzugs can te/ kun gzhi dang / nyon mongs pa can dang / yid dang / mig dang / rna ba dang / sna dang / lce dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa de rnams yongs su gyur pa ni rang gi ngo bos yongs su gyur pa'o/ /bdag med pa'i ting nge 'dzin gyi sgom pas me long lta bu dang / mnyam pa nyid dang / so sor rtogs pa dang / bya ba nan tan gyi rang bzhin la gnas nas ldog par 'gyur ba zhes bya ba'i don to/ /gang gi phyir rang gi ngo bo yongs su gyur pas bud med thams cad kyi sgyu ma'i rang bzhin gyi dngos grub yin te/ de'i phyir/ rnyed pa kun gyi bde spro bas/ /bud med thams cad 'grub par 'gyur/ /zhes bya ba yin no/ /sna tshogs dang sgyu ma ni sna tshogs sgyu ma ste/ kha dog dang dbyibs sna tshogs pa las lha mo thams cad la sogs pa'i gzugs so/ /de'i sna tshogs sgyu ma'i phyag rgya 'di bzung nas blo la gzhag par byas nas 'di skad bka' stsal pa/ mkha' 'gro ma bcom ldan 'das rdo rje sems dpa' nyid kyis btsun mo'i 'khor gyi nang du son pa'i phyogs bcu'i nam mkhar gang zhig 'gro ba 'di ni sgyu ma sna tshogs kyi phyag rgya zhes bya ba don to/ /'jig rten dang 'jig rten las 'das pa thams cad kyi bstan bcos kyi nang du rab tu grags pa mi gsal ba'i skad kyis rang gi brdar byas pa zhes bya ba'i don to/ /mkha' 'gro ma la sogs pa 'di ni mdor bsdus nas gsungs pa yin no/
